articleTitle: A Hybrid Cloud Storage System Utilizing The ECC Algorithm and Data Fragmentation Approach Utilizing Secure Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: To improve data security, the Hybrid Cloud Storage System combines data fragmentation and safe cryptography. The solution protects data security and integrity by encrypting files before storing them in the cloud, using the Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) technique. Combining public and private cloud environments, the hybrid cloud approach offers increased security, scalability, and flexibility. A data fragmentation strategy is used, in which the files are split up into smaller pieces and dispersed among several cloud sites, to further secure the data. Because each fragment is useless without the entire dataset, this fragmentation reduces the chance of data breaches. This method is perfect for safeguarding sensitive data in distributed cloud environments because it combines data fragmentation and ECC encryption to provide safe, effective, and dependable cloud storage. To optimize the data replica placement has become one of the fundamental problems. To reduce the inter-node traffic and the system overhead of accessing associated data items. Introduce Replication Management method for Optimal Performance and Security. File Fragmentation- Methodology to split the uploaded file into fragments. Replication is to help ease retrieval of data.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence based Smart vision based on Segmentation of Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Evaluating the simulation process of digital image processing and application in various fields with its image analysis technique is the essence of this article. The upcoming problems of segmentation of digital images for artificial intelligent vision are focused. The wide range of problems of computer vision can be solved by simulating digital images. This article discusses the proper evaluation of the different methods of segmentation and its importance in today's application. It discussed how algorithms help in digital image processing for face recognition, Irish recognition, and fingerprint. This study goanna help you improve the problem faced by digital image processing and create its various application in the upcoming future. Also, helps you to detect primary objective, improve performance, and perform better quality work in the field of image processing.

articleTitle: Embedded Language Translation Based on GRU Gated Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The project "Embedded Language Translation Based on GRU Gated Attention Model" aims to develop an advanced machine translation system that seamlessly integrates Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) with sophisticated attention mechanisms. This innovative model is specifically designed to handle sequential data effectively, addressing the common challenges of translating long sequences and maintaining contextual accuracy. By leveraging the selective focus capabilities of the attention mechanism, our system ensures more precise and contextually relevant translations. The comprehensive methodology includes meticulous data collection and preprocessing, model design and training, rigorous evaluation and fine-tuning, and seamless integration into resource-constrained environments such as mobile devices and IoT platforms. The ultimate goal is to deliver a robust, scalable, and high-performance embedded translation solution that can operate in real-time, thereby breaking language barriers and enhancing global communication.

articleTitle: Personalized Cancer Drug Recommendation using GAN and Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Through more accurate medication recommendations and increased treatment efficacy, machine learning has improved personalized cancer therapy. To support the treatment recommendation system for lung cancer, the study uses a Conditional Tabular Generative Adversarial Network (CTGAN) to generate synthetic patient data. Machine learning algorithms process data to recommend appropriate medications while LightGBM demonstrates superior performance to XGBoost by achieving 0.82 accuracy. Explainable AI (XAI) techniques produce greater transparency while supplying doctors with expanded treatment information. This approach aims to enhance patient treatment outcomes while establishing trust in AI-driven medical advice.

articleTitle: Smart Fabric Inspection: Leveraging Deep Learning for Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The early identification of defects on fabrics is important especially when it comes to the production of textile products. It presents the development of the deep learning technique for automated detection of defect zones in fabric. Using the sophisticated architectural design of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Mobile Net, Dense Net and Alex Net the research seeks to improve accuracy of the defects. In particular, an autoencoder model is applied due to its data compression and decompression features, which enable feature extraction. Thus, the study is cantered on the adjustment of the autoencoder’s input values, as well as hyperparameters for enhancing the performance. Holistically deploying the CNN in combination with other compact architectures such as the Mobile Net in combination with sound architectures such as Dense Net and Alex Net offers a versatile solution for fabric defect detection. This research proves by using different types of deep learning models combined, the automatic fault detection system in textile manufacturing can be enhanced in both accuracy and efficiency.

Author Keywords: fabric defect detection auto encoder feature extraction CNN Mobile Net Dense Net Alex Net

articleTitle: UMLify: Instant UML Diagrams from Scenario Descriptions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Unified Modeling Language (UML) is a visual modeling language for expressing the architecture and dynamics of software systems. Traditionally, creating UML diagrams required significant expertise and effort to translate user stories into visual representations. However, advancements in tools like PlantUML and Natural Language Processing (NLP) have revolutionized this process. This paper explores how these technologies can automatically generate UML diagrams, simplifying the transformation of natural language user stories into structured visual models. By focusing on the integration of NLP and UML generation tools, the paper aims to demonstrate their potential to streamline software development, improve accuracy, and enhance scalability in modeling processes.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Quality Control Using Data-Driven Approaches and Machine Learning in Metal Production
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The metal industry has a critical need for materials to be produced with a more economical method that minimizes or is free of any environmental impact, making the conventional quality control techniques that are heavily reliant on human inspection laborious, subjective, and prone to human error. This paper discusses how machine learning and data-driven next-generation quality control systems may represent a paradigm shift in the process of metal production. Using real-time data from several production processes, such as temperature, processing conditions, and material composition, the machine learning model can make very accurate forecasts and monitor the quality of the end product. It also adjusts the production process to make the best quality possible in real time, with the aid of pattern detection and anomalies.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Long Term Short Memory Based Text Mining Classification Method for Analysing the What’s App Messages with Text and Emoji
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this digital time, from plain text, emoji’s are crucial to supplement emotional expression. However, effectively understanding and applying text mining techniques to messages containing both text and emoji’s still continues to pose great challenges. This paper proposes a model based on Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM for enhanced emotion recognition for WhatsApp messages. The model utilizes CNN for the extraction of spatial features and BiLSTM for establishing the contextual relation of sequences to text. The framework begins with pre-processing of WhatsApp messages through tokenization of characters, filtering of stop words, normalizing emoji into meaningful representations. The CNN module extracts essential features from input sequences, while the BiLSTM works on learning the context dependency both into the past and into the future. The final classification layer implements a fully connected network with a soft-max activation for sentiment and emotional classification. The model was trained on a diverse and annotated WhatsApp dataset, in which text and emoji patterns are present, rendering it suitable for learning and generalisation tasks. Experimental results have demonstrated that the proposed method performs better than traditional machine-learning techniques in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The proposed system serves as a quick response to sentiment recognition via WhatsApp, surveillance of social media, and human-computer interaction, grasping the entire complexity of user emotions in digital communication. This study gives further impetus for emoji-aware text mining, providing substantial help within emotion recognition systems under natural language processing.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosing Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the primary cause of death, and hence, early identify and management would be absolutely important for saving lives. Heart rate monitoring device based on the Arduino platform using heart rate sensor, near infrared sensor and machine learning to provide accurate and reliable results. The data is analyzed by a machine learning model using the Bagging algorithm that gives predictive insights into cardiac health. A web-based dashboard is provided to show real-time analytic, and in case of abnormal readings, the GSM module sends SMS to the consulting doctor for further action. The system eliminates challenges that are associated with the traditional methods, such as high costs, delayed information, and the need for elaborate equipment and setup, thus suitable for home and remote monitoring. Through implementing the proposed system for the data alert collection system, analysis and accessibility of the data is improved, monitoring is made continuous, and the approach towards managing cardiovascular diseases is made more proactive.

articleTitle: OMACS Based Adaptive Intelligent Tutoring System Development
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nowadays learning through online among learners was increased. Most of the online resources are static, we can’t say everyone gain knowledge, to overcome this Intelligent Tutoring System (ITS) plays a vital role by providing adaptive path for each learner. The inherent properties of agents such as autonomy, pro activeness, adaptability reduce the complexity of intelligent tutoring system development. However, those agent-based ITS are developed in adhoc fashion, so in order to develop a ITS for a long run in this work an Agent Oriented Software Engineering (AOSE) methodology OMACS was applied for developing adaptive ITS. The proposed system addresses challenges such as content selection and usability while ensuring reusability and systematic design. The ITS integrates agents such as profile analysis, tutor, clustering, evaluation, and path planning agents to create a comprehensive learning environment. Implemented on the JADE platform, the system’s usability and adaptiveness were evaluated through qualitative and quantitative studies involving students and experts. Results indicate that the proposed ITS effectively enhances learning outcomes, achieving over 65% user satisfaction and more than 70% expert approval for its systematic design approach. Comparative analysis demonstrates that the proposed system offers superior reusability and extensibility compared to existing ITS solutions.

articleTitle: SHAP-Enhanced Hybrid Model for Accurate Financial Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The detection of fraudulent transactions presents challenges due to the nature of fraudulent datasets, where fraud cases hardly exist against legitimate ones. In the author's opinion, other traditional approaches performed significantly better but failed to meet the high quality and accuracy required for practical deployment. To face these issues, this work proposes a hybrid machine learning framework that combines Isolation Forest for anomaly detection and Logistic Regression for supervised classification purposes. The class imbalance issue is handled by SMOTE, which creates fake samples of the minority group. Besides that, some kind of interpretability is provided to the model through the application of SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), which gives an indication of which features are influential in contributing towards the fraud predictions. The framework shows high precision, with a much lower rate of false positives and provides transparency that makes it possible to scale and optimally solve the gap in practical applicability for fraud detection in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification: A Comprehensive Framework with Uncertainty Quantification and Markov Chain Simulation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor is an abnormal growth of cells within the brain or its surrounding tissues that can disrupt normal brain function. Brain tumors can be classified as benign (non-cancerous) or malignant (cancerous), with each requiring different diagnostic and therapeutic approaches. The proposed methodology aims to develop a machine learning-based brain tumor classification system using medical imaging data, such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans. The objective is to automatically identify and categorize tumor types, including glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumors, while distinguishing benign from malignant cases. It would comprise pre-processing MRI images for removing noise and improving clarity, feature extraction, and employing advanced machine learning techniques, like Convolutional Neural Networks or transfer learning frameworks, to perform classification. The model was tested against an expansive dataset of annotated brain tumor images to achieve high accuracy and robustness. Evaluation metrics include accuracy which is 99.31% for 2D images and 90.68% for 3D images, precision, recall, and F1-score to judge the performance of the model. The presented system can help health professionals make rapid and reliable diagnoses, resulting in better care and treatment.

articleTitle: VisionEase: Reconceptualizing Reading for Partial Vision Seniors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study focuses on the analysis of recent development in the field of accessible mobile e-Book applications for learners with a particular emphasis on usability demands and technological options. The analysis came up with some of these specific needs, among them being; text-to-speech customization, contrast, text enlargement, and ease of navigation, which this study fills by using machine learning model of gradient boosting to predict fonts and zoom factor for visually impaired to have easy simplified e-book. These usability attributes are important in the provision of access to the visually impaired people when using the digital contents. Although many studies have not addressed these challenges using machine learning, this paper demonstrates enhancing user experience such as incorporating ML models such as (Random forest, SVR, Decision trees and Gradient boosting) for predicting the font size and style. Of them Gradient boosting was chosen the best model due to its propriety to incorporate the numeric variables such as age, screen size, and categorical variables such as e-book content type and brightness. Furthermore, it has high precision and stability, which retains good performance on a small amount of data, satisfying the study’s condition. These model which includes Scikit-learn makes it possible to develop smart areas that adapt the shape and the content depending on the user’s demand to offer a more personalized reading experience. Thus, the outcomes shows that Gradient Boosting model sets the font size ( 27) and font style (Times New Roman) with the input attributes. Beside increasing the convenience in obtaining e-books, such development also provides positive effects for the visually impaired that is to enhance their ability and enable them to be more active members of society. Incorporating these models into the e-book platforms will help add onto the creation of a society where technology fits the needs of all consumers especially touching on the issues affecting the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Intrusion Detection System Malware Android Devices
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Malware infestations have increased with the rise of mobile devices, notably Android smartphones. Our work fixes this issue by improving Android security using Decision Trees (DT), Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Random Forest (RFs), and K-nearest neighbours (KNNs). We defend Android smartphones from malware using a proven way. We will test these machine learning methods against diverse illnesses. Android smartphones have raised security concerns, necessitating innovative techniques to recognize new threats. Machine learning algorithms that recognize and anticipate patterns may replace Android security. DT, KNN, RF, and SVM algorithms helped us construct a strong malware detection system. We evaluate numerous Android malware detection machine-learning algorithms based on speed, accuracy, and effectiveness. These findings should improve Android security machine-learning solution selection and implementation. Decision trees are transparent and open, random forests use ensemble learning, support vector machines excel in probabilistic classification, and KNN detects Android infections from similarity patterns better. A comparison study can provide the finest security solution. The initiative will provide the basis for mobile device security research and enhance Android's security using machine learning. Android smartphones will be safer from new attacks when security gaps are closed.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Phishing Detection: A Data-Driven Cybersecurity Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Phishing attacks have evolved beyond traditional emails to include SMS-based scams (smishing) and deceptive websites, posing a significant cybersecurity threat. Conventional rule-based detection methods struggle to counter attackers' sophisticated tactics. This paper presents an AI-powered phishing detection system that integrates machine learning and cybersecurity techniques to identify and prevent phishing attempts across multiple digital communication channels. Our system analyzes textual and behavioral patterns in emails and SMS messages, while advanced cybersecurity tools assess domain authenticity, URL structures, and webpage behavior for website phishing detection. By leveraging AI’s adaptive learning capabilities, our solution provides real-time, multi-layered defense against phishing threats, achieving high accuracy while maintaining a controlled false positive rate. This research contributes to cybersecurity by introducing a scalable, AI-enhanced system capable of adapting to evolving attack strategies, strengthening digital security, and improving user protection.

articleTitle: DINA-PTLC: AI-Powered Traffic Control For Faster Emergency Response
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Traffic congestion has become a major issue in most parts of the globe, mainly as a result of the high rate of vehicle growth. Consequently, the speeds of vehicles have reduced, resulting in lost time, lost opportunities, and increased frustration. Traffic congestion affects businesses too, resulting in loss of money, decreased worker productivity, lost trade opportunities, late deliveries, and increased expenses. In order to address these problems, new facilities and infrastructure need to be developed along with integrating advanced technologies to make them intelligent. Although widening roads and lanes is not always possible, using intelligent solutions through advanced technology can reduce traffic issues. More efficient traffic control systems are a pressing need. Nowadays, automatic traffic lights are managed by timers and sensors, where each phase is pre-programmed with a standard time. Yet, as worldwide vehicular traffic keeps increasing, it tends to cause heavy jams at intersections. Most traffic lights operate on a standard green-light cycle without consideration for emergency vehicles. Accordingly, emergency vehicles like ambulances, police vehicles, and fire engines can be trapped in traffic, leading to delays that can lead to loss of property or life. The major objective of our project is to enhance the flow of traffic and facilitate that emergency vehicles are able to reach their destinations without making unnecessary detours. This system will be put into practice through computer programs like Raspberry Pi OS, Pygame, Raspberry Pi GPIO, and Python to facilitate automatic lane clearance for ambulances.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Hybrid Feature Fusion for Improved Coffee Leaf Disease Detection in IoT-Enabled Python Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Coffee, a commodity of global importance, is the second-most traded product and is widely consumed across the globe. Nevertheless, the leaves of the coffee plant are susceptible to fungal infections and insect infestations, which impair their photosynthetic areas and result in inferior, damaged coffee beans. The precise and prompt identification of these illnesses is essential for executing appropriate remedial actions since various species need distinct treatments, including pesticides or other methods. Accurate identification enables the implementation of suitable measures to avert more plant damage, safeguarding agricultural production and quality. This study uses deep learning methodologies to create an enhanced disease-detection system for coffee leaves. The proposed network incorporates an inception module for feature extraction, a global context module to capture spatial relationships, and a multi-head attention module to improve classification accuracy. This hybrid model facilitates the effective detection of coffee leaf diseases, demonstrating strong performance across various environmental circumstances. The solution Utilizes IoT-integrated Python systems for real-time application, enabling accessibility for coffee producers and supporting prompt decision-making. The system seeks to enhance crop management, Minimize losses, and promote sustainable agricultural practices by tackling disease detection difficulties using advanced AI technology.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In order to maintain both public health and environmental sustainability, water quality must be effectively managed. An overview of a thorough Water Quality Management System (WQMS) that is intended to monitor, evaluate, and control water quality parameters in a range of aquatic habitats is provided in this abstract. Modern sensor technologies are integrated into the system to provide real-time monitoring of important parameters like turbidity, pH, dissolved oxygen, and pollutants like organic contaminants and heavy metals. Sensor networks placed across bodies of water, a reliable data transmission infrastructure, and a centralized platform for data management and analysis are essential elements of the WQMS. Accurate data interpretation, early anomaly detection, and trend prediction for water quality are made possible by the incorporation of advanced data analytics techniques, such as machine learning algorithms. This proactive strategy encourages prompt decision-making for preventing pollution, keeping an eye on regulatory standards compliance, and allocating resources efficiently. Through the provision of easily interpreted and available data, the WQMS fosters stakeholder collaboration and educates decision-makers about sustainable water resource management. In order to accomplish comprehensive watershed management objectives, future developments will try to improve sensor capabilities, increase geographic coverage, and combine with more comprehensive environmental monitoring systems.

Author Keywords: Internet of things and Wi-Fi technology

articleTitle: Prediction of Facial Emotions using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Facial expression prediction has gained considerable attention in recent years, particularly because of its applications in human-computer interaction. This paper compares a wide range of deep learning and machine learning models for the prediction of face emotion using the CK+ dataset proposed by Cohn-Kanade. The dataset is characterized by seven classes of emotions represented by the labels, namely surprise, happiness, disgust, anger, sadness, fear, and contempt, on 784 training, 98 validation, and 99 testing images. To further improve model performance, preprocessing techniques were employed that enhanced data efficiency. To increase variability in the data and reduce overfitting, all images were scaled to a 48*48 pixel resolution, pixel values were scaled to be between 0 and 1 for uniformity and the following data augmentation techniques were implemented: 10-degree rotation, horizontal flip, 0.15 zoom. The five models that were tested were CNN, SVM, VGG16, InceptionV3 and VGG19. The results demonstrate the high accuracy achieved by the CNN model which showed an accuracy of 98.98%, 99% and 99% in training, validation and test respectively. The SVM classifier got an accuracy of 99%. Both InceptionV3 and VGG19 on the other hand achieved competitive testing accuracy values of 90.91% and 97.98% respectively, while VGG16 got tested and reached an accuracy of 85.86%.

articleTitle: Multimodal Emotion Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Emotion recognition is a vital component of human communication and has significant applications across various domains. The goal of this research is to integrate text and visual data to create an effective model for real-time multimodal emotion identification. The text analysis utilizes fastText due to its speed and effectiveness, while 2D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is employed for image analysis to capture local features and handle content variations. The CMU-MOSEI dataset is used for testing and combining the datasets, and emotion predictions classified into six distinct categories. The study compares various approaches and emphasizes the advantages of multimodal affective computing systems, which achieve higher classification accuracy depending on factors like the number of emotions analyzed, extracted features, classification methods, and database consistency. By addressing challenges in understanding visual signals and emotional awareness, this research aims to advance emotion detection and recognition systems.

articleTitle: Collision Prevention Technology in IoT Integrated Smart Bike Helmet
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Helmet Wearing Detection: The first feature is ensuring the rider puts on the helmet before commencing the vehicle. The helmet comes equipped with sensors that detect the proper position on the head of the rider. If the helmet is not being used or on the wrong spot, the vehicle will not start, preventing the accident caused by riding without a helmet. Emergency Key: The emergency key is integrated in the bike's system. The emergency key can also be utilized for initiating an emergency signal if and when needed, and this will make the system react quickly whenever there are emergencies. Injury Detection and Location Tracking: In event of injury of the rider and failure to use manual sending of an emergency message, the system detects the injury automatically and forwards the rider's location to an already identified emergency contact. This function is significant in case the rider is disabled or unconscious, as it ensures that assistance reaches the person in time. Advanced Sensors for Accurate Injury Detection: This feature is crucial when the rider is unconscious or disabled since it provides that assistance to the person in time. Advanced Sensors for Accurate Injury Detection: The helmet incorporates acceleration and vibration sensors, which monitor impacts and abnormal motion that could signal a crash or severe injury. The sensors, coupled with the sensor reading from the bicycle, give the rider's state of being very accurate readings. All of these sensors combined enable the system to sense even slight signs of trauma, including jerky impacts and sudden impacts. This is a more effective way of gauging injury than relying solely on the helmet. When an accident happens, the system sends an alarm with the rider's exact location to the stored emergency contact number in the system. With the integration of these safety features, the smart helmet aims to reduce the risk of damage, offer timely assistance, and ultimately save lives. This technology offers an additional layer of protection through automatic notifications, improved response times, and greater safety for riders.

articleTitle: Vehicle License Plate Detection and Recognition using YOLOv9 and Easy OCR
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The objective of the paper is to propose an approach for a real-time accurate Automatic Number Plate Recognition(ANPR) system, which recognizes vehicle license plates. The system is based on a common vision concept that combines Optical character recognition (OCR) and YOLOv9 deep learning algorithm. Intended to overcome challenges including poor light, partial obstruction, and different angles for high-speed vehicle plate recognition over multiple regions. This means that not only is the architecture future-friendly for license plate designs, but it will also work with existing infrastructure so this can be deployed in traffic management, law enforcement, and security use cases.

articleTitle: Ship Detection using SAR Images for Maritime Vigilance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The identification of ships using the SAR methodology is vital for the security and surveillance of maritime domains, but it remains a complicated task because of the image’s intricacy and its small features. We introduce a Feature Extraction Algorithm that excludes non-ship neighborhoods along with a weight map to improve detection in heavily cluttered environments. We implement Feature Pyramid Networks, which enhances feature extraction and noise filtering. The guided attention together with the optimized Swish and Tanh activations improves spatial focus while detection is refined using Particle Swarm Optimization. The tests carried out in SAR datasets proved its efficiency in real-time detection of small vessels.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Novel Convolutional Neural Network and Artificial Neural Network to Enhance the Accuracy for Flaw Detection in Animal Hide
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research explores how well Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (NCNN) detect animal hide imperfections to improve quality of weather. Materials and Methods: The study extracted 3600 leather images from Kaggle and split them into two separate groups for this investigation. Group 1 used NCNN, and Group 2 used ANN. Statistical testing generated a sample size of 20 specimens at 95% confidence with 80% power in this experiment. Python became the chosen programming platform for data analysis and preprocessing. NCNN shows better results than ANN because it delivers 96.80% accuracy at 0.001 significance level (p<0.05). Conclusion: The analysis proves the Novel Convolutional Neural Network successfully finds defects in animal hides, but ANN cannot match its results.

articleTitle: Integrating Vision Transformers and Text-to-Speech System for Converting Object Detection Outputs to Audio Descriptions using AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents an integrated system that combines Vision Transformers (ViTs) for object detection with Text-to-Speech technology to create a real-time assistive tool for the visually impaired. The system exploits DETR to detect objects in a scene with very high accuracy and contextual depth, while gTTS provides natural, multilingual auditory feedback. This well-trained Vision Transformer model serves images and delivers a very detailed description of objects, such as spatial relations, which can be converted into speech in any language user prefers. Some results of evaluations from COCO show the working of the system: it achieves 90.3% for mean Average Precision (mAP) and 4.5 as Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for the speech quality. It works in real time, and on average, processes frames in 0.47 seconds, with latency of 0.8 seconds from detection to generation of feedback. Although the system is found wanting in low-light conditions and offline usability, its strengths in accuracy, accessibility, and multilingual support mark it as a transformative assistive technology.

articleTitle: Waste Detection in underwater using deep Vision Transformers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The detection of waste in underwater environments is a critical task for marine conservation, yet it poses significant challenges due to the complex and dynamic nature of these settings. Factors such as low visibility, varying light conditions, and diverse waste materials make traditional detection methods, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), less effective. To address these challenges, this research explores the application of Deep Vision Transformers (DVTs) for underwater waste detection. DVTs are particularly well-suited for this task due to their advanced features, including the ability to capture global contextual information and model long-range dependencies within an image. Unlike CNNs, which focus on local features, DVTs utilize self-attention mechanisms to effectively process and prioritize different parts of an image. This leads to robust feature extraction, which is crucial for accurately identifying waste in complex underwater environments. The Project employs techniques such as transfer learning and data augmentation to enhance the performance of DVTs on the limited datasets available for underwater imagery. Fine-tuning the model with labeled underwater images further improves detection accuracy.

articleTitle: FADA: Fourier-Augmented Dual Attention Architecture for Enhanced Contextual Awareness in Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Medical image segmentation plays a crucial role in ensuring accurate diagnosis and effective treatment strategies. This paper presents FADA, a Fourier-Augmented Dual Attention model, an advanced deep learning framework specifically designed to enhance segmentation performance in medical imaging. By integrating Fourier based transformations with dual attention mechanisms, FADA effectively captures both local and global contextual information, leading to more precise segmentation of anatomical structures. To assess its performance, FADA is compared against conventional segmentation models such as U-Net and Attention U-Net, using two widely recognized medical imaging datasets. U-Net serves as a foundational benchmark due to its established effectiveness while Attention U-Net enhances feature selection through attention mechanisms. Unlike these models, FADA leverages fourier transformations within its attention module, offering a more robust approach to capturing contextual dependencies. Experimental results demonstrate that FADA outperforms both U-Net and Attention U-Net in segmentation accuracy, while also exhibiting greater resilience to noise and improved computational efficiency. These findings highlight the potential of combining fourier analysis with dual attention to advance medical image segmentation, ultimately contributing to better clinical decision-making and treatment planning.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model For Prediction Of Solar Insolation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The rapid shift toward renewable energy will require very high accuracy predictions in solar insolation to efficiently implement solar panels in the right regions. This study presents a hybrid machine learning strategy for predicting hourly minute-scale insolation of sun radiation for any given location, unlike other common models based solely on monthly averages or daily mean values. The methodology utilizes a GRU model to predict weather parameters (temperature, humidity, pressure, etc.) for a specific time. These weather features are then fed into a Random Forest model trained on ISRO's monthly solar insolation data and weather data from OpenWeather. This framework effectively bridges the resolution gap between monthly and hourly forecasts, enabling granular insights for solar energy planning. The model is tested over Ahmedabad, India; results showed high predictability accuracy with error metrics like MAE, RMSE, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to validate the robustness of the model. This workflow allows users to estimate the solar energy potential for any city at a given time in order to aid in decisions on placing solar panels, conducting feasibility studies, and estimating energy yield. With GRU, RF, and the logical division approach combined, there is a highly efficient, computationally explainable, and scalable solution for energy planning. There is potential in expanding this hybrid framework to more cities, especially about the promotion of sustainable energy projects and smart grid management.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Image Analysis For Dermatology And Dermatopathology: Advancements And Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Emergence of Artificial Intelligence has evolved as a transformative tool for dermatology and dermatopathology, addressing significant hurdles such as high consultation costs, global dermatologist shortages, and diagnostic disparities. Therefore, this review delves into the progress that is being made in the areas related to AI applications with focus on its ability to diagnose high-resolution skin images towards better accuracy in diagnostics regarding melanoma, nevi, and inflammatory diseases. Using techniques like CNNs and deep learning, AI achieves sensitivity levels ranging from 58% to 96.1%, which is on par with human expertise. However, there are still many challenges, including dataset biases, underrepresentation of SOC, and reliance on outdated classification systems like the Fitzpatrick Skin Type (FST) scale. This paper will illustrate examples of solutions like Monk Skin Tone Scale, Fast Contrastive Unpaired Translation, (FastCUT) among others, to diminish this problem. Moreover, other ethical considerations like clarity and fairness and data confidentiality, among others, were observed. The review points toward multidisciplinary collaboration prospective clinical trials, and strict observance of regulatory compliance while dealing with AI models with great care for their trustworthiness and inclusivity. Thus, by overcoming these challenges, AI has the potential to revolutionize dermatological care with equity, accessibility, and effectiveness across diverse populations.

articleTitle: Harnessing Generative Adversarial Networks for The Proactive Prediction and Prevention of Zero Day Exploits in the Dynamic Infosec Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A zero-day exploit is an online attack using a previously unknown software or hardware weakness before its vulnerabilities can be tackled by its creators. A zero-day exploit could result in unauthorized access, information loss, and extensive financial gains. Recent works have investigated utilizing Generative Adversarial Networks in predicting and detecting zero-day exploits. In the adversarial process, the discriminator and generator refine detection. Studies conducted between 2022 and 2024 have proved the capability of such models in detecting vulnerabilities. Nevertheless, existing GAN based methods are confronted by various challenges, such as high cost, scalability issues, unstable training, and slow responsiveness to newly emerging exploit attacks, rendering real-time detection of threats less efficient. This project proposes an improved GAN architecture tackling such problems through a hybrid approach merging Conditional or Wasserstein GANs and Reinforcement Learning, Vulnerability Intelligence, Graph Neural Networks, and Autoencoders. This stabilizes training, minimizes computation overhead, and maximizes flexibility to new exploit methods. Our model, with this architecture, will be able to provide more precise detection of zero-day exploits, strengthening cybersecurity defenses beyond existing techniques. This method is designed to be adaptive and scalable so that it can provide long-term security against evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: Enhancing Learning Management Systems with Accessibility, Integrity, and Personalization Through Advanced Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nowadays, malpractice is increasing during online exams. Also, people with disabilities face many barriers when trying to attend quizzes on online platforms, as they are unable to see the questions or answer them effectively. This examination management system aims to develop a flexible platform for all students. To avoid malpractice, this system identifies unauthorized devices, such as mobiles, to prevent students from seeking answers via picture capture or Google Lens. To assist disabled students, a voice assistant helps deliver questions and recognizes sign language motions as their answers during assessments for this natural language processing is used. On the admin side, a chatbot is used to search users dynamically. Among the various technologies being utilized, image processing is achieved using Convolutional Neural Networks, and AI- driven chatbot provide personalized assistance. Blockchain technology helps keep academic records safe and secure integrity, and the Internet of Things (IOT) for real-time feedback on learner engagement. It prevents anyone from changing or tampering with these records. This makes it easy and reliable to verify student’s achievements and credentials.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning and Big Data Analytics for Personalized Medicine and Treatment Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The integration of both machine learning (ML) and big data analytics (BDA) under the philosophy of precision medicine is positively dismantling healthcare to enhance individualized/patient-specific care/treatment regimens for individuals. Using large swathes of medical information from EHRs, genomics, continuous monitoring technologies, and the like, we want to derive fine-grained patient data, forecast disease trajectory, and tailor care interventions, and hence, more effective health outcomes. The current use of ML and BDA for personalized interventions is discussed comprehensively in this paper. Specifically, the paper provides an account of the algorithms and methods for data processing, together with the system architecture concerning various types of health data. Furthermore, we outline a whole system architecture and the suggested approach in which all these technologies can fit into. We discuss how the non-quantum definitions of performance measures, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and response time, are impacted by the deployment of personalized medicine systems based on ML. These are aspects of the beginning of a strong movement of integrated healthcare delivery, specially highlighted in the study.

articleTitle: Stock Market Trend Analysis and Prediction Using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The intricacy of financial markets has made stock market prediction a difficult task. Conventional techniques often depend on historical data, technical analysis, and fundamental research; however, these methods could better capture the market dynamics impacted by several outside influences. Sentiment analysis, a subfield of natural language processing (NLP), has emerged as a practical approach for incorporating unconventional data sources, such as news articles, market reports, and social media, into stock market prediction models. This work suggests a novel method for predicting changes in the stock market by utilizing textual data sentiment analysis. The approach entails gathering and preparing textual data from several sources, applying natural language processing (NLP) techniques to extract sentiment features, and incorporating these features into machine learning models for prediction. The proposed approach's efficiency is assessed using sentiment data from news articles, social media sites, and historical stock market data. The results demonstrate that adding sentiment research to stock market projections can improve their accuracy compared to traditional methods. The study's conclusion discusses the implications of sentiment analysis in stock market prediction and the potential for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Secure File Sharing using Blockchain-Based Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: With growing concerns of data security and privacy related to digital file sharing, this research paper proposes a framework that strengthens secure file sharing across heterogeneous platforms. The solution exploits blockchain technology in combination with attribute-based encryption to protect anonymity of users and ensure data integrity. Blockchain, being a decentralized ledger, manages access without any centralized system, and the smart contracts define rules regarding file access and usage. The framework minimizes the risks associated with traditional methods by storing access permissions securely on the blockchain. Compared to the existing solutions like cloud-based encryption, End-To-End Encryption (E2EE), Attribute-Based Encryption (ABE), and Peer-To-Peer (P2P) file sharing, this approach provides better security, privacy, and reliability. This work addresses modern challenges in digital file sharing, providing a trustworthy and robust solution for secure communication.

articleTitle: Enhanced Security Through Distributed Fragmentation And Encryption For Cloud-Based Data Storage
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel cloud data security paradigm for sensitive applications, integrating Equipartition File Segmentation (EFS), a hybrid encryption scheme, and distributed storage. EFS partitions files into uniform fragments, subsequently encrypted using alternating AES and Blowfish algorithms in Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode with unique Initialization Vectors (IVs). To ensure secure key management, an RSA key pair is generated; the AES/Blowfish keys are encrypted with the RSA public key and persisted within Firebase Firestore. Notably, the private RSA key is encrypted using a user-supplied password and stored within the Firebase Database alongside the public key. Encrypted file fragments are distributed across Amazon S3 and Azure Blob Storage to enhance data availability and resilience. File reconstruction is performed by retrieving the RSA-encrypted symmetric keys and the password-encrypted private RSA key, decrypting the private key, and subsequently decrypting and reassembling the file fragments through Sequential Data Reassembly. This architecture achieves enhanced data security through robust cryptographic techniques, secure key management protocols, and distributed storage, while maintaining acceptable performance characteristics.

articleTitle: Secure And Efficient Payment Processing Using An Unique Pin-Based Transaction Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper introduces a method for secure and confidential online transactions using an intermediate bank account. The approach involves using a virtual wallet to store the user's funds and an intermediate account to act as a safeguard between the user's actual account and the merchant's account. The proposed payment system includes a PIN-based authorization system to enhance security, requiring users to provide a unique PIN to authorize transactions. Overall, this system offers a reliable way to conduct anonymous and secure online transactions.

articleTitle: NLP in Customer Care Centers to Enhance Customer Service
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Natural Language Processing is an emerging tool in call centers, significantly improving the automation possibilities and the efficiency of customer service. This study investigates a theoretical model proposed for using NLP in the automation of everyday tasks, such as data entry, information retrieval, storage of information in the form of text, call categorization, and easy call responses, which requires major human intervention. By implementing NLP, the call centers can progress along with the workflow while human errors and messiness is reduced. This will allow employees to participate in complex interactions with customers, through which some of the important customer interactions will be improved, operation speed will be increased, waiting time and errors will be reduced, and minimal human interaction will be required. Besides the automation of tasks, NLP also enables call centers to serve a more customized customer service experience. Sentiment analysis of the voice through the variables of the loudness, pitch, and tone of the spoken sound by using voice recognition, real-time language processing and semantic analysis of the words spoken by the speaker will be used to prioritize calls as per the context of the needs and demands of the customer. Some advanced text recognition functions based on NLP gather customer users’ needs and problems more precisely which gives them the instruments for faster and more empathetic responses through voice generation. This study also describes how these AI-driven solutions can help companies to improve their customer satisfaction and resource utilization in the BPO industry, thus redefining the landscapes of AI to a great degree.

articleTitle: QueryMate: An Intelligent Study Helper for Document Analysis and Interactive Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper describes, in detail, a Study Helper application based on cutting-edge NLP techniques, including transformer models such as BERT and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The application provides the capabilities of document summarization, topic-specific insights, explanations of various concepts, and generation of personalized quizzes that support the process of learning by students. By integrating vector databases, this guarantees efficient indexing and retrieval of document embeddings to allow for precise, context-aware question answering. The research introduces how the system architecture synergizes RAG with transformers and databases to support QA and summarization tasks. Additionally, the study has incorporated a spaced repetition algorithm that is novel to optimize review schedules using forgetting curves and learning patterns. It employs multimodal strategies to retain knowledge, beautifully integrating text, audio, and visual components in order to accommodate diverse learning styles. This approach reflects a scalable, intelligent academic support system.

articleTitle: Real-Time Helmet and Triple Riding Detection System with Automated Email Notifications for Enhanced Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study proposes the development of a real-time computer vision-based system for detecting motorcycle riders not wearing helmets and triple riding. The system uses the YOLO object detection algorithm to locate motorcycles, riders and helmets from surveillance footage. The system detects such violations as no helmet or more than two riders on a motorcycle, it may capture a photo or video clip and will send out automated email notifications to the concerned authorities or the registered owner of the motorcycle. This innovative approach fills in the gaps of manual monitoring by providing scalability, real time processing, and automated proof of evidence collection to further improve road safety by enforcing traffic regulations.

articleTitle: Eavesdropping Detection Technique using Differential Space Time Relativistic Quantum Key Distribution in Public Key Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Relativistic Quantum Key Distribution (RQKD) enhances secure communication by combining quantum mechanics with relativity. It uses relativistic properties, like the invariance of the speed of light, to ensure secure key exchange. Challenges may still persist and eavesdropping can still happen due to various factors including Timing manipulation, physical equipment vulnerabilities and Relativistic exploitation. To mitigate such security vulnerabilities, in this proposed eavesdropping detection work, additional parameter namely Space-Time coordinates of the sender and receiver are introduced into the Relativistic QKD. Finally, derived result shows that our proposed Space-Time Relativistic QKD (STR-QKD) can enhance the security with the additional Space-Time constraints for all systems including AI systems.

articleTitle: Detection Of Forest Fire Using YOLOv8 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The incidences of fire and smoke in forests can result in significant damage and even casualties. Many recent detection methods lack generalization because they are mainly designed to suit specific data types and scenes. In this project, a Fire and Smoke Detection System is developed for forests using YOLOv8, which is an object detection algorithm. The main objective is to achieve efficient and accurate identification of occurrences of fire and smoke in images or video files. It requires a heavy amount of data which must be prepared by collecting and annotating the images that contain fire or smoke. YOLOv8 is the model used for training the collected dataset along with specific class configurations set on the classes of interest. In addition to this core detection ability, it also includes required evaluation metrics to measure the Model performance. The evaluation of precision and robustness is done through precision, recall, and F1-score for fire and smoke detection. Finally, the project also focuses on developing a Graphical User Interface (GUI) to visualize the prediction. A user can feed in the images or video streams. GUI will show the predictions. Bounding boxes will surround the regions, detected as fire and smoke. The novelty of this work lies in the integration of YOLOv8 with a user-friendly interface for real-time visualization, enabling efficient detection and interpretation of fire and smoke occurrences in forest environments.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Performance of DeiT Model in Medical Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Effective medical intervention relies on properly distinguishing pneumonia cases through chest X-ray examination. In this study, we assess the performance of the Data-Efficient Image Transformer model for binary classification of pneumonia versus normal cases using chest X-ray images. The model was fine-tuned with different learning rates (0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1) and epochs (5, 10, 25, 50) to evaluate its effectiveness. Across various combinations, we observed peak performance at 25 epochs with a learning rate of 0.1, achieving an accuracy (90.87%), precision (91.11%), recall (90.87%), and F1-score (90.70%). The model’s Matthews Correlation Coefficient reached 80.49%, and Cohen’s kappa attained 79.95%. The study demonstrates the efficacy of the DeiT model in capturing global relationships within the image data, offering competitive results for pneumonia classification, and highlights its potential for broader application in medical image analysis tasks.

articleTitle: Enhancing ODI Cricket Score Forecasting Using AI: A Data-Driven Approach with Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cricket’s popular international (ODI) version is famous for achieving a balance between the quick thrill of Twenty20 matches and the depth of strategy of Test matches. It’s very hard to forecast the score in this game. To enhance the accuracy of prediction, we will focus on using advanced machine learning techniques to predict cricket scores in (ODI) matches. Employing techniques such as Multi-Linear Regression, The system considers 350,899 records and 15 features, such as runs, wickets, overs, striker, and non-striker, based on Random Forest Regression and a Stacked Ensemble model. With 90.76% accuracy, the Random Forest model surpassed other approaches such as Support Vector Machines and Decision Trees. Statistical performance measures such as Mean Squared Error, Root Mean Squared Error, and R-Squared were employed to ensure the performance of the system. We point out the scope for extension to other forms of cricket, such as Test and T20 matches, and to other sports disciplines, although the present results may be used for ODI matches. Cloud computing is proposed to be incorporated into future enhancements for real-time predictive analytics and big data processing.

articleTitle: A Novel Dataset and a Hybrid Ensemble Approach for Anomaly Detection in Enterprise-Access-Logs for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This work proposes a new access-log based dataset which combines real-world enterprise access logs with infused synthetic anomalies to establish a well-balanced distribution of normal and malicious activities. The dataset can be used to effectively train ML algorithms for classification of identity-based threats such as unauthorized access and privilege escalations. The dataset contains a very comprehensive and diverse set of features, which make the dataset feasible for Machine learning based implementations. The dataset has been made publicly available through Github, and will serve as a reference standard for access-logs based threat detection research in future. Further, this study also introduces an ensemble anomaly detection framework consisting of Quantum Clustering (QIC), Autoencoder, Graph Learning, Hidden Markov Model (HMM), Hyperdimensional Computing and Recurrence Quantification. Through ensemble-based approach combining the mentioned algorithms in a structured flow, the detection accuracy is found to be significantly higher when compared to traditional individual ML algorithms. The ensemble model thus built surpasses conventional ML and DL algorithms by reaching almost 90% accuracy, 94% precision, 92% recall and 93% F1-score. To sum up, this work contributes to the current pool of knowledge in this domain by adding a novel dataset, and proposing an effective ensemble approach. This work finds its applications in critical infrastructure protection and enterprise data security.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Networks-Based Machine learning for Analysis of Sub-surface Water quality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Ground water is the most important source of water for the entire world. In India, almost 65% of the water needs for various purposes are met by ground water. Improper disposal of several waste, the ground water is being contaminated includes presence of heavy metals and toxic substance. There are other certain technologies adopted to predict the quality of water. The accuracy will not be high due to several factors like climate change, Temperature change, and pollution. Machine Learning technologies can be adapted to predict the quality of water. Different Algorithms are used to train the model and the accuracy of all algorithms is then compared to check which algorithm has the highest accuracy to predict the quality of the water.

articleTitle: Development of Ensemble Learning Algorithms for Pulmonary Disease Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The rising global cases of pulmonary diseases require new diagnostic methods beyond traditional techniques because they depend on subjective human analysis which proves inefficient to the healthcare system. This research solves these problems through a sophisticated ensemble learning model which unites CNNs with multimodal clinical information to boost disease recognition and identification capabilities. The method applies hierarchical extraction to both medical imaging features and structured clinical variables thus enabling the system to detect complex patterns linked to different pulmonary conditions. The framework addresses biases and improves its ability to work with different patient data through a dense neural network classifier which consolidates collected features. This research addresses major deficiencies in current methods because imaging and non-imaging data integration does not exist effectively while presenting a solution to unify these data types. Experimental results demonstrate significant potential for improving diagnostic accuracy, reducing false positives, and enabling scalable clinical decision support systems, ultimately enhancing patient outcomes and optimizing resource utilization in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Parkinson’s disease Diagnosis: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a progressive brain degeneration disorder that highly influences the lives of patients, hence detection at early stages becomes the utmost necessity. The current research article develops the ML pipeline for the classification of prediction with a patient dataset using vocal characteristic. We have implemented SVM algorithm, Random Forest, and KNN algorithms, and optimized model performance applying hyperparameter optimization and k-fold cross-validation. Results reported that the optimal SVM model yielded the maximum accuracy, indicating the possibility of an earlier diagnosis in clinical practice. This study focuses on the utilization of ML to make the invasive methods of diagnosis more effective for Parkinson's disease prediction and thus provides directions for future work.

articleTitle: Transforming Circular Economy Models Through Data Analytics:A Predictive and Real Time Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The shift towards circular economy seeks to improve resource utilization, decrease pollution, and protect the environment by changing the traditional economy of ‘take-make-dispose’ to a closed looping system. A circular economy focuses on the continuous use of materials through recycling or regeneration to avoid resource exhaustion and waste generation. However, there are barriers to scaling up resource recovery including mapping out material flows, waste streams and other resources. This article discusses the role of data analytics tools enabled by IoT devices, sensors, and machine learning, in bridging the gap between traditional economy and circular economy. Life cycle analysis of products and material is carried out, so that ideal recovery points can be set, using models such as Random Forests and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The proposed framework connects data from IoT systems with industrial reports and waste management procedures providing accurate resource, waste and recycling management, and other operational related decision processes. This ultimately contributes to the goal of sustainability.

articleTitle: Automated Glaucoma Detection Using Vision Transformers and Capsule Networks: A Deep Learning Approach for Early Diagnosis from Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: It is well known that glaucoma leads not only to visual impairment but also to total blindness, making its diagnosis very important in preserving the vision of affected patients. In this work, we offer a fully automated system employing Retinal fundus-based deep learning for glaucoma diagnosis where Vision Transformers and Capsule Networks are used in deep learning architectures. Suitable algorithms for upgrading the photo and enhancing the performance of the model are performed on the images, including plotting, histogram equalization, and normalization. The RIM-ONE dataset was achieved with a categorical cross-entropy loss and Adam Optimizer with 93% accuracy on the model. Grad-CAM is utilized to make the model explainable for the images and pinpoint the specific regions of images, which are responsible for the obtained predictions. The accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of the image are some of the performance evaluation criteria used. The aim of this approach is to devise a reliable and explainable solution for glaucoma primary diagnosis in a timely manner that would assist clinicians and advance the patient’s care.

articleTitle: Resilient Hybrid Energy System with Adaptive Control for Motor Energy Recovery
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The paper discusses a Resilient Hybrid Energy System (RHES) that combines solar panels, fuel cells, and supercapacitors to improve energy recovery in motors. It uses a fuzzy logic controller for better energy management and includes a bi-directional converter to capture energy during braking, which helps save power. The system adjusts in real-time to different load demands and aims for improved power factor correction, promoting sustainability and stability in the electrical grid. Testing shows that this system enhances power efficiency and is well-suited for electric vehicles and renewable energy setups. Additionally, the project includes simulations of a Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) using MATLAB Simulink to study its performance under various conditions, showcasing its potential for zero-emission energy applications.

articleTitle: Optimized Hyperspectral Crop Classification using Coot Bird Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Hyperspectral remote sensing (HSRS), also known as imaging spectroscopy, is a cutting-edge method for capturing spectral data across numerous spatial locations in a wide array of narrow spectral wavelengths, enabling the generation of detailed and coherent images. HSRS involves collecting digital images across contiguous spectral bands, spanning the visible, Near Infrared (NIR), Thermal Infrared (TIR), and MidInfrared (MIR) regions of the electromagnetic spectrum. For agricultural applications, remote sensing techniques facilitate continuous and quantitative monitoring, providing crucial physical and chemical information about vegetation. This study introduces the Agricultural Crop Classification using Coot Bird Optimization with EntropyBased Feature Fusion (ACC-CBOEFF) technique for hyperspectral imagery (HSI). The ACC-CBOEFF approach leverages feature fusion and parameter tuning to classify various crop types effectively. It incorporates Gabor filtering as a preprocessing step and employs entropy-based feature fusion using ShuffleNet, EfficientNet, and DenseNet models for robust feature extraction. Additionally, the Deep Variational Autoencoder (DVAE) system is utilized for crop type classification, with the Coot Bird Optimization (CBO) method optimizing DVAE hyperparameters. Simulations on benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance of the ACC-CBOEFF technique compared to other state-of-theart methods

articleTitle: Advancing Digital Libraries through Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality: A Comprehensive Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This electronic document is a "live" template and already defines the components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] in its style sheet. Libraries digitizing has changed the academic world and created free knowledge everywhere. Nevertheless, traditional digital libraries have engagement, interactivity, and accessibility restrictions. VR and AR technologies are about to tackle this issue, delivering an immersive and engaging experience to users. Drawing upon literature from many sources, this paper looks at the potential for AR and VR to bring about positive change to the space of the academic library, outlining implementations and applications as well as ways to measure impacts. It summarises of comparative studies of AR/VR improved libraries and conventional systems, list down case studies of real-world implementation, and also discusses the challenges and solutions put forth to them. This becomes a discussion that lays a path for world adoption, a path seen globally that details how the library will be relevant and grow and become a womb of innovative creation and collaboration.

articleTitle: Comparison of CNN Models Using Transfer Learning and an Ensemble Approach for Plant Species Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Classifying plant species is an important part of environmental monitoring, biodiversity preservation, and forestry management. However, manually inspecting every plant could be laborious and time-consuming. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have shown incredible promise for this problem. The goal of this project is to employ artificial intelligence and machine learning to address this problem. Using transfer learning, we evaluate how well several pretrained CNN models perform in classifying tree species from the pl@nt300k dataset. The classification accuracy, computational efficiency, and flexibility of models like EfficientNetb0, ResNet50, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, and Xception are assessed using a dataset with 24050 photos, with EfficientNetb0 achieving the best accuracy of 90.94% out of all the pretrained model. Furthermore, we provide two ensemble approach using soft voting and weighted average model, achieving an accuracy of 96% and 95% respectively. Results show that the proposed ensemble model provides a more effective classification model for the identification of plant species. We have also discussed the architecture of the hybrid model and how it benefits the classification process, which could be of help in further research to create more effective, flexible and scalable models.

articleTitle: Context-Aware Sentiment Analysis for Enhanced Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The extensive use of social networking sites has transformed how people share and consume information, but it has also made it easier for fake news to proliferate quickly, endangering social stability and public confidence. This study presents an innovative framework for detecting fake news by integrating context-aware sentiment analysis with advanced machine learning techniques. The approach uses contextual embeddings and sentiment polarity scores to identify news stories as either real or false, utilizing the Indian Fake News Dataset. The effectiveness of several machine learning and deep learning models, such as Decision Trees, Gradient Boosting, BERT, BART, and Logistic Regression, in identifying false news was assessed. Among these, deep learning models, particularly BERT, achieved the highest accuracy at 92%, significantly outperforming traditional models such as Logistic Regression (75%) and Gradient Boosting (85%). The findings emphasize the effectiveness of combining context-aware sentiment analysis with state-of-the-art deep learning models, positioning BERT as a robust and scalable tool for combating misinformation in real-time digital ecosystems.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Optimization of Cloud Data Centers: Enhancing Reliability and Cost Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The existing Internet and Cloud computing services have fuelled the need for data center accommodation that should perform reliably, at a fast-growing rate and with elasticity. Conventional optimization approaches fail to meet all these objectives at once, particularly as far as cost, energy, as well as reliability are concerned in dynamic cloud contexts. AI is changing cloud data centers in terms of its allotment of resources, maintenance, and energy management on the cloud. The following paper aims to discuss the potential of AI solutions for the advancement of reliability and cost-effectiveness of cloud systems. Self-controlled cooling systems enhance energy use, which is a huge saving for operations costs. Also, with the help of AI, one can predict possible security threats and prevent their occurrence at an early stage. There are benefits of implementing an intelligent cloud system in data centers that include cost-effectiveness, low emission of carbon, and high service availability. Consequently, this paper presents an overview of the AI frameworks, their applications, and the issues they encounter during their application. It is important to talk about the trend in the development of AI for automation in the near future and directions for further studies as well.

articleTitle: Ground Water Quality Analysis with Real-Time Data Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: For the entire world Ground water is considered as the predominant source of water used for various purposes. As far as India is concerned 65% of its needs are satisfied by ground water. But it is polluted with improper disposal of solid and liquid substances which leads to the presence of heavy metals and noxious elements. Several technologies are used to envisage water quality. With respect to change in climate factor, change in temperature, heavy contamination the accuracy would not attain high. Hence it is decided to adopt Machine learning technique in order to predict standard of water quality. Different Algorithms are used to train the model and the accuracy of all algorithms is then compared to check which algorithm has the highest accuracy to predict the quality of the water.

articleTitle: From Sensors to Solutions: A Survey on IoT and Machine Learning in Modern Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, the convergence of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms has paved the way for precision agriculture. By leveraging IoT sensors and real-time data analysis through ML algorithms, farming practices can be optimized for water usage, soil health, crop prediction, and pest control. This survey explores various IoT devices used in agriculture, the integration of ML models, and presents a comparative analysis for different scenarios. Finally, we provide recommendations for the most optimal configurations in various agricultural settings.

articleTitle: Satellite Image Chronology Prediction for Sequence Modeling
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
