abstract: Satellite imagery is an important tool in understanding temporal changes in Earth's surface. The chronological sequence of satellite images is very helpful for applications like disaster management, climate monitoring, and urban planning. This paper proposes a novel methodology for the chronology prediction of satellite images using a deep learning model called ConvLSTM. This proposed framework incorporates preprocessing techniques such as resizing, normalization, and grayscale conversion of the satellite imagery in preparation for the temporal sequence model. The model ConvLSTM2D has been designed for efficient capture of spatiotemporal features, and other evaluation metrics, such as SSIM, PSNR, MSE, and RMSE, have been used for robust performance assessment. Other exploration is made by using the U-Net, and Convolutional Autoencoder models to improve prediction accuracy and reconstruction of high-quality images. The experimental results illustrate the efficiency of the ConvLSTM model by showing better performance in predicting high-fidelity sequences of images. This work forms a benchmark to utilize deep learning techniques for predicting satellite image chronology and presents pathways for further research in Earth observation technologies.

articleTitle: Incorporating Real-World Factors into an Advanced Cost Model for Personalized Path Planning in Multi-Vehicle Autonomous Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Navigation of autonomous self-driving cars in dynamic environments needs to consider real-world constraints as well as the preference of users. This research presents an enhanced cost model for individual path planning in multi-vehicle autonomous system involving traffic, types of roadway, weather, pollution, accessibility, dead zones, events, construction zones, fuel efficiency, safety and scenic beauty and cost. Through associating these factors with user specified preferences, the direction of the proposed Adaptive Personalized Path Planning Framework (APPPF) is such that it allows for the dynamic adjustment of an associated personalized cost function P(s). The total cost function F(s) = G(s) + H(s) + P(s), together with accumulated, heuristic, and personalized costs is assessed with an efficient path search algorithm to identify the best paths. Studies show that the proposed approach improves path adaptability, safety, and user satisfaction levels, thanks to simulations. In this work, a feasible and practical solution is proposed for addressing the multi-vehicle autonomous systems problem to enable intelligent and user-centric mobility solutions.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Satellite Image Cloud Classification with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Advancements in remote sensing (RS) have greatly increased the availability of satellite imagery, enabling diverse applications. However, cloud-cover remains a significant challenge, obstructing the acquisition and analysis of optical satellite images. This necessitates advanced cloud classification techniques as a crucial preprocessing step. The proposed MobileNetV2-based convolutional neural network architecture demonstrates unprecedented cloud classification capabilities, effectively processing imagery across diverse spatial resolutions ranging from 10 to 56 meters. By leveraging sophisticated machine learning algorithms, the model transcends traditional pixel-based thresholding techniques, capturing complex inter-pixel spatial correlations with remarkable precision. Experimental validation across heterogeneous datasets including IRS (AWiFS, LISS-III), Landsat, and Sentinel platforms reveals exceptional performance metrics, consistently achieving classification accuracies exceeding 99.94%.

articleTitle: Smart Stitch: A Mobile App for Personalized Garment Customization and Stitching Guidance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Smart Stitch is an innovative mobile app aimed at easily facilitating both beginners and experts in garment making. Integrating real-time 3D visualization, dynamic simulation of fabrics, and interactive stitching guides, this app allows the user to enter his measurements and visualize customized garments with utmost accuracy. The users have to choose the designs from Kurtis, Anarkali, and blouses while uploading fabric images to see realistic previews of how the chosen materials and patterns will appear on the selected garments. A further advantage of Smart Stitch is step-wise animated sewing instructions and the estimation of materials required for the garment along with costs determined through its estimation tool. The back end of the app engages modern technology such as Three.js, WebGL, and Blender, for real-time rendering, and Python for fabric optimization and cost computation. Future improvements entail the integration of AI-based fabric suggestions, as well as augmented reality for virtual try-ons of garments. Smart Stitch wants to transform the way one does garment creation at home: quickly producing personally tailored, well-fitted garments with ease and accurately fitting pieces.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Autonomous Remote Access and Scheduling System to High-Performance Computing Resources
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative AI-driven system for managing and facilitating remote access to High Performance Computing (HPC) resources. Leveraging the Django framework and cutting-edge machine learning models, the system addresses critical challenges prevalent in academic HPC environments: inefficient resource allocation, prolonged access approval delays, and a lack of user-friendly management interfaces. The proposed system’s key component include an AI-powered Lab Manager (ALM) that automates the request review process, significantly reducing approval times. Additionally, a computer-specific chatbot, developed using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-base model from Hugging Face, assists users with common queries and troubleshooting. The chatbot, trained on a custom dataset of 600 question-answer pairs, achieved an F1 score of 98.1% and an average loss of 0.135. The implementation features a user-friendly interface providing real-time access to available computing resources, instant booking capabilities, and personalized support through the AI-driven chatbot and WhatsApp integration. After implementing comprehensive security measures, the system integrates with AnyDesk for direct timely access, and it can be readily adapted to work with other remote access tools to secure and manage access effectively. For administrators, the backend system offers comprehensive resource management tools, enabling data-driven decision-making for optimized resource allocation based on specific project requirements. This innovative system significantly enhances productivity, and effective utilization of resources, and advances the mission of fostering impactful research, ultimately benefiting students, faculty, and the broader academic community.

articleTitle: Virtual Disaster Management Systems for Real-Time Response and Aid
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This review paper examines the current status of web-enabled disaster management programs that combine Artificial Intelligence with Internet of Things and Geographic Information Systems. The system focuses on developing better situational awareness and decision capabilities to resolve issues stemming from information overload as well as data quality and resource limitations in low-income areas. An AI-based cloud platform will combine swift information from multiple resources to optimize disaster services through real-time data processing. This platform enables effortless data management while enabling seamless collaboration among agencies in various emergency situations. At the same time, it supports easy processing and data compatibility for different requirements. The system operates to minimize data silos and boost operational speed and unite efforts in disaster management particularly for neglected communities. The framework delivered through this research establishes new foundations to improve emergency preparedness and response through enhanced resilience attributes and multilevel scalability and interoperable functionality.

articleTitle: Cognitive Large Language Model in Social Media with Local Memory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Enter the era of social media reimagined! This research taps into an interesting combination of advanced Artificial Intelligence, with large language models such as ChatGPT and GEMINI your favorite social platform. Personal information of each user is armed with voice commands and LLM. But this is the first. When it comes to security. We got you covered Choose between playing low key or just sharing just the right number of juicy details. Plus, all the classic features It's still fun, like scrolls and scrolls.

articleTitle: GeoRescue Drone
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Earthquakes, landslides, and floods are natural disaster induced catastrophes resulting in victim detection delay and greater casualties. The traditional rescue processes like manual digging,thermal imaging, and sonar scanning fail tolocate buried survivors under the rubble. In response to this, an Artificial Intelligence-based Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) with Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), GeoRescue Drone, is introduced to scan subsurface in real-time to identify buried victims accurately and minimize rescue time. The drone emits high-frequency electromagnetic waves, sweeps reflected waves, and distinguishes human bodies from other objects with a machine learning-based classifier. GPS navigation and AI-driven autonomous flight offer high coverage with low human intervention.Performance testing shows 92.8% detection rate, 90.5% precision, and 1.2 seconds response time per sweep. Future plans involve multi-sensor fusion, onboard LiDAR, and optimized AI-driven signal processing for enhanced accuracy.

articleTitle: Advanced Natural Language Processing for Personalized Voice Assistant Experiences
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This project pioneers a groundbreaking voice-controlled interface poised to revolutionize personal computing. By harnessing advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and voice recognition technologies, it aims to streamline user interaction across a plethora of tasks, including launching applications, file conversion, online content sharing, and WhatsApp messaging. Central to its innovation is a sophisticated voice recognition module empowered by state-ofthe-art NLP algorithms. This module is meticulously trained to comprehend and execute user commands in natural language swiftly and accurately, catering to diverse demographics and ensuring a universally accessible computing experience. Integration with WhatsApp enables hands-free messaging, prioritizing user privacy and ensuring compatibility across platforms. This initiative underscores the transformative impact of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and voice recognition technologies in reshaping digital interaction paradigms. Through iterative refinement and user-centered design, the project strives to establish a new standard for efficiency and accessibility in personal computing. By emphasizing privacy, data security, and cross-platform support, it aims to delivera consistent and safe user experience across diverse devices and operatingsystems. Ultimately, this endeavor represents a significant leap forward in voice-controlled computing, promising a future where technology seamlessly adapts to meet the evolving needs and preferences of users.

articleTitle: Soil Fertility Assessment and Crop Recommendation Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Balancing the soil fertility is the crucial for sustainable agriculture since it helps maximize crop yields. The research adopts Machine Learning (ML) to construct a recommendation system for soil fertility and crop selection which examines soil nutrient changes preceding and following cultivation. Through forecasting soil fertility reduction the system provides crop waste recommendations for fertilization improvement. The system offers recommendations regarding suitable crops for the upcoming harvest cycle when using waste residues and when excluding waste residue use. The model receives training from authentic soil and crop data through Random Forest Regression and Classification methods. Through an application designed with Flask the system presents an interactive graphical user interface that enables farmers to quickly obtain recommendation outcomes by supplying soil parameters. Recovering the organic waste and facilitating precision agriculture through its operational framework, this technology increases the resource efficiency. Soil sustainability receives improvement through this method which simultaneously increases agricultural production and reduces chemical fertilizer dependence.

Author Keywords: The research incorporates keywords which include Soil Fertility and Crop Recommendation and Machine Learning and Precision Farming as well as Agricultural Sustainability and Crop Waste Utilization and Nutrient Management and Random Forest and Flask Web Application

articleTitle: Soil Texture Classification And Ideal Cocopeat Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Efficient use of water in farming is crucial, especially in areas with limited water supply. This study introduces a new method to classify soil surface texture and recommend the right amount of Cocopeat using Red Green Blue (RGB) images. This approach provides a cheaper and simpler alternative to traditional methods. However, determining the right amount of Cocopeat needed for different soils and environmental conditions is still a challenge. These findings show that RGB images can effectively identify soil texture, allowing accurate classification and personalized Cocopeat recommendations. This helps improve crop growth and soil health. The method is scalable, non-invasive and allows quick data collection using drones or satellites, making it suitable for large-scale use.

articleTitle: SDIRTCC: Secure duplicate Identification and removal from textual data in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the world day by day textual information size is increased exponential and in particular, vision, analysis and interpretation of language force a challenge of management of data, in a big storage with heavy storage space. In order to minimize data size eliminate duplicate is one of the way to follow and duplicate types are also forces security problems. In this research a new method secure duplicate packet and elimination from textual dataset in a cloud computing (SDIRTCC). It is working in hybrid model by combining eliminate duplication from user side and as well as from server side to get good rate of compression and provided full security to data. SDIRTCC is small techniques preprocess data at user side to identify and eliminate duplicate entries and this is well suitable method for devices like IoT working under constraints, and also designed to protect from side channel attack. Touchdown(TD) dataset is used to conduct experiment. It consists of running the written by peoples. SDIRTCC shows 72% of compression rate that in turn shows the impact of duplicate data present in the dataset, and reduced TD dataset occupies less storage when compared with original TD dataset. Finally, reducing dataset size demands less storage space in cloud, saved lot of space in cloud, easy to maintain security, and enhanced efficiency and management of big data in cloud computing.

articleTitle: A Multi-modal System using Eye Blink detection and OTP Generation for User Authentication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Conventional CAPTCHA systems are becoming susceptible to advanced automated bots; hence, their effectiveness towards securing online platforms is lost, but the user experience becomes compromised. To address this challenge, in this research a robust multi-modal CAPTCHA system that incorporates face recognition, blink detection, and OTP verification. The face recognition module is the first authenticating layer in which the facial features are captured using a webcam in real-time then it is moved to the next authenticating layer blink detection, where biometric data are used to confirm human interaction through involuntary eye movements like blinking. Then it moves on to the final layer which is a one-time password where after the confirmation of eye-blinking the OTP is sent to the registered user device so that authentication can only be completed by a legitimate user. This proposed multi-modal captcha system shows higher accuracy than other state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: IoT Based Contactless Switch Using Gesture Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the need to reduce physical contact with shared surfaces, particularly in public spaces. Traditional switches for controlling lights and appliances posed a health risk, as they could easily transmit infections through frequent touch. Addressing this challenge, a gesture-based control system was developed to operate electrical devices without physical contact. The system uses a laptop camera to detect hand movements, leveraging a hand-tracking module to recognize specific gestures. These gestures are mapped to control a hardware setup that includes a 4-channel relay module connected to low-voltage DC bulbs, simulating common household devices such as lights and fans. The aim is to provide a hygienic, user-friendly solution that enhances safety in shared environments by eliminating the need for physical switches. By integrating image processing with IoT capabilities, this system allows for contactless control of devices using simple hand gestures, reducing the potential for surface-based contamination. Performance evaluations demonstrated accurate gesture detection in controlling the devices, indicating the system’s effectiveness as a practical tool for safe, contact-free interaction in public spaces.

articleTitle: Estimating the Box Office Success through Machine learning and Sentiment Analysis of Movie Feedback
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The machine learning framework integrated with sentiment analysis, which uses data from social media sources to predict box office revenue and audience response. Real time data from Application programming interfaces such as Twitter and Instagram are gathered, filtered to exclude useless data, then subjected to sentiment analysis using the VADER and TextBlob libraries. The Random Forest and Linear Regression algorithms are applied to determine sentiment trends and box office revenue with relative maximum values of accuracy. The system illustrates various aspects of the sentiment which include the distribution of the sentiment, the density of the selected keywords, and the analysis of the trends with time. In this piece, it underlines the need to mix audience response data with other styles of modeling for a richer viewing of movie success. The features that can be added in future are real-time sentiment analysis, Deep Learning models to enhance the predictive nature of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Traffic Density Detection And Signal Optimization Using YOLOv5 And ANT Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Urban traffic jam leads to delays, wastage of fuel and air pollution, and fixed-time traffic signals do not react to real-time scenarios. The findings of this study recommend detection of cars using YOLOv5, regression methods for finding the optimum duration of green light, and reinforcement learning (DQN) for making adaptive signal control decisions. Traffic flow prediction is improved by LSTM models. Performance is quantified in the form of vehicle clearance rate, waiting time reduction, and traffic flow rate. Experiments show that the adaptive system outperforms standard fixed-timing methods greatly, with YOLOv5 detection being 60% accurate, DQN lowering waiting times by 37.2%, vehicle clearance rates increasing by 42.8% during rush hours, and carbon emissions lowering by 27.4%, hence a scalable model for smart cities.

articleTitle: 3D Finger Vein And Iris Pattern Based Verification System Using Photo Acoustic Tomography
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: When it comes to biometrics, the finger vein modality is crucial because of its unique properties. However, there are two problems with the current vein verification systems: first, they only capture a 2D image of the vein and iris from one side of the finger using a monocular camera. While operating in contact-free mode, it gathers minimal information on vein patterns for validation purposes and produces discernible differences in results when samples of the same person are taken from various locations on the iris and finger veins. The efficiency of the system is negatively affected by both of these problems. Current systems tend to be more attuned to variances in iris and finger vein location especially those caused by pitch and roll changes. A lot of work has gone into trying to fix this problem in recent years, but it's still not easy. An innovative software and hardware platform is presented in this paper for collecting full-view vein and iris pattern information from whole fingers and iris using three cameras. Then, a full-view 3D image of the finger veins and iris is built using a novel 3D reconstruction method. The system is completed with a corresponding 3D feature of the finger veins and iris. The experimental results show that the new method not only improves recognition performance compared to the traditional single-view 2D method of finger vein recognition, but it also fully utilizes the extra valid information provided by iris and finger vein biometrics.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiovascular Disease Prediction: Stacked Ensemble Models with XGBoost, Neural Networks, and Generative AI Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: cardiovascular disease hence makes a sizable portion of global mortality, further calling for ideal and timely prediction measures. The comparison of four machine learning models, namely, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Networks for cardiovascular disease prediction is done in this work. Therefore, to improve the prediction accuracy still further, the present study advocated the use of a new Stacking Model as the augmented learner through Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms. When compared with individual models, the accuracy of the Stacking Model is extraordinary is 90.00% higher than other baselines including Logistic Regression (72.36%), Random Forest (71.41%), XGBoost (73.57%), and Neural Networks (73.18). Within the system setting, there is a Generative AI chatbot where users can ask questions about the predictions and factors behind them. Moreover, a user-oriented feature implemented via an SMTP based Email Notification Service means timely alerting of severe predictions and/or changes. The combination of machine learning, Generative AI, and email notification shows how more prompt and efficient, easy to use diagnostic tools can be created for the future with appeal to personalized health solutions.

articleTitle: Blockchain: Development of New Cloud Repository Model using Federated Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The advancement of IoT are widely used in Medical sector, merging IoT with medical domain and introduced IoMT, it provides new challenging task to provide integrity and security, controlling and managing and predicting data that is gathered through IoMT. In his paper proposed a new security cloud storage model by combining features of block chain technology and federated learning. In order to provide security proposed model gathers medical data using IoT, collected data is encoded using attribute encryption method (AEM) using a key Hybrid Energy Optimizer (HEO) method, with permission encoded data stored in a block chain, and predicts IoMT data from threats. Security using federated learning methods like GRU and BiLSTM are combined to improve prediction accuracy and patient are predicted from various types of disease. In his model patients data trained using DL methods, and privacy is maintained using collaborative methods. From experiments we come to know that our methods shows more accuracy they traditional methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Privacy in Health IoT Using Fog Computing with Proxy Re-Encryption and Modified Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT)-based cloud system has various obstacles, including confidentiality, vulnerabilities in centralized operations, difficulties in managing IoT devices, and vulnerability to malicious assaults. Secure and reliable transmission of Electronic Health Records (EHRs) between healthcare and cloud IoT is critical. IoT-enabled healthcare equipment, which has been increasingly adopted by hospitals, presents significant security risks. However, medical organizations fail to address this risk leading to possible threats to encryption and authentication of healthcare IoT devices. This paper introduces a novel framework, the Proxy Re-Encryption-Modified Whale Optimization Algorithm (PRE-MWOA), designed to improve security of Health IoT networks through Fog Computing. By combining Proxy Re-Encryption (PR) with MWOA, the framework ensures that sensitive data remains protected while allowing for intelligent task distribution and robust anomaly detection. The decryption of results occurs only at the final stage, ensuring that data remains secure throughout the computational process. Experimental results indicate that the PRE-MSSA framework significantly enhance both data security and energy consumption compared to traditional state-of-art solutions.

articleTitle: Anti-Remote Disk Imaging: A Comprehensive Approach to Prevent Unauthorized Data Access
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Remote disk imaging is an emerging cybersecurity risk that compromises sensitive information integrity. Malicious actors exploit legitimate tools like dd and Clonezilla to clone and exfiltrate data remotely. This paper introduces a novel anti-remote disk imaging system that integrates process monitoring, dynamic firewall configurations, and full-disk encryption to mitigate unauthorized disk access. Unlike existing singular approaches, our unified solution offers real-time detection, prevention, and administrative alerts. Comparative analyses reveal that our tool outperforms existing techniques with a 92% effectiveness rate and an average response time of 3 seconds while maintaining low resource usage. These results highlight its practicality for safeguarding critical systems in resource-constrained environments. Remote disk imaging poses challenges such as real-time detection, resource constraints, and distinguishing between legitimate and malicious activities. Existing techniques, like full-disk encryption and firewall-based blocking, face limitations in adaptability and performance. This paper introduces a comprehensive system that addresses these challenges by integrating process monitoring, dynamic firewall configurations, and encryption to prevent unauthorized disk imaging.

articleTitle: Ethics of AI Technology Interruption and Discomfort on Employee Turnover
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: AI and robots provide significant potential for human growth in the near future. These systems have prompted issues regarding their purpose, long-term hazards, and appropriate use. They question the assumption that humans are the only intelligent and dominating species on Earth.AI holds enormous promise for economic development, social advancement, human well-being, and safety enhancements. AI-based expertise offers significant risks to handlers, designers and humanity due to data biases, safety, confidentiality, and ethical problems. This article concentrated on ethical difficulties that occur with AI structures as objects, i.e., tools shaped and hand-me-down by people. It covers anxieties about confidentiality and management and prejudice, human-robot collaboration, engagement, and the impact of individuality. When artificial intelligence expertise erodes employees' expertise, and they are more likely to leave. Artificial intelligence technology is commonly employed in different service sectors, such as cookery, guest rooms, and advertising. Virtual aides have been placed in selling the goods and services to respond rapidly to visitors' requests. Problems relating to upcoming artificial intelligence technology have received more attention in the media . AI may improve sales processes by increasing efficiency, customization, and predictive insights.

articleTitle: Predictive modeling of carbon intensity with Environmental impact analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The project focuses on analyzing and predicting carbon intensity, which measures the environmental impact of electricity generation in terms of carbon emissions in grams of CO2 per kilowatt-hour. Using data from the UK Carbon Intensity API [14], the system tracks real-time carbon intensity and detects unusual spikes or drops, i.e., anomalies. It uses models like linear regression and random forests to predict future carbon intensity and checks for accuracy, achieving an R2 score of 0.9868 using dynamic thresholding. The project also calculates an environmental impact score, showing how environment-friendly the electricity generation is, and gives recommendations to reduce emissions based on the severity of the score, those recommendations are termed as pathways. It updates the data and graphs live every minute, making it a useful tool for monitoring carbon emissions and promoting sustainable practices over time. To enable real-time exploration, the project has integrated a dashboard in the Panel framework and hvPlot for plotting. Panel is used for creating an interactive UI and hvPlot for plotting. All the live outputs and results, including Environmental Impact Score, pathways, trend analysis graph, anomaly detection, etc., will be displayed in real-time.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnosis of Spine Pathologies using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Diagnosis of spine diseases can be a problem in terms of inaccuracy and speed with manual approaches. This work is going to introduce the classification of spine problems-such as Scoliosis and Spondylolisthesis-by using an automated technique that includes deep Convolutional Neural Networks working over medical images. This approach will feed images through augmentation, normalization, and scale all images evenly before extracting as much relevant information as possible from the image using CNN. It has achieved this model by training and evaluating on labelled datasets to perform well in terms of accuracy. Future work will involve integrating the models in a clinical context to extend the set of conditions that can be detected.

articleTitle: Explosion Risk Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Explosion Risk Detection System is a cutting-edge solution designed to mitigate the risk of explosions in hazardous environments. This advanced system integrates multiple sensors, including gas detectors, temperature, and pressure sensors, to detect potential explosion risks in real-time. By leveraging wireless sensor network technology with GSM and Zigbee capabilities, the system enables prompt alerts to nearby personnel and transmits critical data to management authorities, facilitating swift response and evacuation. The system's multi-sensor approach provides comprehensive monitoring of environmental conditions, allowing for early detection of potential explosion risks. Real-time data analysis and machine learning algorithms enable the system to identify patterns and anomalies, ensuring accurate and reliable risk assessments. With its advanced notification system, the Explosion Risk Detection System minimizes the risk of explosions, protecting lives and preventing damage to equipment and infrastructure. By providing a proactive and reliable explosion risk detection solution, this system significantly enhances safety and efficiency in industries prone to explosion hazards, such as oil and gas, chemical processing, and mining.

articleTitle: Dynamic Website Authentication Using Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) for Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, the proliferation of fake websites poses significant threats to user security, trust, and data integrity. This paper presents a novel solution to address this issue through the implementation of a dynamic website authentication system using Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) verification. The system allows websites to register securely with a central authentication server, generating unique TOTP codes that users can verify to determine the authenticity of the website. Website owners are issued a secret key upon registration, which is used to generate TOTP codes that refresh every 30 seconds. This project emphasizes user-friendly verification mechanisms and secure key management to protect users from phishing attacks. The system architecture, implementation, and potential applications are discussed, along with future directions for integrating multi-factor authentication and expanding security features.

articleTitle: A Review of Generative AI in Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Traditional machine learning algorithms have paved the way for more sophisticated models mainly in the field of Gen AI. This review compares how Gen AI is used in recommendation systems to traditional AI methods and the application of both in various fields. Generative AI has transformed the systems for recommendation by correcting the flaws of conventional machine learning approaches. This review compares the use of Gen AI and conventional AI in RS throughout various fields, with a focus on GANs and VAEs. These generative models indicate their capabilities and challenges involving low data, cold start, and lack of diversity in recommendations. They also show potential limitations for further research. The report outlines recent works to represent how Gen AI enhances RS performance traces key trends, and addresses relevant emerging concerns with reliability and ethics. The results highlight hybrid approaches, promising further developments of the effective and flexible RSs. To conclude, the paper advocates for further research to be performed.

articleTitle: Advancing Data Heterogeneity Solutions in Blockchain-Enabled Federated Learning for IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) offers a collaborative approach to training machine learning models across distributed devices without compromising user privacy. However, a persistent hurdle in its implementation is data heterogeneity— the uneven and diverse data distributions across participating devices—which becomes particularly challenging in Internet of Things (IoT) networks. By combining FL with blockchain, researchers have introduced decentralized, secure, and transparent methods to tackle these issues, yet several gaps and difficulties remain. This paper takes a fresh approach by compiling and analyzing the wide array of proposed solutions and ongoing challenges for managing data heterogeneity in blockchain-integrated FL systems, focusing on their relevance to IoT. We discuss techniques which seem feasible: personalization federated learning through group clustering of devices; adaptive aggregation methods; and blockchain-based reputation systems. In addition, they are mechanism-like reward-based participation and context-aware frameworks, to combat imbalance and thereby enhance fairness in heterogeneous systems. There are still unaddressed issues, including scalability, size of FL networks in blockchain, efficiency versus performance trade-offs, and, above all, the challenge of ensuring that heterogeneous systems can interoperate. By presenting an interconnected review of advances and bottlenecks, the current work is able to inform future developments of resilient and scalable FL systems for IoT applications.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics and the Role of AI-Powered Robo-Advisers in Modern Banking Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The paper tries to analyze a study on how AI-powered robo-advisers are changing the face of banking in the modern world with the potential democratization of financial services by giving more personalized, efficient, and cost-effective solutions. Based on predictive analytics and machine learning, this study will look at some important factors that can influence customer readiness, adoption, and performance of robo-advisors. Respondents in this survey are very diverse and are administered with the help of a structured questionnaire. The data is then analyzed using advanced techniques, including decision trees, clustering, and regression. The key findings underline the main drivers of adoption as digital literacy, trust in AI, cost, and personalization, while the main barriers identified include privacy concerns, lack of trust, and usability challenges. Hierarchical clustering provided insights that clear customer groups with different concerns could be distinguished, rendering banks actionable strategies to address these barriers. This research has shown the improvement in customer education, building of trust, and cost-effectiveness as the main accelerators to increase the adoption of robo-advisers. These findings add to the burgeoning literature on AI in banking and inform future research directions.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning and Data Analytics Approach to Patient Risk Stratification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a robust machine learning (ML) and data analytic solution for risk stratification of patients to promote clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that provide enhanced protection of the patient health interests. Our approach, which we have shown would minimally intrude into peoples' lives, uses predictive models to analyze patient data to identify high-risk patients early in the history of a wide range of medical conditions. Utilizing integrated structured data (e.g., lab results, vital signs) and unstructured data (e.g., clinical notes), our system improves the accuracy of medical decisions made by healthcare providers. We use a combination of supervised learning algorithms and real-time data processing to recalibrate risk scores, which serve as actionable insights for anticipatory interventions. The strategy also comes with extensive validation protocols to verify the efficacy of her model in a healthcare environment. Our results indicate that this practice dramatically increases the accuracy of risk assessments, with important implications for patient care and resource utilization.

articleTitle: Enhance Quality of Service in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks through Advanced Multi-Path Routing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A mobile ad hoc network is a adaptable and changing network that does not depend on physical environment; it is very useful in remote areas. Ensuring Quality of Service (QoS), which is essential for sustaining performance in a variety of applications, is one of the core needs for MANETs. This paper presents QoS involve analyzing important characteristics including end-to-end delay, packet loss ratio, and packet delivery ratio. Because of the changing topology, rare resources, and sensitivity to link failures, MANETs provide difficulties in achieving high QoS. The quality of this problem is improved by designing multiple paths between source and destination nodes and taking multipath routing into practice. By advance multipath routing, MANETs can better support applications that are important by improving performance and data privacy

articleTitle: Spine X-Ray-Based Osteoporosis Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Bone fractures are common in elderly patients due to osteoporosis, a prevalent metabolic bone disease in this population. While early diagnosis is possible, current techniques (such as DEXA, QCT, etc.) are often expensive and invasive. This project proposes a less complex deep learning model to predict osteoporosis using grayscale images of human spine X-rays. The VGG16 CNN architecture is applied for feature extraction, and the extracted features are classified using a Feedforward Neural Network (FNN). The database for this project was obtained from publicly accessible archives. The results demonstrate high accuracy, supporting the effectiveness of the proposed model that integrates VGG16 with FNN for an automatic osteoporosis diagnostic system. Specifically, this imaging-based approach offers an alternative for early diagnosis at lower costs and with less invasiveness, ultimately improving diagnostic effectiveness and enhancing patient care.

articleTitle: Zero-Knowledge Range Proofs and Blockchain Integration for Enhancing SCADA Data Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Traditional Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) are prone to cyber attacks which makes it difficult in keeping data secure. As the traditional architecture relies on centralized storage, which makes them vulnerable to unauthorized access and manipulation. To tackle these security concerns, the study demostrates the integration of blockchain technology and Bulletproof, a zero-knowledge range proof technique into SCADA systems to securely store aggregated sensor value proof in the ledger. The study uses Hyperledger fabric, creating a transparent and tamper-proof record for audits and providing a more secure and trustworthy system. This approach reduces storage and computational overhead while ensuring that data remains private and within valid ranges without exposing sensitive details. By combining blockchain with zero-knowledge range proofs, the proposed solution enhances both security and efficiency in SCADA systems. It ensures that sensor data remains protected from tampering while keeping blockchain resources optimized. This makes industrial systems more secure, reliable, and ready for the future of automation.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Analysis In IOT Devices Using ELK Stack
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The explosive growth of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has significantly reshaped today’s network environments, creating a surge in data and introducing new challenges in managing and securing network traffic. In response, this paper introduces a practical and adaptive framework tailored for analyzing IoT traffic using the ELK Stack—Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana. Logstash is used to collect and transform data efficiently, Elasticsearch handles scalable storage and fast querying, and Kibana delivers easy-to-understand visualizations to track trends and detect unusual patterns.To boost the system's intelligence, machine learning is integrated into the framework, enabling it to spot anomalies and potential threats in real time. Testing in diverse IoT scenarios showed faster threat detection and improved accuracy in identifying unauthorized access, proving the framework’s flexibility and effectiveness across various devices and network conditions.With real-time insights into bandwidth consumption and device activity, network administrators can take proactive steps to manage threats and optimize performance. As IoT networks continue to grow in complexity, this research emphasizes the importance of smart, scalable analysis tools. Future development will focus on incorporating advanced predictive models to further enhance threat detection and support more resilient, secure IoT ecosystems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Algorithms in Oral Lesion Diagnosis: Innovations in Image-Based optimization for Cancer Detection and Differential Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A part from being a challenge routine clinical practice, clinical oral lesions can begin from benign pathology to malignant diseases like OSCC (Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.). This preliminarily exploratory research aims at evaluating the applicability of the DL algorithms for the unobtrusive interpretation of clinical oral photographs in relation to early identification of cancer and accurate distinction of various types of OM lesions. The lesion data were gathered from the hospitals and authentic online sources, and meaningful CNNs and other frameworks like Res-Net and YOLO algorism were used for classifying the lesions with higher test accuracy. The models’ performance was high with task performance AUCs above 0.95, which helped to distinguish between malignant and benign lesions. The heatmap-based interpretability helped in workings out particular diagnostic features that needed validation from clinicians. This project shows that more DL solutions could be applied to oral diagnostics, which would lead to the development of economical, precise, and non-erosive technologies to improve early detection, sorting, and differential diagnosis of oral diseases. The future work consists in enriching data samples and improving multi-class classification.

articleTitle: DeepNeuroScan: AI-Powered Brain Tumor Detection Using Machine and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cancer is the most deadly disease since it destroys healthy tissue and drastically reduces a person's lifespan. When compared to the features recovered using more conventional methods, those generated by deep convolutional layers are more robust and easily distinguishable. Brain tumours can be classified and diagnosed using AlexNet and ResNet-18 in conjunction with the support-vector-machine (SVM). The average filter method is used to improve MRI scans of brain tumours. After that, we use deep convolutional layers and other deep learning (DL) approaches to extract robust and significant deep features. SoftMax and SVM are then used to categorise these features. There are a total of 3,060 pictures in the MRI dataset, with three classifications representing cancers and one representing normal tissue. The greatest results are shown by a hybrid approach involving AlexNet and SVM, which achieves 96.2% accuracy, 96.65% sensitivity, and 98.60% specificity.

articleTitle: A Predictive Mechanism Using MLT To Detect Bankruptcy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This Research focuses on improving the accuracy and efficiency of bankruptcy prediction models so that it would serve as a valuable tool in assessing organizational fiscal health. These improvements may revolutionize the practice of risk assessment so that lending decisions may be informed, regulatory oversight improved, and investor protection enhanced. An optimized model may also support thee early warning system that will provide for timely intervention to perhaps reduce the devastating impacts of corporate bankruptcies on the economy at large. It discusses the delicate trade-off between the complexity of the deployed models as well as their interpretability, emphasizing the importance of transparency in financial decision-making. It aims to develop an interpretative model that achieves high performance while maintaining comprehensibility by eliminating irrelevant features. Given the rise of the need for explainable AI in the financial sector, where explainability is vital for building trust in AI systems and aligning with regulations, this proposed approach is well-aligned with current requirement.

articleTitle: Leveraging AI for Translating English-Captioned YouTube Videos into Regional Languages
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: YouTube is often the best player in the world of video for entertainment, education, and information. However, most users experience problems in aspects such as downloading videos to perform offline analysis or simply due to poor Internet connectivity or academic purposes. There is also a growing need for automated captioning translation and multilingual access for non-native speakers and non-local users. The research proposes, therefore, the development of an adaptive translation system that deals with YouTube movies extracting captions from video, translating the captions to a specific language, and synchronizing audio video with the translated text along with the original captions. Most of the public existing tools would fail because YouTube sources keep frequently changing. Most of these problems have minimal performance accuracy in captioning or fail to download the captions. The proposed methodology has been imagined to overcome these using AI and ensure performance improvement across various environments It will helpful application for blind users, users seeking knowledge from inclusive education, and those wishing to learn using their mother tongue or overcome language barriers. Advancing toward the vision of national language interaction ensures that people from different languages can enjoy video content regardless of their mother tongue. The future of this application will be a blend of AI-based media processing with a well-designed architecture for future-proofing to improve digital accessibility and to provide a mean scaled-down replacement for real-time language translation in video content.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Approach to Identify and Classify Heart Disease using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cardiovascular Disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death worldwide, expected to account for 19.05 million deaths by 2020. Heart disease is more common in younger adults because of lifestyle factors such stress, poor diet, and inactivity. To improve human health, researchers are trying to find the early causes of heart disease. In the medical field, early diagnosis lowers mortality and enhances treatment outcomes. Classification tasks related to heart disease have a great deal of potential to be improved by machine learning (ML). In the medical domain, machine learning algorithms are becoming increasingly important, particularly when using medical databases to diagnose illnesses. Accurate diagnosis of heart illness is made possible by the sophisticated data processing and analysis methods, which are also utilized to predict other ailments. The effectiveness of the KNN, Naïve Bayes, and support vector machine (SVM) approaches is compared in this study both with and without the elephant herd optimization strategy. The most popular "Cleveland Clinic Heart Disease dataset" (including 303 cases and 14 characteristics) has been taken from the Kaggle repository and used in the proposed project. The algorithm selects seven of the most relevant features; its performance was improved via the Elephant Herd Optimization approach. Out of all these classification methods, the support vector machine produced the most accurate result, with an accuracy rate of 88.59%.

articleTitle: Highly Accurate Crow Search Optimized CNN Classifier for Cyclone Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Accurate and timely prediction of cyclone events is essential for effective disaster management and risk mitigation. This study introduces a highly precise cyclone prediction model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with the optimization capabilities of the Crow Search Algorithm (CSA). The resulting model, called Crow Search Optimized CNN (CSO-CNN), harnesses the feature extraction and classification strengths of CNNs, while the CSA is used to optimize the hyperparameters of the CNN architecture for optimal performance. The model is trained and validated on a comprehensive dataset that includes satellite imagery and meteorological data from a wide range of cyclone events. The CSO-CNN achieves remarkable classification accuracy, surpassing traditional CNN models and other leading techniques. Its ability to quickly and accurately assess the likelihood of cyclone formation provides crucial decision support for disaster management authorities, enabling timely and effective response strategies. By integrating the CSA optimization technique with the CNN framework, this study presents a novel approach to cyclone prediction. It highlights the potential of combining advanced Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to tackle complex environmental challenges and deepen our understanding of intricate atmospheric phenomena.

articleTitle: Decentralized digital Ledger for Secure and Transparent crypto Voting
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The rights of voters are often compromised due to issues related to immutability, transparency, safety, and privacy in digital voting systems. This survey paper explores the application of blockchain technology in e-voting systems to address these issues and prevent corruption. A systematic literature review approach is adopted, analysing recent studies and applications of blockchain in e-voting. Key aspects reviewed include cryptographic security, decentralized ledger systems, consensus mechanisms, and smart contracts. The survey finds that blockchain technology enhances data integrity, transparency, and vote verifiability. Its decentralized nature prevents tampering, as all voting records are shared across multiple nodes, eliminating a single point of failure. Vote tallying and rule enforcement are automated by smart contracts, reducing human intervention and errors. Traditional e-voting systems face challenges such as susceptibility to fraud, data breaches, and manipulation due to their centralized architecture. Decentralized digital Ledger originally developed for cryptocurrencies, is a decentralized technology known for its security, transparency, and immutability. Recent advancements in blockchain address the limitations of traditional election systems.

articleTitle: Smart Email Filtering Against Phishing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the recent years, phishing has emerged as the greatest cyber threat to billions of people. Most threats are transmitted through e-mail, which malware cannot identify. The spam is installed and used on mail servers, e-mail servers, firewalls, and mail transfer servers, spam filters are able to trace spams in e-mails. Examples of old techniques that are ineffective and incapable of handling threats risen in the contemporary world include blocklists and real time blackhole listing. The newest advanced techniques in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) keep advancing based on the limitations introduced by these traditional techniques. The merits and demerits of the current techniques are discussed by analyzing them. This is helpful for the identification of the variety of DL and ML and techniques that is integrated as Adaptive Contextual Phishing Detection (ACPD) may be applied for email spam detection. In addition, the review can evaluate efficiency and point out research gaps. Looking into these factors will lead to enhance an efficient anti-phishing email detection system.

articleTitle: Optimized Deep Learning Framework Utilizing DenseNet121 for High-Accuracy Image Classification with Improved Computational Efficiency and Feature Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In neuro-oncology, accurate and quick diagnosis of brain tumors is crucial and greatly affects patient survival outcomes and treatment approaches. Based on MRI, the proposed method offers an optimal deep learning framework using DenseNet121 architecture to classify brain cancers. DenseNet121 differs from conventional CNN-based techniques in that it makes use of densely linked convolutional layers, which support less computational redundancy, effective gradient flow, and enhanced feature reuse. These features greatly improve classification accuracy and help to solve usually related to deep network vanishing gradient issues. The proposed system runs thorough preprocessing, refines a pre-trained DenseNet121 model using an MRI brain scan dataset by using data augmentation approaches, hence enhancing model generalization. The Densnet121 has validation accuracy of 86% and 0.9847 AUC score, beats all of the leading models including InceptionV3, VGG19, ResNet50, Custom CNN, and EfficientNet B0. The approach preserves computing efficiency while displaying resilience in separating tumor from non-tumor conditions. The results highlight DenseNet121's scalability and therapeutistic feasibility as a suitable solution for automated brain tumor identification.

articleTitle: ATM Transaction Using Facial Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Financial transactions security in Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) is critical given the increasing levels of fraud and unauthorized access. In this study, a new approach to ATMs' security is outlined by applying facial detection using the Haar Cascade algorithm. It is more secure than the traditional methods of authentication that are prone to theft, skimming, and unauthorized access, such as PINs and cards. Biometric authentication based on facial recognition provides a more secure and user-friendly solution with less risk to the conventional security measures at the ATM. The system uses an integrated camera to scan the facial image of the user during a transaction. The picture is then processed using the Haar Cascade algorithm, a machine learning procedure very efficient in face identification. When facial features corresponding to the pre-registered user profile are identified, access to ATM services is provided through which the transactions can be carried out by only authorized individuals. But unsuccessful attempts at identification block access to avoid unauthorized usage. Conventional PIN-based authentication is vulnerable to various security risks such as skimming and shoulder surfing, rendering it inconvenient and insecure for users. The system under proposal does away with these loopholes by applying the use of biometric authentication, which is both more secure and convenient. Applying Haar Cascade-based face recognition to the design of ATMs can make the security much tighter, reduce the threat of fraud, and ensure an uninterrupted transaction experience to clients.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficient Data Transmission Using Improved LEACH In WSN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Maintaining network lifetime and guaranteeing consistent data transmission in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) depend on energy economy. Designed to maximize energy usage in data transmission, this work proposes an updated form of the Low-Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol, often known as Improved LEACH (I-LEACH). Advanced capabilities like adaptive cluster head selection, dynamic time-slot modification, and energy-aware data aggregation techniques abound in the proposed I-LEACH protocol. Combining these improvements will help I-LEACH reduce energy consumption and raise general network performance. Results from simulations demonstrate that compared to traditional LEACH, I-LEACH significantly outperforms it in terms of network lifetime, energy efficiency, and data transmission reliability. Appropriate for applications needing long-term monitoring and managing energy resources in WSNs.

articleTitle: Decoding the Genome with AI: A Machine Learning-Based Predictive Model for the Diagnosis and Prognosis of Genetic Disorder
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Medical challenges for genetic disorders abound in DNA variation causing some expression in the sufferer. Based on this, this paper presents a novel machine learning framework for predicting and classifying genetic disorders making use of supervised and unsupervised learning methods along with the multi-omics data. To address the issues of genomic data processing, namely high-dimensionality, feature selection, and data heterogeneity, advanced SVM, Random Forest, and Neural Network (NN) classifiers are proposed within the framework. It is done by utilizing the ensemble learning methods to improve prediction accuracy and system stability, which outperforms the traditional method. The framework shows high F1 scores through data preprocessing and feature extraction for genomic datasets, which show its possible capability of giving more accurate and practical results concerning personalized treatment. We will focus on future work that aims to increase the diversity within the dataset, scale the system to become applicable on a broader scale and integrate other omics layers to better enhance the prediction capability as well as enable real time clinical decision making. The results of this research relate the importance of the application of machine learning in revolutionizing genetic medicine, through early diagnosis and personalized care. deep learning approaches and multi-omics data.

articleTitle: Application of Hybrid Machine Learning Approaches for Effective Rainfall Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Proper rainfall estimation is very crucial in improving disaster preparedness and managing effects of other natural disasters like floods and droughts amongst others. In many conventional observational approaches, difficulties can be encountered in terms of getting necessary resolution and accuracy for measuring such characteristics of the precipitation as its intensity and duration at the time of storming. To overcome these drawbacks, this work suggests a new dual machine learning system that integrates XGBoost and BiLSTM for the improved rainfall prognostic model. XGBoost is used for its capability to handle structured, tabular data and prevent overfitting, BiLSTM is used since it can learn temporal relationships and non-linear patterns associated with meteorological time series. The hybrid model takes advantages of these complementary abilities to form accurate and reliable forecast. XGBoost mainly considers finding the importance of useful features from static data where as BiLSTM considers the weather data as a sequence and tries to find temporal pattern. The integration of these models improves both the reliability and efficiency of predictions as well as offering a detailed appreciation of rainfall patterns. In this research work, rainfall forecast accuracy has been enhanced which creates positive implications on agriculture management, flood preparedness.

articleTitle: Combatting SMS Spam: A Machine Learning Approach for Accurate and Scalable Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: SMS spam, being an increasing number, causes tremendous challenges toward user security, privacy, and efficiency of communication. In this paper, a machine learning-based SMS spam detection system is proposed to identify the messages as spam or legitimate. Here, a balanced dataset of 5573 labeled SMS messages from Kaggle have been used with steps of tokenization, normalization, and feature extraction from the data using a Vectorizer. It has been enhanced using multiple Classifiers to have a system with high-probability predictions as well as higher classification accuracy. The model attained 98.4% accuracy with an error rate of 1.6% and went on to surpass several other approaches. In addition, the system uses a real-time detection mechanism, returning instant feedback about the classified messages. It is adaptive and scalable, giving the system a strong foundation in combating the constantly evolving spamming techniques through learning and integration of feedback. The work demonstrated here shows that machine learning can be very effective in fighting SMS spam and also gives insight into the future improvement areas such as advanced feature extraction, multilingual support, and real-time model updates.

articleTitle: A Transformable Mel-Spectrogram for Diagnosis of Dysarthria Using a CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, brain diseases have become more common each year. This is because the population is growing and people are living longer.Some AI-based systems cannot work right when people have speech problems caused by neurological speech disorders, psychological speech disorders, or communication disorders. The disorder known as dysarthria is a neurological speech disease that makes it difficult for people to speak clearly. Tracking the status of these individuals with dysarthria over time might be challenging if they are not identified and treated promptly. As the patient’s symptoms worsen, they can affect their mental and physical well-being. A large body of prior work on dysarthria has included categorization algorithms based on machine learning or deep learning. The proposed study gets better results on the TORGO dataset by turning the audio samples into Mel spectrograms and using a convolutional neural network model based on transfer learning. The proposed work performed with an accuracy of 99.5%.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Driver Drowsiness Detection System for Augmented Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Drowsiness and fatigue are among the top factors that are considered to contribute to car accidents, causing 1.3 million deaths per year. The Advanced Drowsiness Detection System aims at reducing the overall number of different types of accidents on the road as well as fatigue that results in a driver dozing off the above framework is achieved through facial landmark detection. This system employs image recognition techniques to detect drowsiness from the face using face recognition technique. It detects and tracks the driver’s face and eyes to compute the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR), a validated measure for drowsiness detection. This system reduces fatalities and improves road safety by detecting driver drowsiness using Driving Behaviour Analysis (DBA). This system aims to enhance the support for safer transport and mistake-free driving or operation resulting from driver drowsiness.

articleTitle: Safety Vehicle Warning System Using the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The intended smart solution for incentive-based management of accidents in this paper is an IoT based accident alert system for issuing instantaneous alerts in case of an accident that occurs while the driver is in the car. Components of the system architecture are development of the ADXL accelerometer sensor to detect collisions by observing changes of velocity or impact forces. Whenever an accident is detected, the system sounds a beep which is accompanied with latitude and longitude coordinates obtained from the NEO-6M GPS module for easy and quick identification of the location of the accident. The alert is through texting and calling the selected numbers, through the GSM system so even where the internet might be a problem the message gets through. Accident data is also preserved safely in the Adafruit cloud service where it can be accessed instantly by the authorities, or the insurance company, for inquiry, analysis, or for police perks during investigations. It confirms connectivity of IoT components such as sensors, GPS and the cloud to produce an effective and efficient automated solution to implement the needed road safety requirements. Not only does this make medical help available faster, it also feeds real time information back to the authorities to make their decisions faster. But this can help to reduce the potential magnitude of traffic incidents and increase the level of road safety.

articleTitle: VOGraph: Visual Odometry Fusion with Optical Flow and Real-Time Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: It discusses an integrated framework for feature detection, description, and matching coupled with advanced optical flow techniques used in the estimation of motion in dynamic environments. The proposed methodology starts with feature detection algorithms such as LK Shi-Tomasi and LK FAST, used to make sure that the key points are strongly identified across different conditions of images. In order to characterize those features, a number of descriptors adopted comprises SHI_TOMASI_ORB, FAST_ORB, ORB, BRISK, AKAZE, FAST_FREAK, SIFT, ROOT_SIFT, SURF, SUPERPOINT, and FAST_TFEAT, which makes the feature data presentable and computationally manageable. Feature matching is obtained with the help of Brute Force (BF) and Nearest Neighbors combined with the Fast Library for Approximate Nearest Neighbors, FLANN, to get accurate matches between the extracted features. All movements are estimated using techniques based on the optical flow, which calculates motion fields using the Optical Flow Constraint Equation, the Lucas-Kanade (LK), and also a coarse-to-fine flow estimation approach. Afterwards, optical flow demonstrates its feasibility in dynamic scene analysis and object tracking. The framework is tested with the KITTI dataset and live camera feeds, revealing its validity in real-time applications like autonomous navigation, scene understanding, and motion analysis. It tends to underline feature engineering and motion estimation as cornerstones of computer vision systems.

articleTitle: Leveraging Orange for Efficient Implementation of VGG16/VGG19 for Neoplasticity Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This project investigates the classification of neoplasticity in brain images using VGG16 and VGG19 models in conjunction with Orange Data Mining. The dataset, sourced from the Whole Brain Atlas, includes PET images of gliomas, meningiomas, and metastatic tumors. Both models were evaluated with various classifiers, achieving high performance in distinguishing tumor types. VGG19 with the polynomial kernel attained the best AUC (0.986) and F1-score (0.895), while VGG16 with the polynomial kernel achieved the highest classification accuracy (0.913). The results highlight the potential of deep learning models in brain tumor classification and demonstrate the utility of Orange for model evaluation.

articleTitle: Automated Classification and Efficient detection in Brain MRI using SVM and Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: There is a demand to analyze normality or abnormality in MR images, which is a significant task in medical image analysis. Now a days, machine learning methods are applied to identify if the MR image is normal or abnormal. In this work, support vector Machine (SVM) and Decision trees (DT) are applied to MR images to find out abnormalities. Texture features are extracted and analyzed by classification methods such as SVM and DT. The performance parameters on both methods are analyzed, DT provides the classification accuracy of 99% compared to SVM.

articleTitle: Safety Vehicle Warning System Using the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The intended smart solution for incentive-based management of accidents in this paper is an IoT based accident alert system for issuing instantaneous alerts in case of an accident that occurs while the driver is in the car. Components of the system architecture are development of the ADXL accelerometer sensor to detect collisions by observing changes of velocity or impact forces. Whenever an accident is detected, the system sounds a beep which is accompanied with latitude and longitude coordinates obtained from the NEO-6M GPS module for easy and quick identification of the location of the accident. The alert is through texting and calling the selected numbers, through the GSM system so even where the internet might be a problem the message gets through. Accident data is also preserved safely in the Adafruit cloud service where it can be accessed instantly by the authorities, or the insurance company, for inquiry, analysis, or for police perks during investigations. It confirms connectivity of IoT components such as sensors, GPS and the cloud to produce an effective and efficient automated solution to implement the needed road safety requirements. Not only does this make medical help available faster, it also feeds real time information back to the authorities to make their decisions faster. articleTitle: NNVisualiser: An Emerging Framework for Visualising Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: NNVisualiser is a novel and nascent framework, designed for visualising the functional transformations of input in neurons of Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). This paper presents the NNVisualiser framework implemented as a Python package, which facilitates visual understanding of the transformation of input data through various neural network layers, providing insights into network behaviour and aiding in model interpretation. The framework's capabilities include plotting inputs, scales, translations, activations, and flow diagrams of neuron activities. The framework currently supports visualising ANN models trained by Keras deep learning framework, specifically those with single hidden layers and one-dimensional continuous inputs and outputs. Future expansions of NNVisualiser will include support for multidimensional networks and models generated from several deep learning frameworks.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Consumer Payment Apps: Google Pay, PhonePe and Paytm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The growing popularity of cashless transactions has resulted in the broad acceptance of consumer payment services such as Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm in Chennai. This article thoroughly analysis of different systems, concentrating on user ease of use and preference. Given the increasing popularity of digital payments, researching customer attitudes and identifying essential features that contribute to user happiness is critical. This study seeks to provide significant insights for customers and participants in Chennai's digital payment ecosystem by thoroughly examining each application's strengths and drawbacks.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Artificial Gorilla Troop Optimization Algorithm Features based BAT Algorithm for Ground Vibrations Detection using Different Geophone Sensors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Ground vibration sensors, including geophone sensors, are utilized in several applications that involve monitoring seismic activities and structural health. In order to ensure effective monitoring, it is very important to be able to classify and analyze the signals from geophone sensors with precision. In this approach, the first part deals with extracting features in which Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) is applied, which then becomes the feature selection Artificial Gorilla Troop Optimization Algorithm (AGTOA). The categorization is done through the BAT algorithm for signals from a geophone sensor with 10Hz and 30Hz frequencies. The AGTOA-based BAT classifier performed better for the 10Hz sensor, with an average accuracy of 93.88% as compared to 91.86% for the 30Hz sensor. This proves the efficacy of the method proposed; even with inferior quality of data in the lower frequencies, the classifier yields a better performance.

articleTitle: Converzio - Multilingual Mastery: An Engaging E-Learning System and Practice using WebRTC
