publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Learning a new language purely through automated lectures and practice evaluations can lead to difficulties with pronunciation, enunciation, and comprehending slang as spoken by natives. To solve this, we provide "Converzio", a complete platform that combines interactive language classes and virtual chat sessions with native speakers. The software, built with React Native, Node.js, and WebRTC, provides tailored lectures, quizzes, real-time chat, and video chats. User progress tracking, session scheduling, and native speaker webinars on successful training techniques, user communication, and comprehension enhancement are among the features available. This revolutionary technique improves both language competence and cultural knowledge, resulting in a comprehensive and successful language learning solution

articleTitle: Pipeline-Driven Handwritten Digit Recognition: A ZenML Framework Approach for Efficient Machine Learning Workflows
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The integration of machine learning processes has been crucial for creating a scalable and replicable process in many areas. In this work, we present a pipeline-based architecture for solving handwritten digit recognition, implemented with ZenML. In the proposed system, for effective digit recognition of the MNIST dataset, a Support Vector Classifier (SVC) is used as the classifier algorithm to get high accurate result. Using ZenML the identified main steps of data preprocessing, model training, model evaluation and visualization are encapsulated as traceable steps in a workflow. Major input includes having a substantially sound visualization step to display sample prediction and a confusion matrix to allow interpretability and correctness analysis. This framework has a dashboard that helps to keep tabs on the pipeline and enables easy amplification of all the experiments and added capability. This work shows how ZenML manages to provide a capable and flexible solution to deal with the difficulties of ML pipelines trying to be both easy to use and reproducible while also being a substantial tool to support data-scientists and researchers for data-oriented tasks achieving great results.

articleTitle: LSTM-Based Deep Learning Long Term Electric Demand Prediction for Karnataka
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) simulations offer a robust time series-based electric demand forecasting framework. By leveraging the memory capabilities of LSTM networks, accurate predictions can be made for future demand, aiding in efficient resource allocation. LSTM networks have emerged as powerful tools for time series forecasting. Their ability to capture long-range dependencies and handle temporal patterns makes them particularly effective in predicting future values of sequential data. The input data is required for the LSTM, the power demand of Karnataka state has been taken as a study model. It explores the application of LSTM models in time series forecasting, highlighting their strengths in capturing complex temporal dynamics and achieving accurate predictions across various domains. Historical demand data has been collected from 1975 to 2023. Electric demand is forecasted till 2029. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm has captured long-range dependencies and outperformed traditional methods.

articleTitle: Autism Prediction Using Machine Learning a Comparative Analysis of SVM And RNN Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A neurological ailment ASD, also referred to as autism spectrum disorder, has a lifelong impact on an individual's capacity for communication and social interaction. Although it usually manifests itself in the first two years of life, it is categorised as a behavioral disorder and can be identified at any stage of life. According to the ASD idea, the difficulties start in childhood and continue until adolescence and maturity. Motivated by the increasing application of machine learning to medical diagnosis research, this study investigated the potential of random forest and support vector machines to predict and evaluate ASD-related problems in children. The suggested method is tested using non-clinical ASD datasets that are accessible to the public. Our proposed model achieves an overall accuracy of 97% for predicting autism in children.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Hemorrhage in Wireless CapsuleEndoscopy Images using a Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network -Long Short Term Memory (CNN –LSTM) Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The non-invasive nature of Wireless Capsule Endoscopy (the WCE) along with its high-definition imaging capabilities make it an essential diagnostic procedure for gastrointestinal illnesses. Wireless capsule endoscopy is considered a non-invasive method. It involves swallowing a small capsule containing a camera and other components, which then travels through the gastrointestinal tract, capturing images along the way. Since the capsule is ingested orally and does not require the insertion of instruments or devices into the body through incisions, it is classified as a non-invasive procedure. This approach eliminates the need for sedation and reduces discomfort compared to traditional endoscopic procedures, which involve the insertion of a flexible tube (endoscope) through the mouth or anus. However, the large amount of data generated presents challenges in analysis and interpretation. Healthcare practitioners rely on automated segmentation of WCE images into clinically relevant categories, such as detecting bleeding, for prompt diagnosis and treatment. In order to categorize WCE images into two groups—bleeding and normal—this study presents a hybrid model that combines the CNN and LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) architectures. The CNN component extracts spatial correlations within images, while the LSTM component handles temporal dynamics. Using transfer learning techniques, the model is trained on a huge dataset of annotated WCE photos. Extensive testing on a diverse dataset of WCE images from various gastrointestinal patients demonstrates that the hybrid CNN-LSTM model outperforms standalone CNN or LSTM models in classification accuracy. This approach is resilient against common illumination and image quality variations in clinical environments.

articleTitle: Intrutuion Detection System Using Machine Learning Based IDS
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The number of network attacks has increased in today's dynamic environment. Network assaults are unlawful actions taken against virtual assets within a corporate network. Community attacks are typically performed by malicious parties to change, destroy, or gets the private data. Attackers that want access to internal systems usually target network perimeters in their attacks on communities. Network attacks can be categorized into two major types: passive attack and active attack. In passive network attacks, unauthorized users get access to networks, display personal information, and steal it without making any changes. Active network attacks may include material that has been edited, encrypted, or is undesirable. Upon infiltration, malicious events may additionally leverage different hacking activities, inclusive of malware and endpoint assaults, to assault an organizational network. With greater organizations adopting far off operating, networks have end up greater liable to data theft and destruction. As a end result, our proposed device can monitor community visitors for suspicious pastime and come across the presence of any intrusion.

articleTitle: Advanced Cryptocurrency and Stock Prices Forecasting via Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Truthful prediction of the values of the cryptocurrencies and stocks is critical in the financial marketplace. We developed a Bi-Lstm model to forecast the next day prices of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Microsoft stock. The model expands the temporal resolution to the 60-day sequence window, making predictions of financial time series more reliable due to higher temporal dependencies. The effectiveness of the model is evaluated using three error metrics: Hence, use of Mean Squared Error, Root Mean Squared Error, and Mean Absolute Percentage Error was employed to guarantee accurate evaluation. Anticipating prices for the year 2025, the proposed system provides information for overall long-term tendencies and possible gains from investments. The findings reveal that the application of Bi-Lstm model can avert the categories of fluctuation that characterises the financial market and is a powerful instrument for making future predictions. The future work might improve the accuracy of the predictions by incorporating other features like market sentiment and macroeconomic indicators.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Portfolio Optimization Framework Leveraging Modern Portfolio Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The current investment portfolio management methodology demands persistent market surveillance as well as advanced research abilities along with specialized competencies. Traditional portfolio management approaches depend on manual data collection through inspection while experts can still make human judgements that impact the results. Our work presents an innovative Python platform designed to automate portfolio management knowledge enhancement for beginner and advanced investors. The software consists of four key features that assist with monitoring liquid assets while performing yield-based bond assessments and tracking equity portfolios and optimizing asset distributions through Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT). Our system connects to Yahoo Finance and Alpha Vantage APIs to provide up-to-date financial data used in making data-based investments decisions. Successful portfolio management in uncertain market environments depends on this combination of computational systems and existing financial knowledge with real-time market data.

articleTitle: Technology and Community Interventions for food Security and Waste Reduction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Food waste and insecurity using a multifaceted approach that includes nutrition-focused interventions in supportive housing, culturally appropriate food programs for Indigenous communities, and mobile applications to cut down on food waste. Geographical barriers, cultural significance, and logistical inefficiency are among the major barriers. This study assesses the impacts of digital food-waste apps, targeted nutritional interventions, and Indigenous food sovereignty initiatives using a mixed-methods approach. The integration of community-based and technology-driven solutions is unprecedented. The results highlight the worth of cooperative, sustainable approaches toward improving community well-being, environmental resilience, and food access.

articleTitle: Gait Recognition in Forensic: Analyzing CCTV Footage for Criminal Profiling
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The gait analysis helps to identify the features of individual through gait patterns which will assist the investigation. The closed-circuit television (CCTV) footage from the scene of the offense, can be collected through surveillance camera footage, traffic camera footage, dash- cam footage from the dashboard-mounted cameras of the vehicles, mobile phone recording by the victim, is collected for the purpose of gathering digital evidence. Image segmentation of the particular individual from the background scene is done through the collected CCTV footage. By observing the way of walking, movement of lower limbs during locomotion, and walking pattern such as step length, step with, step angle and foot angle which is somehow individualistic to particular person, helps of approximately find the of stature, gender, age, and the bodyweight of a suspect. The observed data is compared with the criminal database to identify the similarities of the suspect. This study helps in the further contribution to establish the physical and biological profile of the suspect for identification. Hence many forensic cases can be solved and criminals can be convicted using this gait analysis.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality in Higher Education A Real Time Perspective
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In Today’s Environment, Augmented Reality (AR) plays a major role in higher education for students and teachers in many ways. Augmented reality is extensively used to enhance with real world with computer generated information to create interactive experience for users who can interact with real world and computer generated content. This article presents a novel approach to develop a model for campus navigation system using Augmented Reality for our Campus "College of Engineering Guindy", Anna University. This proposed system leverages AR Technology, including 3D models, marker-based tracking, and a combination of Android SDK, Vuforia SDK, AR Core, AR Foundation, Mapbox Showing, and location based AR that utilizes GPS. It also aims in enhancing users experience by providing a user-friendly application for easy and efficient navigation throughout the university campus. By combining AR with marker-based tracking, users can visualize destinations through interactive 3D models in the real-world environment. The system integrates multiple technologies to achieve accurate navigation, including precise marker placements and also real-time Global Positioning System (GPS) data. This research article contributes towards the development of advanced AR technology for campus navigation and improving user’s experiences and showcasing the potential of AR in higher educational institutions.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Monitoring for Mitigating Human-Animal Conflicts in Agricultural and Forest Zones
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Human-animal conflicts pose a significant challenge in forest zones and agricultural fields, leading to resource losses and threats to endangered wildlife. These conflicts have escalated in recent years, necessitating innovative solutions for continuous monitoring and intervention. This study presents a novel approach for mitigating such conflicts by leveraging image processing and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Motion detection techniques are employed to identify activity, and content-based image classification algorithms analyze the captured visuals. The proposed method integrates advanced feature extractors, data augmentation, and AI to develop a robust detection network. Additionally, the system enhances safety analysis and certification for high-speed trains by identifying objects and animals in real time. Using the COCO dataset for training and validation, the study demonstrates the potential of AI to streamline conventional safety measures and ensure the coexistence of humans and animals in ecologically sensitive areas.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-Based Strength Prediction Model Using Sustainable Material In Concrete
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The construction industry plays an important role in the emission of CO2 and resource depletion, due to the extensive use of concrete. Conventional concrete uses a lot of cement and natural aggregates, which negatively influence the environment through energy use, greenhouse gas emissions, and ecological degradation during production and extraction. These challenges have increased the demand for sustainable materials in concrete to reduce the environmental impact of the construction sector. Sustainable materials improve the performance and lifespan of concrete while lowering dependency on natural resources. Coconut Shell Ash (CSA) is a Supplementary Cementitious Material (SCM) in concrete instead of regular Portland cement. This study is to examine the effects of coconut shell ash in different percentages of addition in concrete. Glass Powder Waste (GPW) is used in concrete as a fine aggregate of 20 % replacement. Fineness modules of Glass waste and sand are examined. The study focuses on the workability, mechanical behaviour of concrete, durability, and microstructure analysis are investigated. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model and Support Vector Regression(SVR) are used for predicting the compressive strength of the concrete and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value.

articleTitle: Design of an Home Automation System with Voice Controlled Application using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nowadays home automation forms one of the major applications around the globe, all of us likes to setup a home automation but its complex circuit becomes a barrier in setting up it. Home automation involves putting motion or voice control on household appliances. In this paper we discuss about developing of home automation process by using Arduino to decrease the burden of the users and make it easier to interact with home appliances. The focus of the current study is speech-controlled home automation, which enables household appliances like lights, fans, and doors to be operated by voice. To achieve this, Arduino with Bluetooth module have been used as hardware components which controls the state of the electronic gadgets (ON/OFF). The commands are made to pass with the help of MIT application. This research makes home automation simple and affordable to everyone

articleTitle: Enhanced Employee Performance Management System with AI Driven Analytics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Enhanced Employee Performance Management System (EPMS) that is proposed in this paper is a concept-based framework that aims to enhance the efficiency of the workforce through the application of artificial intelligence in predictive modeling. To overcome longstanding issues with employee performance, the EPMS includes new elements, for example, feedback loops and Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Using ARIMA based predictive algorithms, the system provides performance forecasts that product-oriented industries can benefit from. This unique approach delivers adaptability for improving organizational efficiency and the corporate well-being of personnel.

articleTitle: Mental Health Companion for Trauma Recovery Using Multi-Modal Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a mental health companion designed to assist students experiencing trauma-induced emotional distress. Using multi-modal emotion recognition, the system integrates speech, facial expressions, and body posture data to provide real-time coping strategies. Our approach enhances accuracy, reduces latency, and improves user satisfaction, making it a valuable tool for trauma recovery and emotional regulation.

articleTitle: Emotion Detection for Customer Satisfaction Using Optimized XLNet Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A robust mechanism is developed to accurately assess customer emotion. The system analyses text content and extracts emotional characteristics using the XLNet model. This approach makes it possible to better understand customer feedback through the identification of small contextual indications and sentiment patterns that range from positive to negative emotions. The enhanced ability of the model to understand contextual links and bidirectional relationships in text improves the system's performance on sentiment classification tasks. In customer-focused industries, the solution is designed to provide valuable information that may improve decision-making, service delivery, and customer pleasure. The system ensures scalability, real-time processing, and adaptation across a variety of industries, such as e-commerce, healthcare, and entertainment.

articleTitle: AI based Robot Navigation Framework for Industrial and Domestic Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A service robot operates autonomously in service areas such as residences, hospitals, restaurants, museums, and nursing homes. It finds the quickest route from a starting point to a final destination. This effort aims to create a universal navigation framework for an interior mobility service robot. Learning from Demonstration (LfD) is task-oriented development technique that teaches a machine or robot a unique behaviour by presenting the activities directly rather than programming it with control codes and instructions. Unlike conventional programming methodologies, these solutions doesn’t necessitate designing or coding knowledge and can quickly translate shown behaviour into executable code. Three LfD approaches—counter-based, encoder-based, and enhanced encoder-based—are proposed for teaching a mobile service robot to navigate from one site to another. The robot is programmed to navigate to all feasible locations sequentially. This paper discusses the Tree-Based Planner (TBP), which creates a path tree with all logical links between all sites in the surrounding. The system employs the Deep Q-Learning (DQL) method to learn the initial paths from a topological map of the environment, i.e. the path tree generated by the TBP system. The outcome is a navigation framework that takes into account the typical characteristics of an autonomous mobility robot deployed in a service context.

articleTitle: Chip Surface Defect Recognition based on YOLOv11
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Chip surface defect inspection is a critical process to manufacture semiconductors with excellent performance and stable integrated circuits. In this paper, we present a cutting-edge YOLOv11-based defect inspection model, which can support realtime processing and high-precision detection. The model can detect and classify three typical chip surface defects, i.e., cracks, ink marks, and broken areas, with high precision. Innovative additions like the C3K2 block, SPFF module, and C2PSA attention mechanism improve defect localization and classification to a large extent. The model is 0.99 accurate when IoU threshold is 0.5, and it surpasses state-of-the-art algorithms. This paper verifies the feasibility of deep learning-based defect inspection in industrial control and quality control.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Behaviour Analysis in Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research investigates the application of state-of-the-art machine learning strategies, including deep learning, clustering, and reinforcement learning, to better understand user behavior in the banking sector. This strategy enriches personalisation, boosts customer engagement, and enhances operational efficiencies. Advanced neural network designs, including Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and transformer architectures, are deployed to interpret transactional and communicative data. Various clustering methods, such as K-Means, DBSCAN, and Hierarchical Clustering, are utilised to classify users by their behavioral characteristics. Moreover, techniques like Deep Q-learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning are employed to adapt dynamically to user actions, thereby maximizing satisfaction. The research further highlights essential ethical issues concerning bias minimization, privacy protection, and the interpretability of models, ensuring the ethical deployment of machine learning practices. Through empirical validation, the suggested framework shows notable improvements in predicting defaults, refining marketing approaches, and increasing adoption rates. These findings underscore the revolutionary influence of machine learning in profiling user behavior, hinting at future developments in federated learning and quantum computing.

articleTitle: Early Detection Of Liver Disease Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Liver diseases are one of the major global health problems, and better patient outcomes and treatment are reliant on early diagnosis. This research considers a dataset that was obtained from the North East of Andhra Pradesh, India, and contained data from 416 patients with liver disease and 167 individuals without liver disease. Many clinical and demographic factors, such as age, gender, levels of bilirubin, alkaline phosphatase, and liver enzyme markers, are part of the collection. The principal aim of this project is to create a model that, based on patient information, has the ability to predict liver disease. In order to gain a deeper insight into the dataset, exploratory data analysis is performed, showing key trends and patterns. Missing values, especially in the "Albumin and Globulin Ratio" column, are managed with appropriate imputation techniques. Statistical analysis also offers important insights into the variability and central tendencies of the dataset. Visualizations, including histograms and count plots, assist in portraying the distribution of variables such as age, gender, and the target variable used to denote liver disease. Predictive models will be developed by applying machine learning methods like logistic regression, decision trees, and support vector machines. Measures like accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity will be utilized to train and test these models in order to measure their performance. The project has the ability to help healthcare professionals identify those at risk of liver disease early on, thus enabling more preventive healthcare interventions and enhancing patient outcomes through evidence- based insights.

articleTitle: AI-Driven IoT-Enabled Precision Agriculture: Optimizing Resource Usage with LoRaWAN and Drone-Based Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: To maximize the use of resources and increases crop productivity, this research proposes an end-to-end IOT-based precision agriculture system with real-time data gathering with the assistance of smart sensors, monitoring with drones, and analytics with AI. The system collects data regarding crop health, weather, and soil moisture through LoRaWAN, a low-power long-range network technology. Such information facilitates predictive decision-making regarding pest control, fertilization, and irrigation. Field trials show a 15% increase in crop yield, a 20% decrease in the application of pesticides, and a 25% decrease in water usage, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the system in resolving critical agricultural problems and ensuring sustainability. This research demonstrates how IoT and AI can revolutionize farming practices today.

articleTitle: A Multi Framework for Predicting Alzheimer’s disease using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Deep-Brain-Stimulation (DBS) is a demonstrated rehabilitation for Alzheimer's Disease (AD), regularly ensuing in an upgrade of engine work. In any case, a few unfortunate incidental upshots can happen past DBS, which can deteriorate the personal satisfaction of the patient. In this way, the medical group needs to painstakingly choose patients over whom to carry out DBS. In past, there have been a few endeavors to associate pre-usable information and DBS experimental outcomes, with generally centered on the engine symptomatology. We design and implement a Machine Learning (ML) based strategy called multimodel pipeline alluded to as FlowModel, ready to anticipate an enormous number of DBS medical results for AD. It is made out of a Artificial Neural Network (ANN) to squeeze medical data, a picture handling strategy from the conventional to retrieve morphological biomarkers our of T1imaging, and a Support Vector Machine (SVM) to execute the regressions. We authenticated it on 256 AD patients who gone through a DBS. FlowModel illustrated association determinants as lofty as 0.82 and had the option to altogether foresee 63 out of 84 scores, outperforming an existing linear model. The quantity of metrics that are anticipated with this pre-employable data was likewise observed to be related with the quantity of patients with this data accessible, showing that the FlowModel technique is still effectively learning. We introduced a new, ML based pipeline to foresee an assortment of post-usable clinical results of DBS for AD patients. It considered different bio-markers, emerging from various information modalities, illustrating strong relationship coefficients for certain scores from pre-employable information as it were. It shows that numerous clinical results of DBS can be anticipated rationalist to the particular simulation boundaries, as FlowModel has been approved without such incitement associated data.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning for ASD Prediction: Integrating Sentiment Analysis and Character-Level Embedding from Tweets and Clinical Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder considered by challenges in communication, social interaction, and behavior. Early and accurate detection remains a challenge due to subjective clinical assessments. This work presents an innovative hybrid framework that incorporates sentiment analysis from social media data with deep learning techniques applied to clinical data to enhance ASD prediction. Leveraging Twitter sentiment, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model captures public emotional and behavioral patterns, while clinical data undergoes deep learning-based character-level embedding using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with transfer learning. The fusion of these models through a weighted sum mechanism results in a comprehensive ASD detection system. Experimental outcomes demonstrate an accuracy of 99.3% with a loss of 1.45%, significantly outperforming traditional diagnostic approaches. Visual analyses further validate key correlations between assessment scores and ASD diagnoses. Despite limitations such as misinformation in social media and the need for larger clinical datasets, the proposed approach highlights the potential of integrating social and clinical perspectives for improved ASD diagnosis. Future work will explore broader social media sources and advanced deep learning architectures to refine the model, ultimately contributing to early intervention and progressed results for individuals with ASD.

articleTitle: Detection of Hate Speech with Attention-Enhanced Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: One of the pressing issues on user-generated platforms and social media is hate speech, a threat to online communities. Conventional detection methods, such as keyword matching or basic classification, often miss hate speech's subtleties and contextual dependencies. This paper introduces a pioneering deep learning approach, leveraging transformer architectures and attention mechanisms, to advance the state-of-the-art in hate speech detection. Our model's unique feature is its ability to focus on words that carry more contextual relevance, thereby interpreting the intended meaning of the words more accurately. The multi-head self-attention mechanism allows for differential weighting of various input parts, thereby enhancing the model's ability to distinguish between hostile and hateful language, even in cases of word similarity. We explain the architecture of our model with further explanation of the calculation involved in queries, keys, and values, followed by a description of the mathematical foundation of the attention mechanism. In fine-tuning the pre-trained transformer model, say BERT, from the hate speech dataset, our optimised model uses the Adam optimiser. We run experiments to check the performance of the proposed model by using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score to prove that our proposed model outperforms the base models like CNNs and RNNs. Our attention-based approach successfully highlights hate speech in subtle, context-sensitive ways. As this is one of the first studies where attention has been explored in the context of hate speech detection, it provides a good platform for further work on hate speech and multimodal inputs in many other languages. The results of our experiments indicate the promise of attention-based models as a powerful and scalable solution to the real-world challenges of hate speech detection.

articleTitle: ExplainableAI with Transfer Learning for Crop Disease Assessment Using Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The process of maintaining crop to preserve its health naturally is responsible and challenging task in this era of chemical pesticides/insecticides. So, crop management before it is affected by any disease can be a crucial step ahead to avoid the overuse of chemicals. This current work deals with the application of plant disease prediction from thermal images. For this purpose, the popular transfer learning model, EfficientNetB0 utilized for multi-label classification problem. Normal image classification causes more errors than thermal image classification because of blurry images, no clear visuals of the leaves, temperature variations that can't be determined, etc. So EfficientNetB0 model is used which is more balanced, accurate, and efficient. This EfficientNetB0 model combines XAI for a better understanding of the model and gives a higher rate of accuracy than other traditional models. This study highlights the combination of a deep learning model and thermal imaging technique to build a strong, non-invasive mechanism for crop disease management.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Textile Quality Control: Real-Time Cloth Defect Detection Using YOLO Algorithm For Enhanced Manufacturing Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Textile quality checking is an essential production process offering blemish-free materials with low waste and cost of production. Hand inspection methods are slow, susceptible to human mistake, and inefficient. This article proposes a sophisticated real-time fabric defect inspection system founded on the YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once) algorithm, a recent deep learning object detection model. With the help of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), YOLOv8 effectively detects and classifies fabric defects like holes, stains, and weaving defects with a very high accuracy. The real-time feature of the system allows the detection of defects in real time, thus improving quality control as well as production efficiency. We test the performance of the system in terms of precision, recall, F1-score, and processing time. Our findings show a significant leap forward from the conventional inspection techniques, showing the potential of AI technologies in transforming textile quality inspection.

articleTitle: Intelligent Video Surveillance Systems With Violence Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Modern video surveillance systems capable of identifying and responding to security threats and violent crimes in real time have become increasingly common in recent years. This study presents a novel approach to enhancing the capabilities of video surveillance systems through the integration of YOLO (You Only Look Once), an advanced object detection algorithm, specifically for human violence detection. The proposed Intelligent Video Surveillance System utilizes YOLOv8’s speed and accuracy to detect violent activity in real-time video feeds. YOLO is particularly well-suited for real-time surveillance applications due to its ability to classify and identify objects in a single network pass. The system leverages a YOLOv8 model that has been fine-tuned on a comprehensive dataset containing both violent and nonviolent activities, allowing it to distinguish between various forms of human violence, including physical altercations, aggressive gestures, and hostile poses. Key components of the system include video feed acquisition, preprocessing, YOLOv8-based object detection, and post-processing techniques to reduce false positives. When compared to traditional surveillance methods, the proposed system offers numerous advantages. By automating the detection process, ensuring continuous monitoring, and responding promptly to potentially harmful situations, it significantly reduces the burden on human operators. Furthermore, the integration of YOLOv8 allows for scalability and flexibility, making the system suitable for diverse surveillance environments, such as public spaces, transportation hubs, and private facilities.

articleTitle: A Vision Transformer Approach to Efficient Brain Tumor Detection and Segmentation in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor detection and segmentation are important tasks in the field of medical imaging that have significant potential to enhance treatment planning and accurate diagnosis. The construction of a Vision Transformer (ViT) model for the purpose of identifying brain tumor from medical images specifically MRI scans has been covered in this work. Renowned for its outstanding performance recognition challenges, the Vision Transformer will be utilized to improve brain tumor detection accuracy and efficiency. The proposed system will be evaluated in terms of accuracy, performance, and inference time against conventional deep learning models. This research aims to improve real-time medical image processing with ViT, resulting in faster diagnosis and more efficient tumor identification in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of YOLO Models for Strawberry Ripeness Detection in Challenging Environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The application of deep learning in agricultural tasks, such as ripeness detection of fruits has undergone rapid advancements. However, the real time challenges faced by these models under adverse imaging conditions remain underexplored. This study evaluates the performance of You Only Look Once (YOLOv8) models for strawberry ripeness detection across four imaging scenarios: normal, blurred, darkened, and noisy conditions. A comprehensive dataset was prepared, incorporating diverse environmental challenges to simulate real-world conditions. The YOLOv8 model was trained and validated on each dataset, with performance evaluated using metrics such as precision, recall, mean Average Precision at Intersection over Union threshold 50% (mAP@50), and mAP across thresholds from 50% to 95% (mAP@50-95). Results reveal substantial variations in detection accuracy across conditions, highlighting the model’s sensitivity to image quality degradation, particularly in blurry and noisy scenarios. Despite struggling in blurry and noisy conditions, YOLOv8 demonstrated robust detection capabilities in normal and darkened conditions. This study provides valuable insights into the capabilities and limitations of current object detection models in strawberry cultivation and provides future directions for further scaling and enhancing the model into a cohesive setup for automated harvesting. These findings contribute to the development of more reliable machine learning systems in the field of agricultural automation

articleTitle: Integrating Computer Vision and Biomechanism for Injury Prevention for Cricket Bowlers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Cricket bowlers are prone to injuries due to repetitive motion and biomechanical stress, which can affect their career and team performance. This research proposes a new framework that integrates biomechanics and computer vision techniques for early prevention of injuries in cricket bowlers. By analyzing movement patterns and detecting biomechanical abnormalities, the system provides data-driven insights for injury risk assessment and performance improvement. The study uses advanced computer vision algorithms to extract 3D kinetic data from high-speed video footage of bowlers in real-time. Train on machine learning models, biomechanical datasets and injury history. Machine learning models, trained on biomechanical datasets and injury history, are used to identify stress points and deviations from optimal bowling techniques. Validation results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves greater than 85% accuracy in identifying high-risk movement patterns, outperforming traditional biomechanical analysis methods. This approach eliminates the need for complex marker-based motion capture systems, making it accessible and scalable for real-world applications. The integration of interpretable AI ensures actionable recommendations for coaches and medical teams, enabling personalized training interventions and reducing injury rates

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Cardiovascular Risk Prediction: A Comprehensive Review of Models and Validation and Multimodal Imaging Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: cardiovascular disease is an area where more advanced diagnostic, detection, and prediction models are necessary. Advances in machine learning, deep learning and artificial intelligence hold great potential for detecting at-risk individuals, yet validation and application remain challenging. This study examines AI models for estimating cardiovascular disease, with an emphasis on advanced technology, limits, and validation requirements. To improve diagnosis accuracy, consistent validation techniques must be developed, replicability assessed, and many datasets integrated. The importance of multimodal integration, external validation, and ethical considerations such as data privacy and biases that may affect specific populations is underlined. This analysis emphasizes the need of continuing to develop AI and machine learning algorithms in order to overcome these limitations and broaden their applications in cardiovascular healthcare for better prediction and treatment results.

articleTitle: IOT Based Connected Companion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The IoT-enabled pet care system simplifies the management of pet health, feeding, and hydration through automation and smart technologies. Designed for modern pet owners, this system features a remotely controlled smart dispenser accessible via a mobile app. The dispenser is equipped with a weight sensor that ensures precise portion control, supporting a healthy diet for pets. Alongside this, the system includes a smart collar capable of monitoring the pet’s movement and body temperature, sending instant alerts if the temperature crosses a predefined safe threshold. The system also incorporates a motion sensor near the feeding area, which activates a light when the pet approaches, enhancing accessibility and convenience. By storing data securely in the cloud, it enables pet owners to track feeding schedules and health metrics over time. This long-term data storage allows for real-time monitoring and a better understanding of the pet’s overall well-being. Emphasizing user-friendly functionality, the system offers a seamless blend of technology and practicality, ensuring both safety and convenience for pets and their owners. Looking ahead, the system can be enhanced with artificial intelligence to provide personalized recommendations based on the pet’s habits, activity levels, and health data. These insights could refine feeding schedules, suggest dietary adjustments, and improve monitoring accuracy. This IoT-based solution not only ensures the physical health of pets but also provides owners with peace of mind, offering a reliable and comprehensive approach to modern pet care.

articleTitle: AI Powered Project Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: With the growing need for error-free multilingual communication and information retrieval, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled systems have cropped up to enable effective retrieval of texts and translation. This paper introduces a sophisticated AI-based framework incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs) for real-time text extraction and multilingual translation. The system provides for interactive dialogue with documents so that users can retrieve and translate English text into Tamil while keeping the context intact and ensuring accuracy. By leveraging OpenAI’s GPT model, the system ensures high-quality translations that preserve semantic coherence, making it a valuable tool for education, content accessibility, and cross-linguistic communication.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Expiry Date Verification For Medical Product With QR Code
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a system that leverages blockchain technology to authenticate medicinal products by verifying their expiry dates and ensuring product integrity. By linking product data to QR codes, the system provides a secure and transparent method for consumers to confirm the validity of medicinal products. The use of blockchain ensures an immutable record of product information, enhancing trust and safety in the pharmaceutical industry by allowing users to easily verify product authenticity and expiry data.

articleTitle: Nutrition Recommender and Adjustment System by Fine-tuning LLMs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The advent of large models(LLMs) has revolutionized the landscape of artificial intelligence, particularly influencing sectors like healthcare and nutrition. These models possess an extraordinary capacity for understanding and generating natural language, and their ability to generalize knowledge across various domains becomes even more powerful when fine-tuned for specific tasks. Leveraging transfer learning, LLMs can apply knowledge from one context to expedite learning in another. The major problem with available Systems is, not providing items which are not accessible or culturally appropriate for users by fine tuning Gemini model on finding region of user by their diet and limiting it to suggest only food items that are from same region solves this problem. By an available dataset from Kaggle which has data of nutrient content of some specific item and using Schofield Equation to calculate the max and min amounts of macronutrients that the user needs per day, calculated deficient and excess nutrient by basing this the LLM(Gemini) will return appropriate diet by changing, adding or removing the user’s diet. As a result, finetuned LLM(Gemini) has successfully identified and suggested food items from the same region. In this paper, we discussed methods to optimize the nutrition recommender and adjustment system based on user preferences, highlighting the fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs).

articleTitle: AutoMed: Multi-Agent AI System for Personalized Medical Knowledge Retrieval and Summarization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In today’s fast-paced medical environment, researchers and healthcare practitioners frequently find it difficult to keep pace with the sheer number of new articles and studies. Conventional search techniques, though exhaustive, tend to produce either too many irrelevant results or miss important information. To fix this, The research proposes a semi-autonomous, multi-agent and AI-driven solution that simplifies finding and synthesizing medical knowledge. By using agents to refine user queries, retrieve and filter articles from established databases like PubMed and PMC and generate summaries, the system makes searching more targeted. Breaking down complex queries makes it more specific, while intelligent filtering zooms in on the most relevant results. Summaries with source attribution are concise and trustworthy. Plus the system does user preference learning that sends users periodic updates on their areas of interest. Built-in explainability features adds to transparency and credibility so users can trust the curated outputs. Overall, this AI-driven solution is a flexible and time-saving tool for evidence-based decision making in clinical and research settings.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Personalized Deep Learning Framework for Early Detection of Glioblastoma Using Multi-Modal MRI Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The prognosis of glioblastoma, which stands as the most malignant variant of a brain tumour, is clearly unfavourable due to the late diagnosis and the severe heterogeneity it is known to possess. Standard diagnostic techniques nowadays that employ MRI data quite often have a low-level performance in terms of diagnosing glioblastoma during its early stages owing to the diverse manner in which the tumours may grow in various patients. In light of this background, we present a new deep learning framework suitable for multi-modal MRI data and aimed at improving glioblastoma prognosis at an early stage. The framework utilizes convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to obtain features from T1, T2, and FLAIR MRI images, and combines this with an AI-guided individualized diagnostic system. This model utilizes relevant clinical data such as age and genetic data in a more individualized manner to meet patient’s needs during diagnosis. One more novel feature of our approach is the ensemble learning that combines CNNs with RNNs to detect minor tumour deposits more effectively over time. The proposed framework delivered an AUC of 0.94 on large glioblastoma MRI databases, thus progressing the early-stage diagnosis of the tumour type which was the aim. This advanced personalized method not only allows for superior diagnosis but also improves on the treatment plans that are available for such patients. Further development will concern clinical verification as well as increasing the capacity of the framework.

articleTitle: Enhancing Explainability and Transparency in Deep Learning Models for Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Recently, it has been observed that deep learning models can be very useful in handling healthcare facilities mostly medical diagnosis and management. However, they are not interpretable and transparent enough to be accepted and used in the clinical environments where the matching reasoning is important. This paper proposes a new strategy to improve explainability of deep learning approaches when used in healthcare data set. We introduce an IDNN design with explainable layers and postdoc approaches like SHAP and LIME for visualization and explanation of model predictions. Our framework is applied to multiple healthcare datasets such as MIMICIII and ChestXray14 where we will compare the traditional method with the proposed method by training accuracy and explainability evaluation metrics. Results indicate that this causes minimal compromise in accuracy on the other hand, other explainability measures of model fidelity, and comprehensibility reveal significant gains, signifying the potential of this method in advancing the use of AI solutions in healthcare contexts.

articleTitle: Building a balanced Tamil Corpus: EDA and Lexical Diversity Comparison with English
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Corpora are crucial to improve the accuracy of several Natural Language Processing tasks. Tamil is a Dravidian language and classified as a low-resource language. It is also a morphologically rich language with an agglutinative and complex inflectional structure. A balanced corpus for Tamil-TamilCorp, comprising 1.69 billion tokens across 17 genres was constructed. An exploratory data analysis (EDA) was done on the type- token data obtained from all the 17 genres using correlation heatmaps, scatter plots and many more to understand the type- token trends in Tamil. A uniformly random sample of about 1 million tokens (with 615 KB text per genre) was generated. The randomly sampled Tamil balanced corpus was used as the experimental dataset and compared with a similar-sized sample of corpora from other well-balanced English corpora like COCA, COHA and Brown. The analysis revealed that Tamil has much higher lexical diversity in comparison with English due to its morphologically rich and agglutinative structure. The observed differences were statistically significant (t-tests; Cohen’s d for effect size). Statistical analysis used two measures – TTR and MTLD. This experiment emphasizes the significance of understanding variation in lexical diversity across languages and contributes to the fields of NLP and corpus linguistics. The entire code for the EDA, and t-test experiments is available as a open source repository in GitHub along with the word embeddings and a Tamil dictionary of around 8 million words, obtained from TamilCorp so that it might be helpful for other researchers in the Tamil NLP community.

articleTitle: A Cloud Based Smart Energy Analyser Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the past few decades, intelligent home systems have gained immense popularity due to their ability to increase both convenience and quality of life. Customers in the modern era desire dependable energy management, current information, and effective assistance. In this direction, there has been a significant amount of research effort done towards the development of some smart lighting systems in order to save energy and researchers developed an Android-based Smart home system for monitoring energy consumption to prevent anomalies. We investigate the idea of an IoT-based Smart Energy Management system with cloud computing which can be integrated to remotely control household equipment like fans and light, track and compute throughput, appliance power consumption and detect and record energy consumption in the cloud. The initiative being presented here aims to solve issues encountered by both consumers and distribution networks. The paper focuses on smart energy meters, which use embedded system features, such as a combination of hardware and software, to achieve desired functionality.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework for Nutrition Analysis and Ingredient Substitution using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nutrition is a core concern for public health, since it is the basic tool to prevent diseases and ensure well-being in general. However, classical methods of nutritional evaluation and selection of substitute ingredients often fail and do not support personalized nutrition plans. This paper addresses this problem by developing a framework based on machine learning techniques. It uses synthetic data and CNNs to analyze the nutritional content and recommend alternative ingredients that are healthier. The major challenge here is to ensure that the replacements maintain nutritional equivalence without sacrificing functionality or flavor. The focus of this research is to develop an automated system that determines the nutritional content of food items and provides intelligent substitution according to dietary goals such as reducing fat or increasing protein content. The methodology involved preprocessing of a synthetic dataset of food items and training of a CNN model on the task of nutritional classification with implementation of a rule-based substitution mechanism to propose substitutes. Expected outcomes include high accuracy of nutritional predictions along with meaningful substitutions that can enhance the quality of dietary. It has been found that there is an accuracy of 90.00%, balanced precision, recall, and F1 scores. Future extensions will include the following: more real-world dataset integration, reinforcement learning for substitution, and scalable deployment.

articleTitle: SIGNWAVE Gesture-to-Text Conversion
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: SIGNWAVE is a wearable solution that provides a gesture-to-text conversion glove which bridges the communication gap between individuals with speech and hearing impairments. The system make use of flex sensors attached to gloves to detect hand gestures associated with sign language. The sensor data is processed and then displayed on an attached LCD Screen. SIGNWAVE offers a lightweight, wearable solution powered by a rechargeable battery. These gloves make interaction between individuals who are deaf or mute and the broader community easier and more comfortable, enhancing accessibility and makes sure that they feel included in various social settings.

articleTitle: Extracting and Classifying 3D Medical Image Texture Characteristics using GLCM and LBP-Based Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Recent advances in 3D sensor technology have advanced 3D imaging systems. This sparks interest in 3D picture feature extraction and categorization. According to the literature, textural content is essential to visuals. In this case, we extract texture characteristics from three-dimensional photos to improve feature differentiation. Category of volumetric data with texture is possible using this method. We employ feature vectors from Local Binary Patterns (LBP) and Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix methods to achieve this. The visual pattern and volumetric data contrast, homogeneity, and local anisotropy are described. The proposed approach was tested using a publicly accessible dataset of modified volumetric textured pictures. Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are classified. Our solution outperforms manually constructed techniques for extracting texture characteristics from 3D and 2D data and standard deep-learning networks. Even with few photographs per class, the recommended method improves class distinction and yields good results. Show exceptional accuracy. Integrating the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) with Local Binary Patterns (LBP) improved classification performance. The GLCM approach, which captures spatial relationships, and the LBP method, which depicts local texture, was advantageous. This hybrid method improved feature extraction and classification, notably for complex 3D medical pictures with subtle texture changes.

articleTitle: Detection of Sybil Attacks in Vanet using Transformer With CNN Hybrid Architecture and Optimized by AdamW Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) help improve road safety by letting cars talk to each other but they still face Sybil attacks. In a Sybil attack, bad nodes claim many identities and weaken the network. This paper offers a Transformer-CNN model that uses the AdamW optimizer to spot Sybil attacks in VANETs. It uses spatial as well as time data from vehicular communications. The model works best at finding these attacks. The system is measured with metrics like accuracy, precision, and it shows big gains compared to older methods.

articleTitle: An Extensive Analysis on Predictive Modeling for Network Traffic using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the era of proliferating AI applications and interconnected devices, traditional bandwidth forecasting methods fall short. This research explores the fusion of AI, particularly machine learning and deep learning algorithms, to redefine predictive modeling for network traffic. The goal is to develop an advanced forecasting model that flexibly adjusts to evolving network dynamics, accommodating diverse AI applications and user behaviors. The envisioned model aims to equip network administrators with AI-driven insights for accurate resource allocation, enhancing efficiency and responsiveness amid the escalating demands of AI-driven technologies. This study contributes to bridging the gap between burgeoning network requirements and existing forecasting methodologies, paving the way for more resilient and adaptive network infrastructures in the age of AI proliferation

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Frameworks: VGG16, InceptionV3, ResNet50, and Custom CNN for Martian Surface Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Feature classification of the Mars surface is very crucial in planetary science as well as in missions and disentanglement of the history behind the Red Planet. In this paper, research will be done to detect the most effective and stable deep learning model for classifying Mars surface. In this experiment the models used, such as ResNet-50, VGG-16, Convolutional Neural Network CNN and Inception V3 were used to classify Mars surface from a dataset of high-resolution Mars Orbital Images classified into: Bright Dune, Crater, Dark Dune, Impact Ejecta, Slope Streak, Spider, and Swiss Cheese.The findings revealed that all four models performed extremely well, with InceptionV3 emerging as the most accurate model. It outperformed the others while maintaining high precision, recall, and F1 scores across all classes. ResNet-50 demonstrated strong training stability with minimal performance variations, while the custom CNN showcased an effective problem-specific approach. VGG-16 also provided competitive results, making all the models viable options for Mars surface classification tasks.

articleTitle: Automated Detection Of Algal Blooms In Satellite Images Using K-Means Clustering With NDVI And NDWI Indices
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Harmful algal blooms (HABs) greatly affect water bodies, aquatic ecosystems, water quality, and human health. The present work suggests an automatic algal bloom detection approach from satellite imagery by incorporating k-means clustering along with the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI). These indices are used to increase feature extraction for accurate segmentation of water areas, vegetation, and algal bloom areas. The k-means clustering algorithm was applied with k=4. NDVI and NDWI values were normalized between -1 to 1, effectively differentiating bloom-affected areas, with an average NDVI of 0.38 for vegetation and an average NDWI of 0.12 for water bodies. The suggested method enables real-time monitoring of water quality, advancing sustainable management of ecosystems.

articleTitle: Brain tumor classification using Hybrid RF+ DenseNet121
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Classifying brain tumors is the first and most crucial stage in evaluating potentially fatal abnormal tissues and developing effective treatment plans to aid patients' recoveries. Several medical imaging devices may detect brain pathologies. The lack of ionizing radiation and high image quality made possible by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) make it a popular choice for medical imaging. Several proposals for medical image analysis approaches have used deep learning techniques to monitor and diagnose health issues from brain MRI scans. The key process is to investigate the brain tumor through the detection and classification with appropriate methods. Brain tumor can be detected using a variety of medical imaging methods like CT, MRI, PET, etc. In this research, we presented a novel method for brain tumor detection and classification using brain tumor MRI images that combines Random Forest (RF) and DenseNet121. We can see that our strategy outperforms the competition and is more accurate from the findings.

articleTitle: A Projection-Based Framework for Integrating Machine Learning into Macro finance Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research introduces a supervised machine learning projection method to approximate expectations in the optimality conditions of economic models. Building upon the parameterized expectations algorithm (PEA) with stochastic simulation, the proposed neural network-based method efficiently addresses challenges such as multicollinearity and the curse of dimensionality. The study extends existing optimal debt management models to include four maturities, uncovering insights about medium-term maturities’ role in fiscal policy. Our findings demonstrate that the optimal policy actively leverages medium-term maturities to stabilize financial income during economic shocks without increasing total debt.

articleTitle: Hand made gesture-based home automation using IOT with python OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The demand for smart home automation systems is growing at an accelerated pace due to their ability to simplify everyday tasks and enhance the convenience of modern living. However, many existing systems rely heavily on voice commands, physical switches, or internet connectivity, which may not be accessible to all users, especially those with physical disabilities or impairments. These traditional systems often come with high costs due to additional hardware and network dependencies, creating barriers for widespread adoption, particularly among users with special needs or those seeking simpler, more affordable solutions. The Contactless System efficiency was improved by implementing the proposed system as described in this proposal. Accordingly, this paper explains the gesture-controlled home automation based on python OpenCV.

articleTitle: Advanced Ensemble Learning and Feature Enhancement for Robust Breast Cancer Classification in Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the leading causes of death in women, making it important to detect early and correctly for proper treatment. The research uses the Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Dataset (BreaKHis) that contains 162 slide images scanned at 40x magnification and 277,524 image patches of 50x50 pixels, which were divided into two categories, IDC-negative and IDC-positive with 198,738 and 78,786 patches respectively. In the preprocessing stage, CIRES (Comprehensive Image Refinement and Enhancement System) is applied to improve image quality through contrast adjustment, noise reduction, normalization, and sharpening. Data augmentation is performed using CARSHI (Comprehensive Augmentation and Refinement System for Histopathology Images), applying rotation, flipping, zooming, and brightness adjustment to increase dataset diversity. Feature extraction is carried out using ContextAware Feature Enhancement, where the contextual relevance of feature is used for the adjustment of weights to improve discriminability of the feature. The Hybrid Convolutional Attention System identifies the most informative features in the case of feature selection. Classification is carried out by Ensemble Convolutional Recurrent Deep Network, a novel model which integrates models like LSTM, RNN, CNN, DNN, GRU, and DBN, employing bagging and boosting techniques for reduction of bias and variance. Hyperparameter tuning optimizes model performance, and the final prediction is computed by aggregating individual model outputs. E-CRDN achieved an accuracy of 96.5%, demonstrating strong performance across all evaluation metrics. This approach showcases its robustness and potential for reliable breast cancer classification, with significant application in clinical settings for accurate and efficient breast cancer detection.

articleTitle: Geospatial modelling of groundwater potential zones: A data-driven optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Groundwater is an essential resource for sustainable water management, particularly in water scarcity areas. This study introduces a data-driven optimization approach for mapping groundwater potential regions in Tamil Nadu, integrating multi-factor analysis with the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). Key hydrogeological parameters such as rainfall, soil, land use, slope, drainage density, and lineament density are evaluated to enhance decision-making over traditional methods. Spatial data is processed and analyzed using R programming to generate high-accuracy groundwater potential maps. The AHP model’s consistency ratio (CR) is within the acceptable threshold i.e. 0.16, ensuring reliability in the weight assignments. Additionally, the model’s predictive performance is validated using the ROC curve, achieving an accuracy of 89%. These findings enhance the reliability of groundwater potential mapping, offering a scientifically robust framework for sustainable water resource management and future hydrological studies.

articleTitle: Pancretic Cancer Prediction Using urinary biomarkers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly aggressive cancer with a poor prognosis due to late detection. Conventional diagnostic techniques, such as imaging and biopsies, are invasive, expensive, and often lead to delayed diagnosis. This research presents a novel, non-invasive diagnostic approach that utilizes urinary biomarkers—creatinine, LYVE1, REG1B, REG1A, and TFF1—combined with advanced machine learning algorithms for early pancreatic cancer detection. The proposed system employs deep learning models to analyze biomarker patterns, effectively differentiating PDAC from benign pancreatic conditions and healthy individuals. By automating biomarker analysis through artificial intelligence, the system enhances diagnostic precision, reduces false positives and negatives, and accelerates clinical decision-making. Additionally, a feedback-driven learning mechanism is integrated to refine model accuracy over time, ensuring adaptability to new data. This approach not only provides a cost-effective and scalable alternative to traditional diagnostics but also marks a significant step towards personalized and accessible cancer detection solutions.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection System Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Drive fatigue is one of the leading causes of accidents globally and one of the most neglected aspects of road safety. In this project, the most relevant and latest techniques of machine learning are utilized for developing and deploying a robust system for sleepiness recognition. The technology seeks to monitor signs of driver tiredness in real time while there is a long-distance road or travel. The proposed approach consists of using facial feature extraction to track the driver state in conjunction with vehicle data. The system mainly consists of face detection, eye tracking, and alarm system. The efficacy of this system in decreasing drowsiness- related accidents shows what a key tool this can be for improving road safety.

articleTitle: Autonomous Passenger Counting And Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In metropolitan city, public transportation plays a crucial role in day-to-day life of the people. The effective transportation will be ensured by the smart counting system with the help of LIDAR sensor. The VL53L1X (LIDAR) sensor will be employed for counting and recording of passengers. In this case, the sensor will do passenger counting and recording using 940 nm class one laser for monitoring purposes. SIM7600 4G GSM module will be used to enable connectivity and facilitate data transmission, communication as well as internet access for the application and ESP32 Microcontroller plays a major role as main control unit of all the sensors. Neo 6M GPS module will ensure efficient route management, real-time updates and precision in location tracking. Incorporation with Firebase and Flutter flow made it possible to create a mobile application that is user-friendly where one gets green for enough space, yellow for limited space and red when it is fully booked. It will also enhance capacity management as well as planning for the passenger movements. The counting device along with GPS tracking makes this app more convenient among the users due to the additional seat availability along with the live location.

articleTitle: Developing a User-Friendly Conversational AI Assistant for University Using Ollama and LLama3
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of an AI-driven chatbot for a university, designed to assist students and parents by providing accurate and instant information about the university. The chatbot leverages advanced LLM technologies, specifically LLama3, integrated with Ollama, to ensure high-quality natural language processing. Using LangChain, the system processes user queries by combining them with a structured prompt template, generating precise responses, and storing interactions in a database for future reference. The architecture includes modules like login, signup, and chat, ensuring a user-friendly interface. The chatbot's capability to reliably give precise responses was evaluated both manually and with volunteers in actual situations. This project showcases the uniqueness of utilizing Ollama and LLama3, which distinguishes it from conventional solutions by providing incredibly trustworthy and relevant replies. The chatbot enhances the user experience and acts as an efficient virtual assistant for the university by bridging the gap between user inquiries and institutional resources.

articleTitle: Enhancing Personalized Agriculture With Cutting-Edge Hybrid Machine Learning Models And Intelligent Edge Computing For Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and edge computing has enabled personalized agriculture, optimizing farming practices by tailoring interventions to individual crop needs. Traditional methods often lead to inefficiencies in resource utilization, pest control, and irrigation management. This paper introduces a hybrid machine learning framework integrating Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models with edge computing to enable real-time, site-specific decision-making. IoT sensors collect real-time data on soil moisture, temperature, and humidity, while aerial drones with multispectral imaging provide insights into crop health. XGBoost processes this data for soil health classification and pest risk prediction, achieving 92% accuracy. The hybrid CNN-LSTM model enhances irrigation and pest control predictions by 15% over standalone models, allowing farmers to make more precise, data-driven decisions. Field trials demonstrate a 25% increase in crop yield and a 30% reduction in water usage compared to conventional techniques. Edge computing ensures low-latency processing, enabling real-time implementation without cloud-based constraints. This research bridges the gap between real-time data acquisition, processing, and decision-making, offering a scalable, cost-effective solution for sustainable agriculture by reducing resource wastage, improving food security, and promoting environmentally responsible farming.

articleTitle: Time-Series Classification Using a CNN-LSTM Model with Attention, Autoencoder, and K-Fold Cross-Validation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Here, we propose a hybrid Deep Learning (DL) framework consisting of a Denoising Autoencoder (DAE), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and a custom Attention mechanism based on these classic models, capable of resolving sixth generation signal identification and localization. The model deals with both real and imaginary parts of the signals to achieve robustness, adopting advanced Data Augmentation (DA) and regularization techniques. When tested with k-fold cross-validation and learning rate optimization, it showed constant accuracy. This framework enables inductive learning to handle complicated 6G signals and thus can help enhance AI techniques in next-generation Wireless Communication Systems (WCS).

articleTitle: Ontology –Enriched Semantic Analysis framework: Enhancing Context-Aware Recommendation System
