publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the evolving world of e-commerce, there comes a critical need for improving product recommendation systems by making their recommendations more accurate and personalized to enhance user satisfaction for better sales. In the current study, a novelty Ontology-enriched Semantic Analysis Framework, OESAF, is developed that ensures improved context aware product recommendation system using an Amazon grocery dataset. The framework involves the design of elaborate ontologies for each product, including a wide variety of attributes, relationships, and semantic representations. Such ontologies are then processed, with the application of semantic learning techniques to gain an all-rounded understanding of products and user preference. It uses semantic similarity measures between the user profile ontology and ontologies of relevant products for highly matched product retrieval concerning both the explicit and inferred preferences of the user. The most important novelty of OESAF is its deep semantic processing capability, which enables the system to detect complex relationships and preferences beyond superficial data. This algorithm continuously learns from user interactions, improving ontologies to better provide more accurate recommendations by ranking organic products to get more priority. A list of personalized product recommendations sorted by an appropriateness score is generated.

articleTitle: Developing Sustainable Environment Against Air Pollution Impact Using AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Air pollution remains one of the most pressing global challenges, with multi-faceted consequences for human health, ecosystems, and cultural heritage. This review analyzes various aspects which is affecting the air quality and also explores the necessity for air quality prediction and delves deep into decoding multiple advanced Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms. The appraising has been performed on gases which predominantly contributes to the change in air quality. The article mainly focuses on the key pollutants such as NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and Particulate Matter (PM) which triggers more environmental damage and health risks. The utilization of Machine Learning (ML) Models and Deep Learning (DL) Models can be elevated by techniques namely data cleaning, feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning to presage air quality. Thereby, this paper highlights the importance of knowing the impact of air quality and steps to safeguard the environment from air pollution. The review aims to foster a cleaner, healthier, and more resilient future for communities worldwide, with a focus on long term sustainability and environmental stewardship.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Brain Tumor Classification Using DNN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor detection and classification are critical tasks in medical diagnosis, and the use of deep learning models has significantly improved performance in this domain. This paper presents a comparative analysis of eight prominent deep learning architectures—Custom CNN, GoogLeNet, AlexNet, VGG19, DenseNet, CapsNet, U-Net, and ResNet152— applied to the Brain Tumor MRI Dataset from Kaggle. The study evaluates the models, comparing their performances based on accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, among other performance metrics, in order to identify which one is the most effective in classifying MRI brain images into benign, malignant, and normal classes. Although previous works have individually shown the strengths of these models, this paper tries to make a comprehensive comparison in order to analyze their performance under similar conditions. The results show that deep convolutional architectures, such as DenseNet and ResNet, outperform others consistently with regard to classification accuracy, while U-Net performs exceptionally well for tumor segmentation.This study contributes to the growing body of research by highlighting the trade-offs between model complexity, accuracy, and computational requirements, ultimately guiding future research and clinical applications in brain tumor diagnosis.

articleTitle: Malware Detection through Memory Dump Analysis by Enhanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this new era of the digital world, cybersecurity remains a critical concern, demanding frequent updates to counter sophisticated malware such as Trojan horses, Spyware and Ransomware. These threats have reached to high levels, outpacing traditional detection methods. To address this challenge effectively, we propose an innovative approach that combines Gradient Boosting and Random Forest classifiers in a ensemble method. Our study focuses mainly on analyzing the system's memory to identify malware, which often uses conventional detection mechanisms. The hybrid algorithm examines the patterns and behaviors within the system's volatile memory, significantly enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of malware detection. This approach involves collecting and analyzing memory information from diverse digital environments, combining both known and unknown malware scenarios. Initially, we explored the accuracy of four machine learning algorithms: Naive Bayes, Random Forest Classifier, Decision Tree, and Extreme Gradient Boosting. Among these, Random Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting achieved an accuracy of 83.87% and 86.55% which was highest among the four machine learning models. Building on these results, we developed an ensemble method that blends Random Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting classifiers. Remarkably, this blended ensemble method achieved the highest accuracy of 87.88%. In conclusion, our proposed approach not only achieves a balanced accuracy but also computational efficiency in malware detection. These findings represent a significant advancement in memory-based malware detection techniques against the evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: Predicting Soil Moisture Using Gradient Boosting with Linear Base Learner and Tree-Based Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Soil moisture prediction plays a crucial role in agriculture and environmental monitoring by optimizing irrigation improving crop yield, and preserving water resources. The machine learning model is used to predict soil moisture. This work presents a hybrid, that combines Gradient Boosting with a linear base learner for soil moisture prediction. By including meteorological parameters such as temperature, humidity, and UV index, the model provides better predictive performance compared to the traditional Gradient Boosting Regressor, which also gives a higher accuracy and lower error rates. The hybrid model also improves generalization through balancing bias and variance, thus being more robust and less prone to overfitting. Hybrid models can identify complex patterns in data, but an individual model can overfit due to its complexity or because of poor regularization. The study emphasizes the role of hybrid models in potentially advancing agricultural and environmental decision-making by showing the practical applicability of simulated and predicted soil moisture values.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Pod Scheduling: Optimizing MERN and MEAN Stack Performance in Kubernetes
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Microservices architecture has become the foundation of modern application development, offering enhanced scalability, flexibility, and maintainability. This paper presents a comparative performance evaluation of two widely used JavaScript-based stacks, MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and MEAN (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js), deployed as microservices applications in Minikube, a local Kubernetes environment. While both stacks share a common backend technology stack, they differ in their front-end frameworks—React in MERN and Angular in MEAN—which influences their performance, scalability, and suitability for different application types. This study not only compares the architectural differences between MERN and MEAN but also introduces machine learning (ML)-based microservice optimization to enhance service instance selection and resource allocation in Kubernetes. The optimization leverages RF (Random Forest) and XGBoost ML algorithms for dynamic intelligent POD selection and scheduling, ensuring dynamic routing of microservice requests based on real-time performance metrics. Key evaluation criteria include latency, response time, CPU and memory utilization, scalability, and fault tolerance, monitored using Prometheus and Istio. The results provide insights into the efficiency of each stack in handling microservices workloads, helping developers and system architects choose the most suitable stack based on performance demands, resource constraints, and deployment complexity. The paper concludes with recommendations for optimizing microservices-based applications in Kubernetes environments using ML-driven orchestration strategies.

articleTitle: Enhanced Ensemble Modeling in Spatial and Temporal Data for Climate Change Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Precise climate prediction is important for comprehensively tackling urgent ecological problems, but typical models still battle with completely catching extraordinarily detailed trends. This research work thoroughly presents an ensemble-based methodology incorporating LSTM for each temporal datum in conjunction with CNN for each spatial attribute, thus heightening predictive correctness. The proposed model shows high precision by optimizing predictive accuracy extensively with ensemble techniques like stacking and increasing, achieving a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.78°C, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.57°C, and a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 1.99%. Also, an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 0.9063 points out the strong explanatory power. The Future work plans to extend the model to predict climate variables like precipitation and humidity, broadening the effect on climate forecasting.

articleTitle: Road Safety with Deep Learning Voice Based Traffic Sign
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The research deals with deep learning-based, voice-operated traffic sign recognition to improve road safety. A deep learning-based model is presented for the recognition of traffic signs with CNN, trained on GTSRB Dataset with an identification and categorization precision of 95%. The developed system detects signs and, through audio warnings by speakers, assists drivers to make quick decisions. The system aims to mitigate accidents caused by missed or misinterpreted signage by alerting drivers to nearby traffic signs and rules. This approach has potential applications in both driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Comparative Review of Artificial Intelligence Driven Deep Learning in Machine Vision, Healthcare, and Memory Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: A comparative analysis of three high-impact domains are machine vision and robotic vision, healthcare prediction systems, and memory processing for deep neural networks (DNNs), which have the advancements of deep learning and machine learning. Object detection, human action recognition, and semantic segmentation are the applications of machine and robotic vision, which are becoming more precise due to advanced neural architectures. Machine learning provides robust tools, particularly in healthcare and in pregnancy, for improving maternal outcomes by predicting preeclampsia. Meanwhile, to address the traditional memory bottlenecks in DNN processing, an Artificial intelligence-driven technology called processing-in-memory (PIM) can be used, resulting in faster computation and increased energy efficiency. This comparative analysis works on applications, algorithmic structures, performance metrics, hardships, and future directions of the machine and robotic vision, healthcare, and memory processing of AI are also extensively discussed systematically. The novelty of this work depends on its interdisciplinary approach, bringing together advances in machine vision, healthcare, and PIM to address common challenges like dataflow management, interpretation of models, and energy efficiency. It mainly focuses on cross-domain solutions and emerging trends, providing a unique viewpoint on long-term and scalable AI applications across a wide range of fields.

articleTitle: The Impact of Immersive Virtual and Augmented Reality on Medical Field: A Review of Cognitive Load, Learning Efficiency, and Practical Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper describes how AR is transformed into healthcare, particularly when viewed from the perspective of medical imaging, surgical precision, and education, and examines how this integration is done, demonstrating its potential for enhancing clinical practice, engagement of patients, and customized interventions. Thus, AR combined with VR, AI, and robotics will open a new door for healthcare delivery, educational, and training revolutions. The main drawbacks include regulatory challenges, high costs, and clinical validation. This needs further research on this area to move forward. Cognitive load measuring using AR is another important aspect of user experience which removes the traditional method on performance tests or subjective ratings. The use of non-invasive sensors has been combined with physiological measures in recent times. An example is eye-tracking, which will provide us with real-time data of cognitive load; but it is still uneven, and we require a multi-method approach to overcome this. AR and immersive VR are together known as XR technologies. XR is used in medical education, and it is absorbed that it increases knowledge gain much higher in comparison to traditional learning resources in anatomy learning. A Cross-study analysis on students showed that 80% of participants reporting a positive learning experience on XR. Collectively we need intensive research to maximize its impact and address regulatory, developmental, and cognitive considerations.

articleTitle: Predictive modeling for early dyslexia severity assessment in children using ML algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Dyslexia is a widespread learning disorder that impacts a child's reading ability, writing, and comprehension skills, thereby affecting their capacity to read words, spell, and comprehend written material. Early detection is important since early intervention enhances learning. This study introduces a predictive model with a view to detecting dyslexia levels in children through guided quizzes and surveys carried out under parental supervision. The process of assessment has a two-stage process, and it starts with a series of initial questions that test the language ability of the child, patterns of reading, and intellectual capacity. Depending on these answers, the model pinpoints children who are likely to be dyslexic. They are then advised to undergo a second, more in-depth assessment, which helps to narrow down the diagnosis by examining certain indicators more closely. The primary objective of this model is to allow for early identification, thus allowing parents and teachers to implement suitable learning approaches and interventions. Through the identification of dyslexia at its early stages, the model seeks to improve educational support systems to enable children to acquire proper reading skills and enhance their academic performance as a whole.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Learning Framework Utilizing Xception and CNNs for Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy in the Precise Classification of Brain Tumors from MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor is regarded as one of the most aggressive diseases, affecting both children and adults. Tumors constitute 85 to 90 percent of all primary Central Nervous System (CNS) tumors. Approximately 250,000 new cases are reported annually, necessitating innovative diagnostic solutions to address the challenges associated with traditional methods. Brain tumors can lead to severe complications if not diagnosed early, making early detection crucial for effective treatment. Traditional diagnostic approaches, including manual MRI interpretation, often suffer from subjectivity and variability in expertise among radiologists, which can result in misdiagnosis and delayed treatment. This research paper presents a comprehensive novel deep-learning framework designed to classify brain tumor MRI scans into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. Utilizing a dataset comprising 7,022 MRI images sourced from multiple repositories—including Figshare, SARTAJ, and Br35H, a novel framework is proposed by implementing a multi-task classification strategy using CNNs alongside Xception Learning to detect tumors, classify them based on malignancy and type, and identify their locations within the brain. The proposed framework achieves a training accuracy of 98.13% with a training loss of 0.1675. In comparison, validation and test accuracies were 95.11% and 93.60%, respectively with precision and recall metrics exceeding 90% for most classifications, supported by confusion matrices demonstrating strong classification capabilities. Grad-CAM techniques produce saliency maps that explain the parts affecting model predictions to understand them better. Additionally, the intended novel framework is developed via an interactive web application built via Streamlit that will allow the users to input their own MRI scans for real-time classification that will give them all the outputs, ranging from predicted tumor class up to probabilities of all the four types of tumors presented as a bar graph format along with novel saliency maps highlighting the critical areas of scans and confidence scores for each prediction. This research brings deep learning potential techniques in transforming the detection and classification of a brain tumor. It results in better achievements for the patient by obtaining prompt and precise diagnosis while overcoming the constraints of the conventional manual method.

articleTitle: Enhancing Workforce Productivity through Machine Learning: An Analysis of Adaptive Training Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The study aims to determine whether machine learning (ML)-based or conventional training approaches are more effective at boosting worker productivity, skill retention, and engagement. It used the mixed-method research approach where the data is collected from 150 employees working within 10 organizations that adopt technology in various sectors of work, with the intent of evaluating productivity, skill retention, and performance. Training with the aid of ML results in increased productivity by 40% and retention of information by 30%. The employee engagement rate increased remarkably by 90% during the end of the training than the outcomes of the conventional training methods. Such results, therefore, significantly enhance skill development and labor optimization through proof that models based on ML can be applied in modern work environments. The paper further suggests applications of AI-based models for staff development aside from the rapidly increasing number of studies demonstrating the potential of ML for corporate training.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Autonomous Robots for Search and Rescue Operations in Disaster Zones
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Search and rescue (SAR) operations designed to save lives in disaster zones face difficulties executing effectively because of dangerous surroundings and challenging terrain features. An AI-controlled robotic system exists to deal with existing challenges. The system combines a reinforcement learning-based navigation system that integrates multiple sensors including LiDAR with thermal cameras and RGB sensors for detecting victims to work with decentralized task distribution frameworks. Real-time simulations tested disaster navigation datasets showing an overall detection accuracy rate of 95.6%, navigation accuracy at 92.8%, while obstacle avoidance performed at 97.2%. This deployed system achieved 3.2-minute average response times and processed requests with 85.4% resource efficiency. The system proves superior performance over existing SAR methods while demonstrating speed enhancement, accuracy improvement, and autonomous operational value in SAR operations. Future disaster response will change thanks to AI-powered robotics because this technology enables scalable efficient reliable solutions for future deployments.

articleTitle: E-Learning Privacy in the Context of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The present paper discusses the privacy issues associated with the usage of machine learning in e-learning systems. Although ML is a promising technology that increases personalization and engagement, it also poses significant security concerns in terms of gathering and using sensitive data. E-learning platforms are vulnerable to problems such as breaches, unauthorized access, and misutilization of personal information. The paper addresses two major concerns: recommendation engines and predictive performance systems, which emphasize the weaknesses and shortcomings in current data privacy and protection measures. In an attempt to address these challenges, the paper develops a privacy-preserving framework based on federated learning and data anonymization technologies. Together, these technologies work in the decentralization of data storage and reduction of exposure yet provide personalized experiences. There is a comparative study that will analyze whether such solutions could help improve data privacy and at the same time maintain functionality in ML. Finally, a balance between security and user experience is brought into discussion, but this time it puts emphasis on the need to have personalization without sacrificing privacy. The final result is a framework for privacy that supports the fulfillment of laws like GDPR, while in the meantime maintaining the best of the personalization that this brings with the ML approach so that an effective solution towards modern e-learning systems can be availed.

articleTitle: Advanced Offensive Language Detection with mT5 and User-Centric Features
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: With the emergence of diverse languages, cultural nuances, and code-mixed content, detecting offensive language on social media has become critical. This paper addresses these challenges with the help of the multilingual T5 (mT5) model, which has been fine-tuned to detect offensive language in code-mixed multilingual texts. The system is designed as a browser-based web extension that offers real-time detection by blurring or concealing offensive content, which leads to continuous improvement. It also integrates user-centric features that enable users to provide feedback on the accuracy of offensive content detection and report any instances of offensive language that go undetected, supporting continuous enhancement. This user-centric approach presents an accurate, efficient, and context-aware offensive language detection experience, which leads to safer and more secure online environments for different communities.

articleTitle: IOT and NLP based Voice Assistant for Visual Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The visual impaired face a lot of limitations in today's culture where independence is crucial. The blind suffer from a disadvantage since they have to receive manual assistance to explore their surroundings. In addition to walking, eating, conversing with a group of people, etc., it can be challenging for someone with impaired vision to accomplish many necessary daily tasks. There has been a significant increase in the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) over the past few years because many professions require visual information. A voice assistant can converse with humans in natural language through cloud computing, and they unify AI through natural language processing.A voice assistant is most commonly used in smart speakers. In order to determine whether there is a connection between voice assistants and smart speakers and mental health, the study examined how voice assistants and smart speakers are used in daily life. In order to assist the blind, this test could serve as a study for a variety of computational, speech-recognition, and image-recognition approaches. Using Android smartphones, people who are blind can interact with their surroundings using voice commands, environment recognition, and feedback. The proposal is designed to create a single device solution that is simple, fast, accurate, and cost-effective. A number of remedies have been put forward after thorough research into each issue. However, all problems are not resolved simultaneously. A visionblind individual can see, hear, and speak with the technology, increasing their independence and confidence. People with visual impairments frequently seek outside assistance while making judgments. This proposal aims to aid blind people in overcoming their lack of visual perception by utilizing other senses, such as sound and touch.

articleTitle: Smart and Sustainable Tourism Development : Contention convenience and accessibility using Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is well acknowledged in the tourist and hotel industries for its ability to provide new business possibilities. The tourist and hospitality businesses may use IoT to improve client experiences, streamline operations, and raise profits. The modern tourist business faces tremendous obstacles, such as environmental deterioration, cultural disturbance, and socioeconomic disparities. This study investigates the innovative use of modern technology as a holistic solution to these difficulties, propelling the tourist industry in the direction of a more supportable future. Artificial intelligence appears as an important enabler for improving tourist operations and decision-making processes. Including this new technology into any company model offers several benefits, but there are also risks and challenges to consider, such as security and confidentiality. The objective of this paper is to explain how the Internet of Things (IoT) can transform how the tourist sector operates, as well as to offer readers with some of the industry's best market practices, trends, and data. Furthermore, IoT devices improve visitor safety and happiness by providing contextually relevant services. Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) technology gave attractive experiences that change the way travellers engage with sites. AR enhances the cultural and historical context of sites and provides virtual tourist experiences. The findings highlight the possibility for a technology-driven strategy to redefining tourist practices while assuring long lasting environmental, social, and economic sustainability.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Cardiac Segmentation with Swish-U-Net and Optimizer Innovation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading global cause of death, responsible for 17.9 million deaths annually and accounting for 32% of global mortality in 2024. As the incidence of CVD rises, the need for advanced diagnostic tools increases. Cardiac image segmentation plays a key role in accurate diagnosis by visualizing cardiac structures. This study optimizes the U-Net architecture for segmentation by incorporating the Swish activation function to improve performance. We use the "Automatic Cardiac Diagnosis Challenge" (ACDC) dataset of 150 CMRI recordings to focus on the left ventricular cavity, myocardium, and right ventricle for segmentation. We compare five optimizers—Adam, SGD, Nadam, RMSprop, and Adagrad—using metrics such as accuracy, IoU, Jaccard distance, and Dice coefficient. The results show that using both Swish activation and the optimal optimizer together improves the accuracy of segmentation. This makes diagnostics more accurate and helps find cardiovascular disease early.

articleTitle: Decoding Digital Emotions: Navigating Abusive Comments with Ethical and Legal Safeguards
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study presents a vigorous sentiment analysis framework to classify clients' comments into positive, neutral, or negative sentiments, pointed at handling the challenges of linguistic complexity, information imbalance, and client protection. The investigation coordinates profound learning models such as LSTM, CNN, and BERT. Text comments are processed utilizing tokenization, lemmatization, and vectorization, whereas audio comments are changed over into spectrograms for investigation utilizing CNNs. The system ensures scalability and real-time processing through structured databases and API integration, adhering to data privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA. The discoveries highlight the model's high accuracy in opinion classification, its adaptability to advancing language trends, and its adequacy in identifying offensive content. This research offers a scalable and ethical solution to real-time sentiment analysis, enhancing user safety and informed decision-making. The framework has broad applications, observing open estimation and fostering safer digital interactions on social platforms.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using MRI with ResNet50 and Hybrid AI Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper tackles the critical challenge of detecting brain tumors using MRI images, a vital task in medical diagnostics that requires both high accuracy and clear interpretability. While deep learning has achieved significant milestones in medical image analysis, there remains a pressing need for approaches that combine precision with transparency for medical practitioners. Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often perceived as black-box models, offering limited insights into their decision-making processes. To address this issue, the study proposes a method leveraging the enhanced ResNet50 deep learning model to create a comprehensible framework for brain tumor diagnosis. Utilizing an enhanced MRI image dataset for optimized model training, the approach achieved an impressive testing accuracy of 98.89%, with recall, precision, and related metrics exceeding 99%. These exceptional results demonstrate the model's effectiveness in accurately identifying malignancies. The enhanced interpretability and superior accuracy present significant potential for advancing diagnostic tools, paving the way for more transparent and reliable methods in brain tumor detection.

articleTitle: Treatment of Class Imbalance Problem in Noisy Dataset using SMART-SMOTE
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Class imbalance poses a significant challenge in machine learning, often leading to biased models. Traditional oversampling techniques like SMOTE, ADASYN, and Borderline-SMOTE address this issue but face limitations such as presence of noisy points, poor neighbor selection, and irrelevant feature inclusion. This paper introduces SMART-SMOTE, a novel approach that mitigates these issues by removing noisy points, selecting relevant features, and using a dissimilarity-based neighbour selection mechanism. Gaussian noise is added to enhance robustness and generalization. Experiments on the Statlog German Credit and Online Shoppers’ Purchasing Intention datasets show that SMART-SMOTE outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and F1 score, effectively addressing class imbalance across diverse datasets and real-world applications like fraud detection and medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Enhancing PAN Card Security with OCR Based Information Extraction and Face Recognition for Reliable Identity Verification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Due to the potential for impersonation, the Indian PAN card is of great importance and thus, it should be encrypted with certain methods. The paper proposes a system that deals for achieving greater security of PAN card by applying a combination of OCR based information extraction and face recognition system as a means of securing identity verification. A set of OCR algorithms is first entrusted with the task to accurately read and translate the text found on the PAN card which includes the, date of birth, name and the PAN number, along with other features. The digitized and translated data is easier to store and retrieve, which makes the verification process quicker. Furthermore, a deep learning face recognition module is added in a bid to match the face of the PAN card holder with the face on the card. The proposed system is based on the architecture of the convolutional neural network (CNN) which has been shown to perform well in systems that need to compare in different amounts of light and at different angles making it reduce both the false acceptance and the false rejection rates. This article emphasizes the need for cutting-edge technologies to be implemented in identity verification systems, as identity fraud can be avoided through the use of Computerized Optical character recognition technology (OCR) combined with face recognition technology that provides advanced scanning capabilities advanced scanning capabilities that assist in safeguarding the PAN card.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Data Security and Privacy through AI-Driven Encryption and Privacy-Preserving Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The use of digital patient data in health management to meet scientific and analytical requirements is now well established, while ensuring the confidentiality and availability of patient information has emerged as a significant issue. The suggested approach is to integrate AI with the traditional encryption techniques to produce a blend of qualitative and automated encryption methods thus making a dynamic encryption environment that adapts with the level of data sensitivity and the kind of users’ access. Furthermore, the approach also incorporate the use of privacy-preserving methodologies including differential privacy, federated learning, and homomorphic encryption, to allow collaboration in the analysis and research of patient data in a more secure manner while preserving the patient’s privacy. The methodology also involves the use of artificial intelligence for intrusion detection and also compliance management to guarantee sustained compliance and security, and legal frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR. The findings of the evaluation show that with the help of the proposed AI-based encryption, it is possible to achieve better security outcomes compared with common methods and reduce the probability of both privacy threats and false alarm violations while enhancing the system’s performance. Additionally, compliance works well to automate the compliance jobs and relieve the healthcare organizations from the time-consuming duties. Naturally, this work presents a robust, and scalable means of protecting healthcare data while at the same time ensuring that the data can still be processed in a manner that benefits the healthcare system.

articleTitle: Epileptic zonal the EEG signals and MRI scans are used for accurately detecting theepileptic zone using Machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The proposed work is an advanced machine learning techniques that aids in detecting epileptic zones using a combination of electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), emphasizing the integration of signal processing algorithms for improved accuracy. Various methodologies, including Independent Component Analysis (ICA), Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC), and Adaptive Spatial Filters (beam formers), are evaluated to benchmark and enhance the detection of seizure onset zones within the brain. The research underscores the importance of robust data acquisition and preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality signal processing, thereby improving the reliability of zonal detection. The proposed algorithm, demonstrates that EEG and MRI integration allow for better spatial and temporal localization of epileptic activities. The results indicate that techniques such as high-density EEG and adaptive spatial filtering provide detailed insights into brain function during seizure events, while ICA effectively isolates significant signal components, reducing artifacts and improving detection sensitivity to 95%.

articleTitle: Accurate Human Stress Detection from Sleeping Habits Using a Hybrid Ensemble of Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Preventing a variety of health problems and preserving well-being depend on effective stress identification and management. Recently, machine learning has gained attention for its potential in stress detection, especially by analyzing physiological and behavioral indicators. This paper presents a new framework for human stress detection by examining sleeping habits through an advanced hybrid machine learning (ML) model. The proposed model integrates five diverse algorithms—Logistic Regression (LR), Gradient Boosting (GB), Random Forest (RF), AdaBoost (AB), and Support Vector Classifier (SVC)—using a soft voting mechanism. By combining these models, the approach capitalizes on each algorithm's strengths, enabling it to detect subtle patterns in sleep metrics that may indicate stress. Key features used in the model include sleep duration, snoring rate, respiration rate, and body temperature. We tested the model on a dataset containing sleep information from individuals with different stress levels. Results show that this hybrid approach surpasses individual models in terms of accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score, establishing a reliable tool for stress detection based on sleep behavior.

articleTitle: Shaping The Future of Education with Generative AI: Potential, Challenges, and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Generative AI transforms education by making learning experiences better and more personalized. GAI overcomes some of the problems in traditional teaching by providing tools like ChatGPT and GANs, which create smart learning systems, design instructional materials, and provide interactive, engaging experiences. GAI is the key to supporting educators to automate resources, provide personal content, and focus on creativity and critical thinking. Its size of growth and adaptability can fill in any kind of knowledge gap, specifically in distressful regions for applications related to skill development, translation of languages, medical learning, and virtual teaching. Interoperability with VR and the metaverse modernizes education further. The issues in this are data collection, biases in algorithms, and the human interaction is reduced. That would require explainable algorithms and robust data protection. Policymakers, educators, and technologists must be in a joint effort to see that GAI is used justly. Democratized education, lifelong learning, and inclusive future promises GAI as they blend technology with pedagogy to reap maximum benefits and risks.

articleTitle: AI Personalized Mental Health Monitoring System using Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study introduces an AI-driven customized mental health monitoring system that uses machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) to provide ongoing mental health evaluation and assistance. The system uses user-generated textual data, including journal entries, chat logs, and social media postings, to assess emotional states, stress levels, and mental health issues. The system uses sophisticated natural language processing methods to identify linguistic patterns associated with mental health problems such as depression, anxiety, and others. The machine learning algorithms customize monitoring by adjusting to the unique characteristics of each user and use past data to provide customized suggestions and preemptive alerts. The technology aims to enhance human interaction and function as a proactive tool in mental health treatment by providing real-time information. The system extracts emotional indicators from textual input using sentiment analysis methods and pre-trained natural language processing models such as BERT. The results are used with user demographics and history to build machine learning classifiers, such as Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM), which predict mental health disorders. Supervised learning is used to develop the model, and suggestions are progressively improved using a tailored feedback system. The SVM and RF algorithms demonstrated an 88% and 92%accuracy rate in forecasting mood swings and early warning indicators of mental health disorders when evaluated on a set of anonymized mental health information. The 30% increase in user involvement demonstrated the efficacy of tailored suggestions in proactive mental health treatment.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Phishing Detection and Analysis: A Foundational Review
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Phishing is a common cyberthreat that takes advantage of human weaknesses to get private data, such as bank account information, company secrets, and login passwords, without authorization and is driven by the advancements in Artificial Intelligence. In this research, a variety of phishing strategies are examined and categorised according to their technological sophistication, target specificity, and distribution mechanisms. Alongside more sophisticated strategies like spear phishing, clone phishing, and pharming, common techniques like email phishing, smishing (SMS phishing), and vishing (voice phishing) are examined. AI-generated phishing attempts are also covered in the article. Emerging trends like the deployment of deepfakes, social media manipulation. A comparison of each technique's efficacy and detection difficulties reveals how phishing threats are constantly changing. The article concludes by going over current countermeasures, such as user education, sophisticated detection tools, incorporation of Artificial Intelligence in existing methods and adaptive frameworks for cybersecurity, highlighting the necessity of a multifaceted strategy to reduce these risks. This article offers a thorough grasp of phishing tactics and guides the creation of strong defences by combining current research with real-world case studies.

articleTitle: News Article Analysis Chatbot using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The News Analysis Chatbot provides insightful analysis on current events through the generative AI, thus realizing real-time summaries, in-depth analyses of detailed data, and even the perspectives of most matters with all fairness to every aspect concerned. A new tool that ensures you are in the know about current happenings such that you acquire a comprehensive understanding of issues that might otherwise become quagmired. From the generative AI powered analysis of news articles, a changing and intelligent solution for the ability to analyze news content and summarize it. Due to the nature of the advanced NLP techniques used by the chatbot, it is capable of reading and understanding the articles, spotting the main ideas, extracting insights, producing and summarizing user preferences. This will enable users to extract coherent, up-to-the-minute summaries of either lengthy or complicated news articles within an extremely short amount of time. It allows the chatbot to move out of static response spaces by having an interactive discussion about the news, answering follow-up questions, providing context, and offering critical analysis. It can even compare articles within related topics, hint at trends, and even suggest additional readings to enrich the user’s understanding of events. Additionally, it learns the interest of the individual, suggesting articles based on previous interactions. We have introduced the News Research Tool, which is able to extract and process news articles via large language models (LLM). The software takes multiple news article URLs to analyze the news content and an open number of specific questions of the input articles. We deploy Streamlit to design an intuitively-operational user interface and to store the application. We utilize FAISS and a stream to tackle vector-based retrieval and Hugging Face embeddings to let search capture the most relevant context. Lastly, Streamlit Cloud hosts that we deploy our app so that it is accessible as a web application.

articleTitle: An Intelligent IOT-Enabled Smart Diaper System With AI-Driven Health Monitoring For Infant Care
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Neonatal care is incomplete without infant hygiene and health monitoring, but conventional diapers are not equipped with real-time sensing, which may cause discomfort, rashes, and even infection due to the prolonged contact with moisture. This paper suggests an AI-based smart diaper system with the incorporation of moisture and temperature sensors along with IoT-based wireless communication for real-time monitoring. The system repeatedly monitors for levels of moisture, temperature changes, and urinal patterns, giving caregivers real-time notifications through a mobile app or cloud portal. Machine learning software is utilized in predicting diaper levels of saturation as well as for analyzing urination trends to prepare for future changes and enhanced care for the infants. By applying low-power embedded technology, the system manages its energy efficiently but with high levels of accuracy when detecting moisture. Analysis by AI enables early detection of possible health problems like dehydration or urinary tract infection (UTI), and edge computing preserves privacy with decreased latency through data processing at the edge. Experimental tests show high accuracy in detection with low false positives, and it is tested to show its practicality for real-world deployment. Future advancements involve the creation of biodegradable, ultra-slim sensors for enhanced comfort, wireless charging technology for longer device life, and enhanced AI capabilities for sophisticated health diagnostics. The smart diaper design can also be applied to the elderly care and medical fields, solving hospital and residential care incontinence issues. With the integration of IoT, AI, and smart sensing technologies, the research offers an intelligent, sustainable solution for the management of infant hygiene, enhancing the development of AI-based healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph-Based Effective Cardiovascular Disease Treatment Using BEHRT: A Deep Learning Approach with EHR Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Integrating deep learning into healthcare has significantly improved clinical predictions, personalized interventions, and patient outcomes. The ability of BEHRT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers for Electronic Health Records) to model temporal dependencies and capture complex relationships from patient medical records makes it particularly effective for predicting disease progression and outcomes. By encoding sequential information from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), BEHRT can analyse a patient's health trajectory over time, enabling more accurate early disease detection and personalized treatment strategies. Its transformer-based architecture allows for understanding patient data, including diagnosis codes, treatments, and other clinical features, which are critical for tailored interventions. In this study, the MIMIC-III dataset was used, and the application of BEHRTs to the cardiovascular disease subset was demonstrated. This approach showed a significant advancement in clinical predictions. The model effectively processed the large, unstructured, and semi-structured data, identifying key trends in disease progression and enhancing its ability to predict future health outcomes for patients with cardiovascular conditions. Additionally, we used a knowledge graph to represent the model’s insights into cardiovascular disease treatment and medication pathways. This graph highlighted key relationships between treatments and patient outcomes, serving as a valuable tool for clinical decision-making. BEHRT’s scalability and precision in handling vast amounts of structured health data underscore its potential to improve diagnosis, treatment planning, and overall patient care. Its application in cardiovascular disease showcases its broader utility across multiple medical domains, contributing to better healthcare outcomes and more personalized interventions.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The brain's unchecked and fast cell development fuels a tumor. It may prove lethal if left untreated in the early stages. Accurate segmentation and classification remain difficult despite many noteworthy efforts and promising results. The differences in the tumor size, form, and proportions make brain tumor detection extremely difficult. The primary goal of this study is to provide researchers with a thorough literature review on the use of magnetic resonance (MR) imaging in diagnosing brain malignancies. This study suggested multiple methods for detecting tumors and brain cancer using statistical image processing and artificial intelligence. An assessment matrix for a certain system employing particular systems and dataset kinds is also displayed in this study. The anatomy of brain tumors, available data sets, augmentation techniques, component extraction, and classification between machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models are also explained in this work. Lastly, the study gathers all pertinent information for identifying and comprehending tumors, including their advantages, disadvantages, developments, and future trends. In this study, an attempt is made to classify the tumors using CNNs.

articleTitle: Computer vision based efficient real-time lighting control with Haar-cascade classifier
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: World energy requirement has steadily increased due to population growth, urbanization, and industrial advancement. The rise of smart cities and the need for energy-efficient systems is pushing significant advancements in intelligent lighting control technology. A key feature of these systems is their ability to control lighting of a premises according to the presence or movement of persons in certain areas. Computer vision-based object detection is a modern approach in advance lighting control system. Real-time lighting control with computer vision enables automated adjustments is not only reducing energy consumption but also enhancing user experience. This article is about implementation and analysis of lighting control, which is based on the Haar-Cascade classifier to improve energy efficiency through human occupancy detection. The developed system is simplified, efficient in computation, scalable, and modular. The Arduino-based control unit regulates lights via relay, according to human occupancy sensing. This research highlights the application of camera-based identification and motion tracking, illustrating the potential of intelligent energy-saving technology to significantly contribute to climate change mitigation and the establishment of a sustainable, eco-friendly future.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Framework for Osteoarthritis Diagnosis Using Advanced Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In addition to bone most cancers and other diseases, it isn't always unusual for people to be afflicted by fractures because of trauma or different motives. Fractures can arise in any bone in our body, including the ankle, heel, wrist, hip, ribs, foot, and chest. And greater. Fractures are not seen to the naked eye on an X-ray or CT test. However, those photographs are every so often insufficient for analysis. Nowadays, picture processing plays an essential role in fracture detection. Image processing is important for the storage and transmission of up-to-date facts, in particular for contemporary picture alternate, video coding (telephone conversation), digital libraries, photograph databases, and remote sensing. This article invites you to find out the imaging techniques used to stumble on fractures. This paper discusses the artwork of fracture detection the usage of new strategies to enhance image processing and fracture detection. This article affords the generation used to increase the photographic tool to intrusion detection gadgets, their blessings and drawbacks. Accuracy is the epoch value associated with a median value between 0.7 and zero.88, and we will recall an education mode with a model stored in h5 with many samples.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Human Psychological factors vs AI cognitive factors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study investigates the comparative analysis of human psychological factors by considering factors such as mood, memory and motivation against AI cognitive factors such performance, memory and optimization through correlation simulation and statistical evaluation. The goal was to explore the dynamics between these factors, assess their correlations, and examine the differences in their behavior and learning patterns. The MAS(Multi-Agent Simulation) model was developed using R Programming, which simulates 500 steps of behavioral updates of both human and AI agents. Each factor was modeled with random fluctuations to imitate the real-world emotional and cognitive processes. The simulation results show that human mood and AI performance exhibit a positive correlation. While ANOVA test shows there is significant difference in memory capacity. And motivation factor in Humans is easier than optimization of an AI.

articleTitle: Analysis on Skin Disease Segmentation and Classification using Machine Learning and Deep Learning in Dermoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Skin diseases (SDs), particularly skin cancer, are leading causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide, with early detection being crucial for improving patient outcomes. Dermoscopy, a non-invasive imaging technique, is commonly used for evaluating skin lesions, but its analysis requires expertise and is time-consuming. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) methods have shown promise in automating the Segmentation process and Classification process of SDs (SCSD) using dermoscopic images. This review examines traditional ML algorithms and advanced DL architectures like Convolutional Neural Network model (CNNs), U-Net, and transfer learning (TL) approaches. Key challenges include dataset imbalances, the need for large labeled datasets, and the generalization of models across diverse skin types and lesion variations. The review also discusses common evaluation metrics and the strengths and limitations of current methods. By providing an overview of existing research, the paper aims to guide the development of more efficient and robust ML and DL models, advancing automated SD diagnosis and contributing to telemedicine and dermatology’s early diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Freelancer Compensation: A Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study focussed on freelancers, particularly in the delivery sector, where delivery-based wages are common. This analysis interprets and provides an accurate amount of wages for the freelancers and embeds mathematical modeling for calculating hourly wages with Non-linear transformations, hybrid modeling for parameters and representing graphical methods, and comprising the data of the real-time scenario in the prevailing job market. The Embedding Machine Learning model features a Random Forest Algorithm which predicts the hourly wages of each employee and controls overfitting. The proposed solution provides an efficient wage prediction and obtains a high performance. Furthermore, providing the model, is user-friendly, which allows employees to input their performance metrics, and obtain real-time predictions of hourly wages. Real-time tracking tools help ensure hourly work, providing actionable knowledge for workers and businesses and data-driven insights to enhance worker experiences. Furthermore, the bridge gap between the freelancers and the job market includes, providing hourly wages for freelancers in the on-demand service gig economy, providing advanced search functionality using Artificial Intelligence in the Machine learning model, Time tracking, embarking comprehensive portfolios, and profiles will enhance visibility and trust between freelancers and employers. The intercession aims to develop a gig economy ecosystem, bridging existing gaps and strengthening long-term sustainability in the freelancer’s community. This research concludes that providing per hourly wages, for each freelancer and increasing the sustainable gig economy in the community.

articleTitle: Improving Question Answering Systems Using Knowledge Graph Integration and NLP Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: QA systems have become the best-sought-after for correct and context-relevant information in one or the other domain of interest. Nevertheless, such systems have some drawbacks, for example they experience difficulties in solving multilevel queries, misunderstanding anamolies, and giving correct answers. This work aims at improving QA systems by incorporating KGs with the state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools. The use of Knowledge Graphs in the system leads to the enhancement of comprehension of the context and relationship of entities increasing the relevance of answers given. There are techniques for mapping the query terms to the appropriate entities in the KG, techniques for identifying relations that associate queried terms, and transformer models, including BERT and GPT, for contextual semiotics. Also, query rewriting and semantic parsing approaches are used for enhancing the user query to get more relevant to the KG data. A class of graph neural networks (GNNs) are used to perform improved comparative analysis and multi-hop traversal of the graph. Question decomposition and attention mechanisms are used to split the given question into separate sub-questions, and also to point at preferable parts of the knowledge graph. The proposed system proves to handle complex and multi-hop queries far much better compared to the existing systems with marked improvements on the accuracy of results, response time and end user satisfaction. The experimental outcomes corroborate the effectiveness of the approach and demonstrate its applicability to development for open-domain and specific domain QA systems.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for books using Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper analyses how GNNs is, GraphSAGE specifically can help develop a trustworthy book recommender system. It focuses on user-book interactions as a bipartite graph where users, and books are nodes connected via edges that represent these interactions or ratings. Using the Book-Crossing Dataset, where metadata are available, like ISBN, title, author, year, and also user demographics such as age, GraphSAGE model effectively aggregates information from the neighbouring nodes in order to learn embeddings which capture the user preferences, book attributes, and patterns of interactions. This is superior over traditional methods of collaborative filtering and matrix factorization because it deals with sparsity issues. Evaluation results (RMSE: 0.4818, MSE: 0.2321, MAE: 0.2872) show that the model is able to make accurate recommendations. This is further supported by visualizations of training loss and ratings distribution. This work shows the potential of GNNs, especially GraphSAGE, in improving recommendation systems. Future directions include scalability, time dynamics, and multi-modal data integration for enhanced personalization.

articleTitle: End-To-End Encryption Solution for Social Media Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Social media platforms have become essential, for global communication and content exchange in the digital era. One of the most effective security measures for mobile networks is end-to-end encryption. The goal of this review paper is to investigate secure end-to-end encryption technologies in mobile networks. It presents an analysis of cryptography ideas, such as symmetric and asymmetric encryption techniques. It also covers the key technologies used in this process, including end-to-end encryption and decentralized data storage, and describes encrypted communication in a decentralized manner based on blockchains. By fusing blockchain technology with decentralized encrypted communication and decentralized data storage, this strategy transforms the conventionally based digital communication method and offers end users a new means of communication. The most common method for implementing high system throughput, according to its analysis, is steganography, whereas the most likely category for implementing standard security algorithms with low system throughput is modem-based cryptography. Pattern matching of encrypted data and privacy-preserving methods are briefly explained in the study, along with chaotic cryptography for secure voice communication. However these new technologies have drawbacks, such as restricted scalability and blockchain technology’s low efficiency, which could hinder their chances for the future.

articleTitle: Mental Healthcare Chatbots: Technological Advancements, Challenges, and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Mental healthcare chatbots are artificially intelligent systems that have been built with the intent of simulating human conversation and provide emotional support to one’s user. They are also widely used as tools to help individuals cope with the stress, anxiety, and other mental health challenges they have been facing, including easily accessible and affordable solutions. These chatbots use NLP and emotion recognition technology to assist users in understanding their feelings and responding accordingly. This review unpacks the latest advancements of recently developed chatbots, such as GPT-4-based models, BERT and MBERT based models, sentiment analysis, and the study of multimodal systems combining text, voice, and facial expression recognition. Also addressed are important challenges, including privacy concerns, cultural inclusivity, and clinical validation. Finally, the review identifies opportunities to improve chatbots, including supporting multi-language and primary telehealth platforms and customizing user interaction with chatbots to create more inclusive and effective mental health support worldwide.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Detecting FTP Exploits: Integrating Isolation Forest and LSTM for Enhanced Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In this paper, we respond to the rising security concerns that are cyber threats against broadly implemented protocols like FTP as prerequisites of the contemporary interconnected systems. Among all these threats, a vulnerability can threaten FTP servers and rather become dangerous for organizations. More specifically, current detection methods that hold so much promise, like the signature-based approach, are no longer effective because they cannot evolve in response to new forms of attacks or new patterns of exploitation. In response to these challenges, we propose a novel concept, a two model-based system that combines Isolation Forest (IF) for static feature anomalies and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for sequential analysis anomalies in FTP traffics. This approach of IF-LSTM combination takes advantage of both architectures that facilitate accurate identification of both inherent intrusions and temporal attack patterns in real time. Substantial tests are performed on a CICIDS2017 dataset to validate that the proposed model achieves considerable detection rates and surpasses conventional detection approaches. Based on our findings, it is possible to implement feature-based and sequential methods to address the challenging cyber threats and represent a robust answer to protecting FTP servers.

articleTitle: AI and IoT based Mobile Application for Women Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: As the number of offenses committed against women continues to rise, women's security has become an incredible thing. Unacceptable levels of physical violence towards women can be found in all regions of the globe. Due to ineffective monitoring, this has picked up speed. There is currently no viable option to address this issue. The current crop of apps and gadgets is largely ineffective because they require so much user input. Our work is an attempt to address this issue. We create a mobile application to keep women safe. There are two phases to this study. In the first phase, sensor data under both high-and no-risk scenarios are used to train the Artificial Intelligence (AI) model and then tested. K-Nearest Neighbour (kNN) and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) are selected as the AI model. An evaluation will be conducted to determine which of the two models performs better. Successful models are then deployed to the cloud. In the second stage, we employed temperature and pulse sensors to identify the woman's activity, and the sensor data was transferred to the cloud, in which an AI model was deployed to analyse the collected data. Once that's done, the cloud will transfer the information to the mobile app. The woman's temperature and heart rate are displayed on the mobile app. The mobile app will automatically call and communicate location information to the registered individual through SMS if the cloud-based AI model determines that the woman is in a dangerous situation.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Holistic Mental Health Monitoring: Integrating Facial Emotion Recognition, Chatbot, and Voicebot for Personalized Support
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The proposed system will be enabled with various AI technologies of face emotion recognition, an emotional chatbot, and voice bot. Increasing awareness about the problems of mental health creates a demand for innovative solutions capable of filling the gaps in conventional mental health care. Our proposed system integrates pioneering support with the help of advanced AI techniques that offer personalized and accessible support to persons suffering from psychological distress. Face emotion recognition systems use advanced algorithms to detect, in real time, facial expressions, and therefore the emotional states or conditions of the users. The emotional chatbot can further include the user in empathetic conversations by offering customized emotional support and resources with natural language processing and sentiment analysis. This additional voice bot feature is expanding accessibility by enabling users to engage in therapeutic dialogues and get customized recommendations for self-care. With that, this AI-enabled mental health monitoring system integrates all those components specified herein in tandem, so as to bring a revolution in mental health care that nurtures resilience and well-being among individuals globally.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Virtual Healthcare using Decision-Tree
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The advancement of modern technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI), is transforming healthcare by offering innovative solutions. An increase in accuracy is achievable through training large datasets, hence providing personalized medical assistance via chatbots. For a great number of people who are in dire need of medical help but aren't able to get it in a timely fashion, which can turn fatal, our chatbot assists them tremendously in a variety of scenarios.Such a bot is trained in understanding the type of the user, as well as the user’s age, sex, and so on. Depending on how pronounced the symptoms are, i.e. how severe, which are reported, the bot will respond with necessary next steps. We have integrated the chatbot into a website in which the user is required to input the needed information before logging in. If need be, the chat-bot also gives out names and contact number of specialist’s doctors for additional follow ups. Its cloud based architecture is flexible and secure. The abstract outlines the possible transformations AI virtual chatbots may bring in medical facilities delivering automated medical diagnosis and treatment at the point of time.

articleTitle: A Modular Framework for Mitigating and Predicting Fake News Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In today’s digital age, fake news has become a major challenge, shaping public perception and influencing decision-making. To tackle this issue, our project introduces a machine learning-based system designed to detect fake news with high accuracy. Using natural language processing (NLP) techniques, the system effectively analyzes news articles to identify misleading information. It begins by preprocessing text with the Porter Stemmer algorithm, which simplifies words to their root forms. This step ensures consistency and improves the model’s performance. To understand the significance of words in a news article, we use Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and filter out common but unimportant words with Stopwords representations. For classification, we rely on Logistic Regression, a widely used algorithm known for its reliability in distinguishing between two categories—real and fake news. Its balance of accuracy and interpretability makes it an ideal choice for this task. The model is trained and tested on a labeled dataset, showcasing its effectiveness in detecting misinformation. By providing an automated and trustworthy tool for fake news detection, this system contributes to the fight against misinformation in digital media, promoting a more informed and aware society.

articleTitle: Web Statistician: An Interactive Approach to Global Statistical Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In a world where people increasingly seek knowledge and curiosity about other countries and the world, our web-based solution simplifies the accessibility and analysis of global statistical data. It features an interactive world map, which enables users to effortlessly obtain detailed information about various countries by hovering over them. This eliminates the need for time-consuming individual searches. Our idea stands out due to its usability and adaptability. It serves a variety of audiences, making it a valuable tool for adults looking to broaden their general knowledge and students looking for educational content. This appealing idea offers an interesting method to explore the complex world of statistics, whether for exam preparation or just the pure fun of learning. It can encourage students to explore and understand various aspects of the world, including GDP, literacy rates, inflation rates, passport indices, and more. By knowing these aspects, individuals can comprehend a country’s position on the world stage through data analysis, which makes interacting with global statistical data more approachable, participatory, and similar to a fun game.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Road Traffic Noise in Chennai Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Noise pollution is a significant environmental concern, particularly in urban areas, where it adversely impacts public health and overall quality of life. Chennai, a bustling metropolitan city in India, faces elevated levels of road traffic noise due to its dense population, high vehicular density, and unique urban landscape. Addressing this challenge, this study develops a robust predictive model for traffic noise using advanced regression techniques, including polynomial regression, linear interpolation, and Gaussian Process Regression (GPR). The model leverages noise level data collected at 5-meter intervals, incorporating environmental factors such as barriers, wind, and humidity. The data were preprocessed, and relevant features were selected to ensure accurate noise level predictions at finer 1-meter intervals. Validation using metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score confirms the model's reliability. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach to assist urban planners and policymakers in formulating effective noise mitigation strategies for Chennai's unique urban environment.

articleTitle: A Multilingual Mental Health Support Chatbot with Regional Language Capabilities Based On the AMER Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Despite that, access to mental health care is still limited in many areas, particularly where there are differences in language and cultural considerations prove challenging. Many available solutions poorly respond to the needs for inclusive and personalized support in local languages. We present the development of our advanced multilingual mental health support chatbot, AMER: Advanced Multilingual Emotional Response Model with Regional Language Capabilities. Using sophisticated NLP, emotion detection, and speech technologies, the chatbot aims to provide empathetic, relevant, and interactive support for the users in their desired languages. This model is responsible for the emotion prediction and classification; AMER runs through six advanced algorithms: sentiment analysis, emotion detection, multilingual support, emoji recognition, personalized recommendation, and speech emotion recognition. To make sure that it recognizes emotions and processes language accurately, the system is trained on datasets such as GoEmotions, Common Voice, and IndicCorp to accommodate ten different languages, including as many local languages (especially in Indian context). Thanks to its modular design, it can process user inputs, evaluate emotions, and produce tailored, context-sensitive outputs. Emotion detection accuracy at baseline testing was 87%, while language processing accuracy was greater than 92%, boosting user engagement by 76% in relation to standard text-based systems. Future improvements will center around multimodal features like expression and tone analysis, as well as integration with teletherapy platforms. The improvements follow the goal of making the chatbot more accessible and better performing for more users, specifically targeting underserved communities worldwide to broaden the accessibility of mental health support.

articleTitle: Enhanced Gender Detection in Surveillance Systems Using YOLOv8 and Back Body Pose Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
