articleTitle: Unified Image Similarity Detection Using Neural Networks and Feature Metrics
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: With the increase in the amount of image information in every field, the ability to find and eliminate duplicate or near-duplicate images among the huge number of copies stored in large databases becomes an even more vital task. This project targets determining and removing duplicate/nearly duplicate copies and keeping original images without any alterations only. Although YOLO, VGG16, InceptionV3, Alex Net, Reset, and Zente CNNs indeed did well in performing image classification and detecting image similarities, they still pose some limitations in the area of distortion and noise that are introduced through image-processing attacks. These limitations are very much evident in practical scenarios when images suffer from general attacks like blurring, noise addition, scaling, rotation, and compression, which make the accurate discrimination of original and distorted images quite difficult for the CNN models. In such a scenario, the feature matrix integrated with multiple measures of similarities, for example, SSIM, Histogram Similarity, Hash Similarity, and Key point Similarity, has been used in this project. It helps in comparing the images in a much-accurate manner even with distortions or noisy ones. The proposed system of this project employs an iterative process which first applies a series of image transformations or attacks such as Median Filter, Wiener Filter, Gaussian Filter, JPEG Compression, Motion Blur, and so on for simulations of real-world image variations. These include some of the usual distortions that may arise in the course of the acquisition, processing, and transmission of images. By using such transformed images, the synergistic use in the proposed system of the CNN model and the feature matrix in detecting duplicate and near-duplicate images becomes possible. One of the most prominent new features of the proposed system includes eliminating all versions of near-duplicated and processed images.

articleTitle: Utilizing Machine Learning Techniques for Crime Classification Under the Indian Penal Code (IPC) Based on Crime Reporting Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Crime classification using the Indian Penal Code (IPC) is a common task at each police station. It involves complex decision-making related to crimes and respective IPC sections for different cases. The IPC is the foundational criminal code in India, containing a list of all substantive penal laws with definitions and punishments for each offense. Automating the crime classification is helpful due to the complexity and sheer volume of crimes reported daily. This work uses machine learning techniques to automate crime classification based on IPC. To serve this purpose, this paper utilizes the K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm. The proposed system accepts an input crime report and textually corroborates the report to an IPC section. For this intent, the system relies on the bag-of-words technique for identifying sections under IPC by scrutinizing repetition and availability of key terms in the crime to 98% accuracy in classifying crimes. Hence, the automated method is quite effective for mapping crime reports into the corresponding sections of the IPC. Also, because the system can easily be deployed online, it will be easy to integrate with existing workflows at the police stations. So, case filing and management would become more effective. This reduces the amount of manual effort and also brings consistency in classification; for this reason, the tool is of immense value to law enforcement agencies nationwide. The innovation in the paper is the development of a machine learning-based system using the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm to automate the classification of crimes under the Indian Penal Code (IPC) based on textual crime reports.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-Based Pothole Detection for Autonomous Driving Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Undeniably, autonomous vehicles are the most dramatic evolution of transportation yet. They offer new safety, efficiency, and convenience levels that have never been seen before. Still, some natural and unexpected conditions continually strike a blow against the safety of self-driving systems, such as potholes on roads. This paper introduces a new, cloud-based safety solution for autonomous vehicles through artificial intelligence and implementation with the YOLOv8 object detection model, coupled with the deep learning platform Weights & Biases, or wandb. As the real-time pothole-detecting system is developed, issues related to navigation appear while increasing the safety level. This work adopts the YOLOv8 object detection model in the use case due to its higher accuracy and much faster object detection rate. This can classify and predict the object boundaries of a single network, thus being a good fit for quick and accurate detection. Upgrades will be made in sync with new conditions in roads and types of potholes as the right solution gains ready to change the future of transportation about autonomous transportation, paving the path for safer and more reliable self-driving vehicles. It directly addresses the acute challenge of pothole-related hazards. It builds the way to an even safer and more efficient future for autonomous mobility, thus showing tremendous potential for transforming advanced AI technologies.

articleTitle: Smart Specs: Real-Time Object Detection through Embedded Vision
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Human eye is the most significant character to detect the objects. Detecting the object includes the detection of position, size, distance etc. For individuals who have lost their vision and cannot detect objects, this problem can be addressed using smart specs. To enable virtual vision, machine learning and image processing approaches utilizing packages such as OpenCV and NumPy are required. There are different types of algorithms available to detect the object like R-CNN(Region-based Convolutional Neural Network), Fast R CNN, Faster R CNN, Sliding Window object detection and YOLO. You Only Look Once(YOLO) is the famous algorithm to detect the objects and gives the accurate position, size, etc. To create a smart specs device it requires microcontrollers like Arduino, Raspberry pi, ESP32, STM32, etc. To detect and announce the detected object , it requires a camera & speaker. By using YOLO algorithm and hardware devices like Arduino, Camera & speaker, the smart specs will be created.

articleTitle: Integrity Assessment and Intrusion Detection Using ACGAN-Powered Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study investigates the use of Auxiliary Classifier Generative Adversarial Networks (ACGANs) in addressing imbalanced data within the realm of cybersecurity. ACGANs generate synthetic data mimicking network attacks, contributing to dataset balancing for improved model training. The research focuses on enhancing cybersecurity decision making by refining the accuracy of distinguishing between legitimate and malicious traffic. By leveraging ACGAN-powered machine learning, this project work demonstrates the potential for stronger, more accurate threat detection and integrity assessment, ultimately fostering more advanced and resilient intrusion detection systems.

articleTitle: Zero trust network architecture for modern enterprise environments
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) is a modern security approach that departs from traditional trust-based models. Emphasizing the "never trust, always verify" principle, ZTNA seeks to mitigate threats both inside and outside an organization by enforcing strict identity verification and access controls. Unlike conventional perimeter-based security, which relies on a trusted network boundary, ZTNA reduces attack surfaces and limits threat mobility. Core features of Zero Trust include strict identity verification, access control, micro-segmentation, encryption, multi-factor authentication (MFA), continuous authentication and authorization policies. This model represents an in-depth evaluation by using data preprocessing methodologies, augumentation techniques, and comparative model analysis. This survey provides a detailed overview of Zero Trust, optimization strategies, combining theoretical foundations with practical applications, offering security managing digital environments. However, this paper also addresses the challenges of ZTNA in modern business environments such as managing dynamic trust, implementing effective micro-segmentation, and balancing robust authentication with user experience. Additionally, it highlights areas requiring further research to enhance the resilience of network architectures. This review paper offers a comprehensive understanding of how Zero Trust can protect business environments from evolving cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity in Banking and Cloud Computing: Threats, Defenses, and Innovations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The requirement for critical infrastructure protection including banking and cloud computing has increased because these sectors face sophisticated digital threats in present-day secure computing environments. This research analyzes existing cybersecurity conditions by studying vulnerability exposure in banking whereas cloud computing together with their respective defense solutions. The paper describes new developments regarding threat detection and protection methods which feature both legal standards and technological tools that include AI threat assessment systems together with dynamic security models. The discipline of cybersecurity stands essential in protecting blockchain systems and AI functions as well as in guarding against APT threats. The document delivers a thorough examination about existing cyber threats together with protective measures Financial institutions along with cloud service providers implement to protect essential data and infrastructure. This review uses a distinctive comparison method to examine special weaknesses in each sector by studying the defense tactics of different industries across banking and cloud systems. This paper emphasizes the need for security strategies which unite technical progress with organizational guidelines and regulatory rules to boost protection at the end. This paper provides fundamental knowledge which benefits security professionals together with policymakers and researchers who deal with contemporary cybersecurity complexities.

articleTitle: Climate Data and Its Effects on Concrete Structures Using ML Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research focuses on chloride-induced corrosion, which remains a major challenge to the durability and serviceability of concrete structures and structures in general due to the effects of climate change. Chloride ions cause undesirable reactions that not only affect the concrete matrix but also the reinforcement bar resulting in problems such as cracking, spalling, and danger of ultimate failure. Temperature changes and increased humidity due to climate change also affect rates of corrosion and carbonation making concrete even more tender. Carbonation weakens the protection of the steel bars by reducing the alkalinity which protects against rust. The maintenance issues are the fluctuations of local climatic conditions: depth of carbonation and chloride penetration can be rather different for two close squares. This research seeks to establish proactive measures and better methods of maintenance using sophisticated corrosion models to reduce the effects of climate change on concrete structures. In addition to the climate data of Velachery, Manali, and Alandur obtained using machine learning, this study intends to advance understanding of how climate influences concrete durability. This knowledge is particularly useful when planning and constructing transportation and infrastructure structures that would be immune to environmental changes, and chloride intrusion.

articleTitle: Optimization of Mix Design for Geopolymer Concrete Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Engineers’ experience and empirical relationships serve as the foundation for concrete mix design investigation and optimisation. Numerous trial mixes must be made and examined for different design factors in order to achieve the required mix proportion. This obviously takes much time. To overcome, the prediction of the concrete mix proportions with experimental data can help an artificial neural network (ANN). Using a large number of trial mixes and resources, the ANN approach predicts the concrete mix proportions that can be both economical and effective for producing concrete. ANNs are trained to forecast mix proportions that are determined by a variety of input characteristics by using experimental mix design data from the past. A dataset of mix proportions was employed to train the ANN model. In order to anticipate the output, the following input parameters were set: the specific gravity of cement, the W/B ratio, the workability, the target mean strength, and the grading zone of fine aggregate. Five mix proportions obtained from ANN was used to validate the trained network. The error rate observed as 0.193%. The developed ANN model has been found to be highly efficient than linear regression analysis.

articleTitle: AI Pioneering Ethical, Analytical and Real time Emotional Recognition in Dynamic Human Expressions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Facial Expression Recognition system is a crucial topic in the field of artificial intelligence and computer visualization technology. It has a significant impact on the academic field and commercial purposes. There is a significant gap in the real time analysis of facial expressions during recordings or in live video. This crucial gap needs to be filled by continuous development and research on implementing the recognition system, capable of performing real time analysis accurately. It examines the use of machine learning, deep learning neural networks, artificial intelligence, and other new generation technologies like geospatial information, and virtual reality to help and improve accuracy and adaptability. In addition to this, it also focuses on the most popular and efficient ways to preprocess data, using principal component analysis and linear dirichlet allocation. This work also highlights the role of recognition system in monitoring environments, like proctoring systems to detect unethical practices. It offers an effortless way to understand how real time analysis can help improve current systems. This survey dives into privacy protection of crucial data by the process of anonymizing and encryption which is discussed in this journal. This report addresses the challenges faced, resolving many previously identified issues while drawing attention to emerging challenges. It serves as a foundational reference for future advancements, emphasizing the requirement to develop robust, real-time applications for diverse sectors.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Alzheimer’s Diagnosis: A Comparative Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a neurological condition that progresses over time, making early detection and treatment complex. Recently, artificial intelligence (AI) is used as medical tools for predicting illnesses. With the emergence of artificial intelligence as a new wave in healthcare, providing data-driven approaches to disease prediction, traditional computational approaches are compared with modern AI-based methods in diagnosing AD in this review. Whereas traditional ML techniques favor more simple, interpretable models, DL is generally more capable of dealing with high-dimensional, intricate data, particularly from imaging modalities like MRI. Additionally, the use of explainable AI is more transparent and clinically useful. Hybrid approaches, also based on the leverage of the power of different AI approaches, hold promise in circumventing issues like data heterogeneity and model interpretability are also addressed. In this research, the aim is to promote increased effort towards optimizing the sensitivity and promptness of AD diagnosis through cutting-edge AI method by examining the strengths and weaknesses of such approaches. Keywords: Machine learning, deep learning, Alzheimer's, disease, prediction, algorithms, Logistic Regression, Decision trees, SVM, conventional neural networks, XAI techniques, predictive modeling.

articleTitle: Noise-Resilient Graph-LSTM Transformer for Enhanced Modulation Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The advent of increasingly complex communication networks necessitates the availability of robust Automatic Modulation Recognition techniques that can adapt to diversity and noisy environments. This paper propose a novel architecture called Noise-Resilient Graph Transformer-LSTM (NRGTL), designed to leverage the unique graph structure inherent in radio signals while obviating the shortcomings inherent in prior methods. Unlike traditional AMR models, NRGTL integrates GNNs for spatial feature extraction with Bi-directional LSTM for capturing sequential dependencies, thus combining the best of both worlds into a hybrid framework that captures both spatial correlations and temporal dynamics in modulation signals. To further enhance noise resilience, a multi-scale attention mechanism is introduced, allowing the model to focus on critical signal components even under extreme low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) conditions. Adaptive edge pruning is also used in the architecture to refine graph connectivity dynamically, thereby improving computational efficiency without losing accuracy. Results from an extensive evaluation performed on the RML2016.10a dataset show how NRGTL obtains superior results compared to those of the current best state-of-the-art models: Hybrid GNN-Transformer and other LSTM, all at multiple SNR values, for F1-score, Bit Error Rate, and accuracy in general. This work shows the future direction of more progress toward AMR via graph-driven approaches that would be very easily integrated into temporal models for realworld applicability.

articleTitle: Scalable Invoice Reconciliation for SMEs: Edge-Deployed LLMs in Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed business operations through their advanced capabilities in logic processing, contextual understanding, and task execution. However, deploying multi-agent workflows in real-world scenarios presents significant challenges, including high computational demands, elevated costs, data privacy concerns, and the lack of mature frameworks. This paper introduces a novel approach to invoice reconciliation utilizing edge-deployed LLMs within a multi-agent system specifically designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Our solution addresses critical challenges such as resource efficiency, data privacy, and cost-effectiveness while delivering high accuracy. Through a comprehensive evaluation, we demonstrate that the mid-tier model qwen2.5:32b achieves an impressive 99.9% success rate with execution times comparable to proprietary models. Additionally, the functionary-small model achieves an optimal balance between success rate and resource consumption, making it particularly suitable for resource-constrained, real-time reconciliation tasks. By leveraging localized LLM deployments and efficient agent coordination, our system exhibits scalability, adaptability, and practical utility in automating invoice reconciliation processes for SMEs.

articleTitle: Transformer-based Models for Visual and Textual Data Extraction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In an era driven by digital transformation, the demand for intelligent and automated data processing has increased significantly. This research explores a unified approach to extracting both visual and textual information from images, enabling better analysis and interpretation in multiple domains. As a case study, we focus on CCTV surveillance, where traditional monitoring methods are often limited to object detection and manual inspection. Our proposed framework enhances this process by generating detailed image descriptions using transformer-based models, extracting multilingual textual data through Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and translating it into English for broader accessibility. By unifying these components, the frame-work offers a more comprehensive understanding of surveillance footage, improving both real-time monitoring and post event investigations. Fine-tuned on a domain-specific CCTV dataset, the system surpasses smaller state-of-the-art models in generating accurate and context-rich captions. Additionally, its lightweight design allows for deployment on edge devices, making it suitable for real-time monitoring and security applications without relying on high-end computational resources. This research demonstrates the potential of multimodal data extraction to improve situational awareness and decision making in security and other real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Plant leaf disease detection and classification using a lightweight DPCNet model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Plant disease is one of the major causes for an overall decrease in yield and reduces the profit from the farming segment. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) has the potential to classify multiple classes with automatic feature extraction capability and can be light weight to run on edge devices. Therefore, this research work concerns with development of novel lightweight CNN architectures for leaf disease classification. To acquire significant features in lesser number of trainable parameters, a novel microarchitecture module with Depthwise convolution layer, Pointwise Convolution layer and Conventional Convolution layer is proposed. These modules are arranged linearly in three branches to obtain colour, shape and texture features and the developed CNN architecture is called "DPCNet model". Further, to extract texture information, a novel hybrid CNN architecture called DPCNet is proposed by combining features from Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) with CNN feature maps. The proposed architecture is analyzed on plant village dataset. Among the various CNN models, proposed DPCNet delivers highest validation accuracy and least validation loss of 95.78% and 0.1478 respectively with 1,27,425 trainable parameters than the other existing CNN models.

articleTitle: An optimized Clisteer Long-Range Kookaburra Attention Module Steerable Convolutional Neural Networks for Crime Predictions in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Crime prediction in smart cities is a complex yet promising field that leverages data and technology to enhance public safety. In the previous papers several deep learning algorithms are used to predict the crimes in smart cities but does not provide sufficient results that is accuracy is decreased, error rate, computational time, cost is increased. To overcome these limitations this work is proposed. In this manuscript, an optimized Clisteer Long-Range Kookaburra Attention Module Steerable Convolutional Neural Networks (2CLR-KoobAtMSNet) for Crime Predictions in Smart Cities is proposed to predict the crimes in smart cities. In this, to predict the crimes the input dataset is taken from crime data for city of Chicago city. Then these data are cleaned using the Adaptive Guided Side Window Box Filter with Multiple Layers (AGS-WBF-ML). Then the features are extracted using the Attention based Swin Transformer (AST). After that, the features are selected using the Dung Beetle Optimization Algorithm (DBOA) for crime prediction. Finally, the crimes are predicted using the 2CLR-KoobAtMSNet. The 2CLR-KoobAtMSNet model was implemented on the Python platform and evaluated using four datasets, achieving remarkable results with 99.9% accuracy and 99.8% recall, outperforming existing methods. These results demonstrate the model’s exceptional effectiveness and opportunities for advancement in customized stress-reduction strategies.

Author Keywords: Adaptive Guided Side Window Box Filter with Multiple Layers

articleTitle: Advanced AI Framework for Fire and Smoke Detection Integrating YOLOv8 Object Detection and XGBoost Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Early fire detection is very crucial for preventing further fire accidents in industrial and residential areas. Traditional fire detection methods depend on sensors which create false alarms many times and limited detection accuracy. To address these challenges, This study presents an Advanced AI Framework which combines YOLOv8 for real time object detection with XGBoost for enhanced classification accuracy. Our research utilizes YOLOv8’s deep learning architecture to accurately detect fire and smoke in complex scenarios. The detected features are then processed predictions by differentiating fire and datasets covering various fire and smoke conditions. This study enhances AI-based fire detection by providing a high-precision, real-time solution suitable for intelligent monitoring systems. Future improvements focus on seamless real-time processing integration.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security with Real-Time Animal Intruder Detection: A Deep Learning Approach for Automated Alerts and Notifications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper develops an animal real-time intrusion detection system based on the advanced techniques of deep learning. The proposed system makes use of CNN with transfer learning and has achieved an accuracy level of more than 90 percent in distinguishing among various animal species. This high degree of precision will allow any probable intrusion to be detected with full reliability and in real-time at the monitored site. The system is continuously processing video feeds, where animals are being identified based on unique features. The solution is to fit smoothly in existing security architecture and increase safety for agricultural fields, residential sites, and wildlife management. It offers immediate alarms whereby quick actions can be done to decrease the risks made by animal invasions. The real-time capability minimizes responses between detection and intervention. And aside from the accuracy, the whole system is very adaptable-very flexible-and therefore applicable to other settings. Be it on small farms in the countryside, suburban environments, or in large settings for wildlife conservation, such a system would scale effectively to meet diverse needs that different environments might have. With such design, it is easy to customize for specific user needs, providing a flexible yet versatile solution for animal monitoring and intrusion prevention. What follows are the architecture and methodologies of the system itself-evaluation in real-world conditions.

articleTitle: Smart Safety System for Driver and Passenger Protection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The Smart Safety System is designed to enhance road safety by monitoring both the driver and passenger activities and ensuring proactive measures are taken to prevent accidents. The system leverages sensors and real-time data monitoring to ensure driver sobriety and attentiveness while also alerting the driver about potential passenger hazards. The system primarily focuses on two areas: driver safety and passenger detection. On the driver’s side, an alcohol sensor detects any sign of intoxication, and an eye-blink sensor monitors the driver’s focus, especially if distracted by using a phone. If intoxication is detected, the vehicle is automatically disabled through the motor control system, and an alert is triggered via an alarm and notification sent to a web-based platform. If the driver is distracted or drowsy, a warning alarm is activated. On the passenger side, an IR sensor and an ultrasonic sensor detect whether passengers are improperly standing or not seated, and a notification is displayed to the driver. The system integrates an Arduino Uno with several sensors, including alcohol, eye-blink, IR, and ultrasonic sensors. The collected data is transmitted wirelessly through a Wi-Fi module to a cloud platform, such as ThingSpeak, and then displayed on a website built with Java, HTML, and JavaScript. The website provides a login interface to enroll driver information and monitor alcohol sensor readings. In case of driver intoxication, the system triggers the suspension of the vehicle by turning off the motor. This smart safety system provides an efficient, real-time mechanism for preventing road accidents by monitoring driver behavior and ensuring passenger safety.

articleTitle: Optimizing Sleep Disorder Classification: A Synergy Of Bayesian Optimization And Gradient Boosting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The categorization of sleep disorders with proper accuracy and efficiency is important in diagnosing and treatment, by considering the effect these conditions have on people’s lifestyle. This research hand out an innovative method for classifying sleep disorders by applying machine learning techniques, with Gradient Boosting Classifier (GBC) on prior optimized through Bayesian techniques. The extensive dataset encompassing various health-related characteristics, including lifestyle factors and patterns, which undergoes several preprocessing procedure to handle missing values and errors, thus ensuring data consistency and integrity. To establish a performance standard, a preliminary baseline model with the default parameters is made using GBC. The GBC’s hyperparameters are then modified using Bayesian Optimization, which aims to enhance the classification accuracy by analyzing the parameter space. The model’s performance is significantly improved by the optimization techniques, which can be seen by the increase in classification accuracy from 92.92% to 94.44%. This improvement shows that Bayesian Optimization works to refine complex machine learning models which in turn provides more reliable and accurate classification results. Compared to traditional machine learning algorithms while offering a more advanced diagnostic tool. These study results shows that the combination of Bayesian Optimization and GBC offers an effective method for accurately identifying sleep disorders.

articleTitle: Integrated Django Web Interface for Facial Attributes Generation Utilizing Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Imagine a system that takes in a line of text and generates realistic images of faces, the sort of challenge AI researchers have been trying to crack for some time now. In this paper, a new way of achieving this vision has been defined which was never been possible before due to the computational limitations, but that is now feasible due to the advent of deep learning technology. A model that blends Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (CGAN) with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is created which is capable of generating very realistic human faces only from textual descriptions. The CGAN takes the textual input and creates rough facial images, and the CNN fine-tune these images to have a more natural appearance while still being faithful to the original text. This model is trained on a dataset of paired facial images and textual descriptions. The model can consequently generate varied, high-quality images that closely match the input text as a result of being trained on this extensive dataset. This method was assessed through both human feedback and quantitative measures. These results show major improvement in generated text-to-face, paving the way for applications in graphics, virtual reality, entertainment and identifying criminal activities in cyberspace. But alongside this powerful new technology comes an ethical responsibility to protect oneself from the misuse of it for cybercrimes.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Ultrasound Lung Segmentation Using Noise-Resilient Deep Learning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Ultrasound imaging is widely used for lung diagnostics due to its non-invasive and cost-effective nature. However, challenges like speckle noise and low resolution make lung segmentation difficult. This paper presents a novel approach combining multi-modal learning, noise-resilient segmentation, and edge-device optimization to enable effective and accessible ultrasound lung segmentation. The method leverages feature transfer from high-resolution modalities like CT scans and employs a hybrid architecture with denoising autoencoders based on convolutional neural networks to enhance segmentation accuracy, even for low-quality ultrasound images. Lightweight architecture and quantization techniques optimize the system for real-time inference, making it suitable for portable ultrasound devices. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate superior segmentation accuracy and generalizability compared to state-of-the-art methods. This innovation supports point-of-care applications in resource-limited settings, advancing lung diagnostics for underserved communities.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Controlled Manufacturing Strategies for New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Manufacturing strategies which focus on New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) need to innovate because their rapid growth requires more efficient and sustainable production methods. This research studies flexible manufacturing since it represents the fundamental solution for NEV production difficulties. The article evaluates three manufacturing approaches including contract manufacturing together with skateboard platform sharing and modular production lines which show advantages in cost reduction and faster production times and better market responsiveness. Real examples from Tesla, Canoo and Toyota demonstrate how flexible manufacturing works in the NEV sector. Some interconnected obstacles including elevated start-up expenses and supplier connection requirements and employee skill development remain despite productive benefits. The research presents forecasts regarding AI-controlled intelligent manufacturing sites and environmentally-friendly production practices which will facilitate the development of an optimized NEV production network. The NEV industry will push global sustainability in transportation by using flexible manufacturing to solve production challenges.

articleTitle: Reward Based Online Crowdfunding Platform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)

authors.preferredName: J. M. S. V. Ravi Kumar

abstract: The platform provides personalities with an opportunity to present new concepts and/or ventures, and provide material or experiential benefits to backers. The rationale involves easy to use navigator, powerful discovery instruments, integrated and safe payment gateway, and clear financial administration. The user profaced secrets of complex computations include helping backers discover projects that are of interest to them. The integration of social media makes campaigns to reach a wide audience and also users share the projects to their friends to gain more followers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity in Digital Twin Systems: Mitigating Challenges and Defending Against Threats
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are precise copies of actual systems that exist to which people can interact dynamically. Employed mainly in manufacturing, healthcare and smart city sectors, DTs facilitate the improvement of performance and decision-making. This integration raises the risk of cybersecurity threats including loss of data; wrong access; and advanced persistent threats. Since through integrating DT many other infrastructures are attained by the attackers it becomes a very significant agenda to counter them. In this paper, the strategy of using AI and XAI to enhance cybersecurity in DT systems is analyzed. Some of the AI techniques are Anomaly detection, analysis that predicts and Automated response facilities to provide Security precautionary measures. Such methods are improved by XAI through the addition of the process by which the decisions were made and the trust with the parties involved. Mirroring literature review, deficits of existing DT cybersecurity frameworks, analyzed, include overall issues of scalability, insufficient new threat integration, and increased opacity. For such reasons, the current paper offers a detailed cybersecurity framework that adopts both AI and XAI to fill the existing research gaps. The framework has demonstrated the application of improvements in threat detection, downloads response time and system robustness using real life cases. The presented work is intended for those states where it is possible to create safe and secure DT environments, efficient and capable of countering modern cybersecurity threats. They are aimed to cover existing voids in order to create a socially responsible approach to the use of DT in sensitive domains.

articleTitle: Enhancing Deep Learning Models for Vulnerability Detection through Fuzzy-Based Software Reconstruction in OOP
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: As software systems continue to evolve to their complexities, vulnerability detection in code is a daunting task. Traditional techniques, such as static analysis alone, usually fail to deliver vulnerabilities in object-oriented programming languages alone, because they inherit complexities like polymorphism, inheritance hierarchies, and encapsulation. This paper would introduce a novel approach that would be based on deep learning-based vulnerability detection with the involvement of fuzzy clustering techniques in code restructuring in OOP-based systems. Deep learning models such as DNNs, CNNs, and RNNs provide a better way of learning code patterns for the identification of vulnerabilities like buffer overflows, SQL injections, and cross-site scripting attacks. However, the state of features in OOP sometimes demands extra strategies to raise the precision of detection. Fuzzy clustering is used to cluster similar code patterns. It tracks the vulnerability that may remain undiscovered using traditional analysis techniques. The restructuring of complex OOP code-the flattening of inheritance hierarchies, reduction of polymorphic behaviors, and enhancing encapsulation access-halves the process in such analyses being more efficient in detecting vulnerabilities. This is how deep learning and fuzzy clustering could provide an efficient solution to enhance the security of software systems by overcoming shortcomings of traditional approaches and complexities accompanying modern OOP-based applications.

articleTitle: Smart Housing Forecast: Leveraging AI Models for Predictive Pricing and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: People are careful when they are trying to buy a new house with their budgets and market strategies. This study explores the development of a Smart Housing Forecast with use a powerful machine learning models like XG Boost Regression, a powerful gradient boosting is used to enabling highly accurate pricing forecasting and for property recommendation a cosine similarity-based approach with give each buyer need which is suggested by needs. It is seen that not only buyers face problem while buying property but also seller face problem selling property so we use a analysis modules for them to understand for what price to sell and buy property by use graph like scatter plot which to helping buyers and sellers make well-informed selections, these predictive models allow real estate brokers to suggest properties in a more personalised way. A smart housing forecasting project supports SDG 11 by promoting sustainable urban development. It ensures economic feasibility, equitable access (SDG 10), ethical data practices (SDG 16), and health-focused recommendations (SDG 3). These efforts contribute to creating inclusive, safe communities, fostering resilient and sustainable cities in line with global goals.

articleTitle: Internet Gaming Addiction: Prevalence, Causes, Consequences, and Intervention Strategies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: As internet and online gaming phenomenon increases rapidly, gaming addiction, particularly internet gaming disorder, is now recognised as a growing public health issue. Gaming addiction is characterized by symptoms such as personal and social impairments, occupational settings, and obsession, withdrawal, lack of control for actions. This review paper aims to cover the prevalence of gaming addiction, its causes, consequences and possible intervention strategies. It is common in teenagers and young adults, but occurs more frequently in boys than in girls. Learnt low esteem, escapism and comorbid mood disorders are predisposing psychological factors for the addiction. High levels of engagement in games are attributable other social attributes such as reward mechanisms. Some psychological effects include anxiety, depression, obesity, musculoskeletal disorders and academic and social dysfunction. Available so far are reputed treatments such as a combination of cognitive behavioural therapy, time boundaries to focus on policies, parental intervention and school-based programs to promote balanced gaming habits. A further effort would need to be made to know all these factors when we are developing some of the strategies on how to reduce or to some extent will mitigate the negative impacts of problematic gaming, and promote for more healthier gaming practice.

articleTitle: Advanced Real Estate Price Forecasting Using Multivariate Long Short-Term Memory Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Forecasting real estate prices is critical in making financial decisions, formulating investment strategies, and designing plans for urban development. Predictive models can enable stakeholders to detect the market's future trends and make meaningful decisions. Forecasting methods often fail to extract complex nonlinear patterns from economic indicators, interest rates, population, and regional trends in the real estate market. The paper proposes a multivariate LSTM network for advanced real estate price forecasting. The input features under consideration for the proposed model are longitude, latitude, median age of housing, total rooms, total bedrooms, population, households, median income, median house value, and ocean proximity. The multivariate technique offers a better facility for capturing time dependency and relations between varied variables. Therefore, the model performs well in correctly predicting house price fluctuations. This model was tested on housing prices in different regions and related economic indicators. We evaluate the performance of our model in terms of actual versus predicted prices and residual plots. We used cross-validation. The model proved robust and efficient in pricing predictions under different market conditions. All the standard metrics, including RMSE, MAE, and R-squared values, proved the Multivariate LSTM model is highly effective. However, the promising result would have been bettered further if sentiment analysis was incorporated with the dataset-the same thing that would have also improved the precision of the model.

articleTitle: Neural Matrix Factorization and Collaborative Filtering: A Hybrid Approach to Personalized Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This work presents Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF), a novel approach for personalized recommendations. NCF combines matrix factorization with deep neural networks to overcome limitations of traditional methods, such as the cold-start problem and sparsity issues. The evaluation using the MovieLens dataset shows that NCF outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and efficiency. NCF leverages Matrix Factorization to learn latent representations of users and items in to Neural Matrix Factorization to identifies linear and non-linear interactions. It addresses challenges related to recommendations and sparsity handling, making it promising for real-world recommender systems. To meet the demand for personalized recommendations, NCF combines matrix factorization and deep neural networks, enabling accurate recommendations with limited data, scalability for large datasets, and robustness against noisy and incomplete data. The work focuses on developing and evaluating a hybrid recommender system based on NCF and other techniques, such as Collaborative Filtering and Recurrent Neural Networks. Tasks include data collection and preprocessing, model selection and integration, and system implementation and evaluation. Performance metrics such as accuracy, scalability, and real-time performance will be assessed to ensure effectiveness.

articleTitle: Real-Time Suspicious Activity Detection in Bank and ATM Environments Using Meta-Learning and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper presents a cutting-edge surveillance system designed to enhance real-time detection of suspicious activities in sensitive environments such as banks and ATMs. By leveraging edge computing technologies and meta-learning models, the system achieves high accuracy in analyzing live video streams from CCTV cameras over RTSP protocols. A robust architecture integrates tracking-assisted object detection and adaptive behavioral classification, ensuring low latency and reliable performance even under resource-constrained conditions. Edge devices such as NVIDIA Jetson process video frames locally, reducing bandwidth consumption while maintaining data privacy. Unlike traditional approaches, the proposed system utilizes meta-learning frameworks to adapt rapidly to novel and evolving threats with minimal retraining, providing a scalable solution for dynamic security challenges. Through extensive experiments, including latency analysis and classification accuracy benchmarks, the system demonstrates significant advantages over cloud-based methods, achieving faster response times and greater operational efficiency. This work lays the foundation for deploying intelligent, adaptive surveillance systems in high-security environments.

articleTitle: Toledic: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Lite
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Tomatoes are edible berries with the rich umami flavor. Since, identification of diseases in tomato leaves is essential in Indian market to maximize the crop yield and minimize the crop loss. As such, this paper investigates the usage of lightweight Convolution Neural Networks deployed on a Raspberry Pi 4 for real-time diagnosis of tomato leaf diseases. In this paper, I focus on computational constraint on the Raspberry Pi 4 at the cost of accuracy and introduce a novel model, Toledic-Lite. We evaluate and compare various conventional lightweight models based on ResNet 50, EfficientNet v4, DenseNet 121, ConvNext v2_Nano and VGG16 metrics such as accuracy, inference time and memory usage, and identify conventional edge computation performance. Toledic-Lite’s functionality is meant to bring the data processing process in the complex computational tasks of Arm based processors into more efficient and accurate domain by optimizing the accuracy and the result as compared to the conventional model. The objective is to develop a cost effective, efficient and accurate solution for deployment on farms. The work presents models using multiple architectures on the Raspberry Pi platform that balance accuracy and computational efficiency. Overall, it is demonstrated that lightweight CNNs can accurately classify tomato leaf diseases to support the development of intelligent and sustainable agricultural practices. This work demonstrates a significant contribution to the exploration of the application of edge computing for disease management in agriculture, focusing on a need to intervene early to protect crop health and improve agricultural output.

articleTitle: Audio for Visually impaired using Inception V3 and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Humans depend heavily on their sense of sight, and its loss can have a major negative influence on a person's quality of life. Being blind can make it more difficult for a person to carry out daily activities on their own, such as reading, identifying things, and navigating new surroundings. The WHO estimates that there are about 285 million visually impaired people in the globe, 39 million of whom are blind. The concepts of picture captioning and TTS, which uses deep learning to transform an image into text and audio description, are combined in Visual Audio for Visionless. This process is difficult since the system must first comprehend the image's content before figuring out how to convert it into natural language captions that accurately convey the image's meaning both orally and in writing. LSTM with attention functions as a decoder and creates the word-by-word caption in the suggested system, conditioning the prediction on the previously generated caption, while CNN (Inception V3) acts as an encoder. Because of their complementary strengths, Inception V3 and LSTM, which are utilized for picture captioning, can produce good results. In the end, as soon as the system records the situation as an image, captions and audio descriptions are produced for the photographs in real-time.

articleTitle: Biometric Breakthroughs : Improving Service And Security With Fingerprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Biometric verification is now a vital element of contemporary security systems, offering a sure and efficient way of authenticating identities. Of all the biometric technologies, fingerprint recognition is notable for its distinctiveness, stability, and convenience. This project, "Biometric Breakthroughs: Enhancing Service and Security through Fingerprint Recognition," examines the new developments in fingerprint recognition technology and illustrates how it can further security and service effectiveness.Our work is about merging deep learning methods with conventional fingerprint authentication procedures to enhance accuracy, minimize false positives, and maximize system hardness. Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and sophisticated feature extraction methods, our model strives to provide high-accuracy fingerprint identification while overcoming the issue of noise, distortion, and attempts at spoofing.This paper offers an in-depth examination of the methods used, experimental findings, and possible real-world applications—especially in banking, law enforcement, and personal device security. The results highlight the need for ongoing innovation in biometric authentication to support both digital and physical security systems.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Financial Analyst
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the current study, large language models that process user queries and analyse stock market data are compared and used to construct an AI-enabled platform for real-time financial data analysis. In this regard, the proposed platform integrates many data sources that might be used for aggregate analysis, concentrating on the top 50 Indian NSE equities through front-end development using ReactJS and back-end development using Python Flask. The technology provides insights that are pertinent to time and events by gathering data at every imaginable level, from daily reports regarding filings and company actions to minute updates of stock tickers. The design, process, data classification, constraints, and suggestions for future iterations are the main topics of this study.

articleTitle: Improving ECG Arrhythmia Diagnosis with Hybrid Deep Learning Models and Cloud-Based Support
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Arrhythmias, irregularities in heart rhythm, are critical indicators of heart disease and can be effectively diagnosed using electrocardiograms (ECGs), a primary tool in cardiac care. This study proposes and evaluates three hybrid deep learning models: CNN-LSTM, CNN-GRU, and Bidirectional GRU with attention (BiGRU-Att) for the classification of ECG signals into five distinct arrhythmia categories. CNN-LSTM and CNN-GRU integrate convolutional layers for spatial feature extraction with recurrent layers for temporal pattern modeling, while the BiGRU-Att model incorporates an attention mechanism to enhance focus on critical features. The preprocessing method employs the synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) to address the class imbalance, ensuring robust model performance. Results demonstrate that BiGRU-Att outperforms other models, achieving an overall accuracy of 99.4%, sensitivity of 0.987, and the lowest false positive rate of 0.002. To facilitate practical application, a user-friendly cloud-based platform was developed, enabling doctors to upload ECG signals, visualize results, and classify arrhythmias. The platform incorporates a recommendation system powered by a custom-built database, offering personalized recommendations for each arrhythmia type. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid deep learning to enhance arrhythmia detection, ultimately improving diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Personalized Music Recommendations Using Retrieval Augmented Generation: Evaluating Data Processing Strategies on Spotify Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In recent years, music consumption has transitioned from physical formats to streaming platforms such as Spotify. Spotify, one of the leading platforms, has seen remarkable growth, surpassing 574 million active users globally by 2024. This shift has made music more accessible than ever before, but as the volume of available content increases, discovering personalized music recommendations has become increasingly complex. To address this challenge, the development of AI-powered generative recommendation systems has become essential. This research investigates the application of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide personalized music recommendations by utilizing the Spotify dataset. We evaluate the impact of data preprocessing, converting numerical data into categorical data, on system performance. The RAG system, powered by OpenAI’s text-embedding-ada-002 model, processes the data, stores embeddings in Chroma DB, and generates recommendations using GPT-4o-mini. Experimental results show that the converted dataset improves efficiency, reducing both processing time and token usage. User feedback from 43 participants reveals an 80% satisfaction rate, demonstrating the effectiveness and user appeal of the proposed RAG-based music recommendation system.

articleTitle: Classification of Multiphase Flow Regime in a Horizontal Pipe Using Supervised Machine Learning and Bayesian Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)

authors.preferredName: Namburi Pooja Sai Venkata Sri Harika

abstract: Multiphase flow refers to a fluid flow consisting of more than one phase. Conventional/traditional methods rely on empirical correlations and flow maps of the flow regimes that show overlapping characteristics. Machine learning (ML) has gained traction for multiphase flow regime classification, offering improved accuracy and adaptability to complex flow conditions. This paper presents the supervised ML approach to classify the three-phase flow regimes in horizontal pipes. The superficial gas and liquid velocities and water cuts are utilized as input features for flow regime classification. ML classification models, such as Bayesian Classifier and K-Nearest Neighbors, and boosting models, such as XGBoost, CatBoost, and LightGBM, are employed and evaluated. Bayesian optimization is used to enhance model accuracy and robustness by hyperparameter tuning. The selected supervised ML models provided an accurate and efficient classification of multiphase flow regimes when enhanced using Bayesian optimization. The optimized ML models significantly improved the classification accuracy and the F1 score, making them practical for real-time monitoring and control applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Low-Rank Decomposition Techniques for Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Recently, low-rank decomposition methods have brought about powerful methods for tuning deep learning models, reducing training parameters by orders of magnitude and maintaining performance. These methods, including LoRA, Delta LoRA, DyLoRA, WARP, KronA, as well as Intrinsic SAID, have seen widespread usage in many application domains, ranging from natural language processing (NLP) to computer vision, to multimodal tasks. Despite their success in reducing computational cost, these methods also suffer from some limitations including the risk of execution loss, especially for complex task, and the undesirable bipolarity of the model parameters. In addition, before most have addressed the problem, no pre-trained models optimised for low rank techniques have been made available and necessitate resource intensive fine tuning. This paper review the strengths and limitations of each method and point out the tradeoff between efficiency and performance. In addition, it presents possible improvements, including hybrid models, and developments in adaptability and scalability for use in operations of real-world applications like healthcare and finance. Future directions include: increasing efficiency; generalizing the use across many different architectures relevant to AI; and tackling the current limitations to make low rank decomposition techniques more widely usable in AI software.

articleTitle: Automated Histopathological Analysis for Accurate Grading of Prostate Cancer Using CNNs and SVMs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Histopathological analysis is an essential but difficult technique for grading prostate cancer; traditional systems rely on human assessment or rudimentary machine learning methods, which frequently produce inconsistent and less accurate results. Existing automated techniques, which use on logistic regression or decision trees, have difficulty capturing intricate tissue patterns and exhibit poor cross-dataset generalization. The study provides a hybrid system that pairs Support Vector Machines (SVMs) for classification with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and a novel attention mechanism (channel-wise and spatial attention) for increased feature extraction. The technique achieves higher accuracy and reliability in prostate cancer grading by using robust preprocessing techniques and ensemble learning with several SVM. The proposed system outperformed existing systems with 88.7% accuracy, outperforming them by 75.5% and 80.4%, respectively. It also provided improved precision, recall, and F1-score, ensuring more consistent and generalizable cancer grading results. The results show a significant improvement over the existing systems.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning in Healthcare: Integrating Homomorphic Encryption, Smart Contracts, and Adaptive Strategies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The exponential rise of healthcare data calls for strong privacy-preserving methods for collaborative learning. In this paper, an Integrated Federated Learning Framework integrating homomorphic encryption, blockchain, and adaptive learning approaches is introduced to meet the challenges of privacy, scalability, and heterogeneity of data in healthcare. Data confidentiality is provided by homomorphic encryption with the ability to carry out computations over encrypted data safely, and tamper-proof sharing of data by blockchain. Adaptive learning mechanisms such as weighted federated learning and SMOTE address data imbalance and heterogeneity. Evaluated on real-world data such as MIMIC-III, the framework achieves 93.2% model accuracy, outperforming traditional centralized and federated learning approaches. Experimental results are a 30% reduction in communication overhead with faster convergence, making it feasible for large-scale, privacy-sensitive healthcare applications. The proposed framework provides opportunities for secure, efficient, and collaborative analysis of healthcare data.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Deep Learning Approach for Predicting Dementia’s Disease Progression Using MRI Clinical Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Dementia’s disease (DD) is a progressive neurological disease that primarily affects the elderly. Its primary symptom is cognitive impairment. There is currently no known cure; the only available treatments are meant to improve the patient’s quality of life. Given the challenges in treating DD, predicting its trajectory can be crucial in guiding management and treatment strategies. In this work, we propose a multimodal approach that uses MRI scans and clinical data to predict the phases of DD. The VGG19 deep learning model is utilized to interpret MRI images for image classification, and LightGBM (LGBMClassifier) is used to evaluate patient clinical data in CSV format. A multimodal deep learning technique is then used to combine the predictions from both modalities in order to increase the overall prediction accuracy. The integrated model aims to provide a comprehensive and accurate assessment of DD’s progression. This multimodal method offers a promising step toward a better understanding and management of Dementia’s disease by providing doctors with improved prediction insights into the development of the disease.

articleTitle: Advanced Tamil Character Recognition using Generative Adversarial Networks and Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This system on an advanced Tamil character recognition theme uses the benefit of FPGA-based acceleration for gaining the enhancement of high-performance processing, keeping it scalable. What makes such a system interesting is achieving recognition of Tamil text being 3D carvings or embossed inside monuments with an adequate preservation of cultural heritage material. As an added theme, its support to multiscript recognitions-Tamil, Hindi, English and others-would enable it smoothly multilingually be well-integrated into a vast variety of applications. The integration of AR enhances user interaction as it superimposes live recognition results onto the physical object and also provides an immersive learning experience along with hands-on guidance. The architecture of CNNs and GANs used in data augmentation can make this system reliable for recognition across diverse ranges of writing styles, fonts, and languages. It happens to be an ideal tool that fulfils the demands of state-of-the-art Optical Character Recognition (OCR), interpretation of 3D texts, educational applications, as well as real-time multi-lingual functionalities while facing contemporary demands in text digitization.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Insights into Digital Payment Systems for Vendor Network Expansion and Customer Retention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study will investigate the effect of digital payment systems on vendor network expansion and customer retention in a mixed-method approach, covering both organized and unorganized vendors. The research uses statistical techniques and machine learning models to analyze the relationships between digital payment adoption, vendor growth, and customer loyalty. The study found that organized vendors, in terms of network expansion, benefit more from digital payment systems, while the availability and reliability of digital payment options significantly improve customer retention. This research also reveals vendor clusters based on revenue growth, frequency of digital payment usage, and transaction values; it also identifies rewards and security as key factors that influence customer preferences. This is the first study that applies sentiment analysis of customer feedback by applying an SVM classifier for the purpose of understanding user perceptions. The current study has certain limitations, including a low number of datasets and a low R-squared value; still, it points out valuable insights important to policymakers and financial service providers for the optimization of digital payment strategies toward sustainable and inclusive growth.

articleTitle: Detecting and Refining Misinformation Using Domain- Adversarial Graph Neural Network: A Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The swift spread of fake news on social media urges for strong and effective detection system. This study brings out an innovative approach that combines graph convolutional networks with Domain Adversarial Neural Networks (DANN) to capture patterns that distinguish genuine content from false information. Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) are used to examine the complex connections between content and metadata to detect distinguishing patterns between misinformation and legitimate information. Yet, the precision of models created from single domain may be affected by the accuracy of models trained on various domains. To resolve this issue, the proposed approach incorporates DANN to lessen domain disparities and allow the model to generalize across a wide range of social media contexts. To analyse multi-entity interactions and various relationships types, we combine GCN with DANN enabling the model to leverage insights across different domains. By incorporating this enhancement, the hybrid method surpasses traditional methods, achieving a 13% higher F1-score by integrating GCNs and DANN. In comparison to GCN-only and DANN-only models, there is a 12-15% increase in precision and a 10-14% increase in recall, leading to improved scalability and domain adaptability. The integration of attention mechanisms results in enhanced prioritization of important nodes, leading to a notable increase in detection accuracy. Future enhancements focus on adaptive learning, multilingual support and multimodal content analysis enhancing global adaptability and impact.

articleTitle: Integrating Convolutional Neural Networks For Enhanced Real-Time Intrusion Detection And Automated Attack Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This study introduces a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS) engineered for real-time threat identification and classification. By leveraging deep learning methodologies, the system analyzes live network traffic and detects potential cyber threats with high precision. A diverse dataset encompassing both benign and malicious network activities was employed to train the model, ensuring enhanced detection capabilities. To address dataset imbalances and improve generalization, preprocessing techniques such as Random Under-Sampling and feature normalization were utilized. Experimental findings demonstrate that the proposed IDS surpasses conventional signature-based approaches in accuracy, particularly in identifying frequent attacks like DDoS and Port Scans. Future enhancements will focus on refining detection of encrypted and low-frequency threats through advanced deep learning models.

articleTitle: Emerging Threats to Personal Data: AI-Powered Cyberattacks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence plays a dual role in the cyber security domain impacting personal data security. It acts as a tool for both the cyber criminals enhancing their offensive capabilities and also as a defense mechanism enhancing personal data security. The review brings out the emerging threats of AI-driven cyberattacks, increased vulnerability of personal data, and possible countermeasures that may reduce such risks. To fight these emerging threats, AI is used for malware detection, threat prediction, and anomaly detection. Another aspect of this paper stresses AI-based security tools for combating personal data attacks that have been highly sophisticated of recent times.

articleTitle: Land Use Classification with different Machine Learning technique with Landsat MSS Image
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Land use/land cover changes had accelerated near the turn of the 20th century owing to rapid and unregulated population growth, economic activity, and industrialization, especially in emerging nations. A quantitative assessment evidently is imperative for grasping and controlling land transformation processes. In this study, an assessment is made of the performance of four commonly used machine-learning algorithms-Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM), for LULC mapping. Kappa statistics used to assess the accuracy of the study helps to see that all classifiers present accurate results, though some variation is present. The highest accuracy (0.89 Kappa) is attained through the Random Forest algorithm. These results highlight SVM and RF out of all the algorithms used for LULC mapping as the most effective classifiers. However, more tests with the RF algorithm should be conducted in various regions and climate settings to confirm its robustness and potential applicability.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-powered Job Offer Verification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: In the modern world, technological developments and inventions have given us the ability to handle practically each aspect of our lives, including keeping track of money, education, job appearances, and security. But this reliance on technology has also made it easier for con artists to defraud people and gain quick money. Fake work notices are a specific approach that has recently become more common. Unsuspecting people submit applications for these fake job openings, handing over their personal information and paying the application fees to the con artists as though they were going to fall for the fraud and waste their hard-earned money. In this paper, the Natural Language Processing (NLP) approach is used to identify bogus job postings. We collected relevant information from job advertisements, after that we applied the random forest classifier to train and evaluate our model. The results we obtained show that our method can recognize fake job advertisements with a 97% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Diagnosis Of Cervical Cancer Cells Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This paper shows that the deep learning method can be applied to providing computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) of cervical cancer cells. This research studies the effect of CervicalNet, a dedicated deep neural network algorithm on Detecting and categorizing cervical cancer cells through the Mendeley Liquid-Based Cytology (LBC) dataset. This disease affects women across the world, ranks as the 4th common malignancy in women; early detection improves patient care outcome. The traditional techniques are always based on manual examination of cell samples by cytopathologists, procedures that are tedious and susceptible to human errors. This work illustrates that deep learning particularly CervicalNet, can assist with automating and improving detection in the diagnosis of cell images, by accurately categorizing them as well as identifying cancerous abnormalities with high precision. The aim is to highlight the efficiency of CAD Systems in reducing diagnostic time and improving accuracy in cervical cancer screening.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Framework for Leather Surface Defect Detection and Classification Using CNN Architectures
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The most critical procedure in the leather processing industry is the detection of surface defects in leather, which helps determine the amount of treated leather that is usable. Thus, identifying and locating leather flaws has a significant influence on leather hide grading. A system for identifying and classifying leather surface flaws is presented in this research. Deep learning models are used by the suggested framework to identify and categorize leather flaws. Convolutional neural networks, or CNNs, are used to identify flaws and categorize their types using the Multi Class Model (MCM) and Binary Class Model (BCM), respectively. Various CNN designs, including LeNet-5, VGG-13, VGG-16, VGG-19, ResNet-50, MobileNet, and MobileNetV2, were employed for the BCM and MCM. Out of all the models, the BCM model's test accuracy was the highest at 93.65% for the VGG-16 architecture, while the MCM model's test accuracy was 81.24% for the MobileNet architecture. The best models have been incorporated into the suggested framework once their performances are compared.

articleTitle: Protective Gear Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks to Enhance Occupational Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Ensuring occupational safety in workplaces is a critical concern, especially in dangerous environments where the use of protective gear, such as helmets and other safety equipment, is mandatory. This paper presents a deep learning model for detecting protective gear using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The model is trained on a public dataset ‘Is an Employee Wearing Safety Gear?’ available on Kaggle. An accuracy of 99% has been achieved. The monitoring of safety compliance by employees can be automated by integrated this technology with surveillance systems for real-time detection, significantly reducing the risks associated with human error in safety enforcement. Future work will include expanding the dataset to incorporate additional classes of protective equipment to scale the system’s applicability across industries.

articleTitle: Enhancing Online Transaction Security Through Comprehensive Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The purpose was to improve the effectiveness of Support Vector Machine (SVM) model using ensemble learning and hyperparameter tuning. Specifically, we utilized a stacking classifier that combines two base models: SVM and XGBOOST. SVM was optimized through key parameters which include the RBF kernel, and high regularization constant c value of 10, and Gamma ‘scale’ function for higher values of decision margins. For construction of the Model XG Boost was selected due to the reason that it is very accurate especially when it comes to imbalanced data sets and doesn’t require a high degree of customization as other algorithms but has a specific set several parameters like Maximum depth or learning rate which has to be adjusted. In the stacking ensemble, the meta-model was Logistic Regression which was then tuned to a greater number of iterations in order to achieve a better minimum. The meta-model was trained with cross-validation in order to avoid over fitting. The model was assessed with metrics that are commonly used, including accuracy, AUPRC and ROC-AUC. These metrics gave an indication on the ability of the model in classifying imbalanced data with high accuracy and predictive models. These techniques and hyperparameters adjustments brought a positive impact in the classification results confirming the success of the using a Hybrid Model composed by SVM and XGBoost. Here, a fusion of both technologies presents a direction for other machine learning applications that need accuracy and understandable results.
